On a 50-sample evaluation, CommitLLM achieves 98% format compliance (vs. 22% for vanilla Mistral), reduces average output length from 154.8 to 37.9 characters, and improves LLM-as-a-Judge scores from 1.97 to 3.68 out of 5. Notably, the post-processing layers contribute more to quality improvement than the fine-tuning itself, suggesting that for structured-output tasks, treating the LLM as a component in a deterministic pipeline is more effective than optimizing the model alone. The entire system runs on a single consumer GPU (NVIDIA T4, 16 GB VRAM).

title: Salience Induction against Multi-Hop RAG Agents: Threat and Defense
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly retrieve external evidence and orchestrate tools for knowledge-intensive applications. In Multi-Hop question answering, agents chain facts across documents. Existing defenses focus on content poisoning, which injects false facts, and prompt injection, which embeds directives. We identify a third attack surface: the salience channel, through which fact position, emphasis, framing, and semantic proximity can redirect reasoning even when all retrieved claims are true and no instructions are present. We formalize Salience Induction as truth-preserving edits that redirect Multi-Hop attribute binding while leaving the retrieval trace semantically intact. We define six Salience-Editing operator classes and build an iterative proposer-verifier pipeline under factual and stealth constraints. We also introduce SalientWiki-MH, a decoy-annotated Multi-Hop benchmark. Evaluations across five frontier model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Qwen) and three agent architectures (ReAct, Reflexion, and tool-calling) show broad generalization. Under a 30% edit budget, Salience Induction achieves an 83.3% attack success rate; the strongest evaluated baseline defense leaves 75.7% post-defense ASR. Untargeted rewriting further reduces attacks only by degrading neutral task success. Our lightweight input-side defense, Salience Normalization, reduces attack success to 15.3% under standard attacks and 23.6% under an adaptive attack. These results show that truthfulness and instruction filtering alone are insufficient: robust agentic RAG also requires defenses against salience-relevance decoupling.

title: Distributive Laws for Parallel Composition in Rely-Guarantee Concurrency
summary: The rely/guarantee approach supports the stepwise development of concurrent programs. Our goal is to develop a theory for reasoning algebraically about concurrent programs in a rely/guarantee style, where rely and guarantee conditions are encoding as commands within our theory. As for mathematics, distributive laws are essential for algebraic manipulation of concurrent programs. In this paper we investigate distributive laws for parallel composition and show how these can be applied to rely/guarantee concurrency. The most general distributive laws are only refinements in a single direction, however, by restricting the form of the command being distributed, one can devise stronger equality laws, which are applicable to guarantee commands as well as to suitable combinations of rely and guarantee commands. Our approach is to develop the distributive laws in a more abstract synchronous atomic algebra, and then apply them to an instance of that algebra supporting rely and guarantee commands. The theory has been formalised in Isabelle/HOL along with proofs of the lemmas presented here.

title: D-NOVA: In-Storage Retrieval Accelerator via Dual-Bound 3D NAND-Optimized Similarity Search with Vector Adaptation
comments: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026), Athens, Greece. Chang Eun Song and Sumukh Pinge are co-first authors and contributed equally
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the factual grounding of large language model (LLM) inference by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases. However, its dense vector retrieval introduces significant latency and energy overhead, becoming the primary performance bottleneck. Although recent in-storage accelerators aim to reduce data movement, they still rely on host or embedded processors outside the memory, where nearly 70% of the total retrieval time is spent. As a result, they cannot fully overcome the bandwidth limitations, leading to yet another memory bottleneck. To tackle these limitations, we present D-NOVA, a hardware-software co-designed in-storage retrieval accelerator. D-NOVA executes an inverted file (IVF)-based hierarchical retrieval pipeline by deeply embedding the search functionality directly into the NAND memory array. This is achieved by incorporating a new distance metric, Dual-Bound Tight Similarity Sensing (DTS), which is specifically tailored for searching within the NAND string. In addition, we introduce a lightweight contrastive adapter that maps embedding vectors into a DTS-friendly domain, recovering near-software recall while improving performance and energy efficiency. D-NOVA is up to 41.7x faster and 71x more energy-efficient than a CPU baseline, and achieves 12.13x higher throughput while being up to 1.26x more energy-efficient than state-of-the-art in-storage RAG accelerators, demonstrating the potential of fully in-storage vector search for scalable RAG acceleration.
comment: Accepted at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026), Athens, Greece. Chang Eun Song and Sumukh Pinge are co-first authors and contributed equally

AI.title_translation: D-NOVA：通过双界限3D NAND优化相似性搜索与向量自适应的存储内检索加速器
AI.tldr: 本文提出D-NOVA，一种将向量检索直接深度嵌入3D NAND阵列的存储内加速器，通过新型距离度量和对比适配器，实现了比现有加速器高12.13倍的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）中的密集向量检索带来了显著的延迟和能耗开销。现有的存储内加速器仍然依赖于存储芯片外部的主机或嵌入式处理器（约占总检索时间的70%），无法完全克服带宽限制，从而导致了新的内存瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一种软硬件协同设计的存储内检索加速器D-NOVA。其方法包括：（1）将基于倒排文件（IVF）的分层检索流水线深度嵌入到NAND内存阵列中直接执行；（2）引入专为NAND串搜索设计的双界限紧密相似性感知（DTS）新距离度量；（3）采用轻量级对比适配器将嵌入向量映射到DTS友好域，以在提高性能和能效的同时恢复接近软件的召回率。
AI.result: 与CPU基线相比，D-NOVA的速度提升了高达41.7倍，能效提升了71倍；与最先进的存储内RAG加速器相比，其吞吐量提高了12.13倍，能效提升了高达1.26倍。
AI.conclusion: D-NOVA展示了全存储内（fully in-storage）向量搜索在实现可扩展RAG加速方面的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过从外部知识库检索相关信息，增强了大语言模型（LLM）推理的事实依据。然而，其密集向量检索引入了显著的延迟和能耗开销，成为主要的性能瓶颈。尽管最近的存储内加速器旨在减少数据移动，但它们仍然依赖于内存之外的主机或嵌入式处理器，近70%的总检索时间都消耗在这些处理器上。因此，它们无法完全克服带宽限制，从而导致了另一个内存瓶颈。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了D-NOVA，一种软硬件协同设计的存储内检索加速器。D-NOVA通过将搜索功能直接深度嵌入到NAND闪存阵列中，执行基于倒排文件（IVF）的分层检索流水线。这是通过引入一种新的距离度量——双界限紧密相似性感知（DTS）来实现的，该度量专门针对NAND串内的搜索进行了定制。此外，我们引入了一个轻量级的对比适配器，将嵌入向量映射到对DTS友好的域中，在提高性能和能效的同时，恢复了接近软件的召回率。与CPU基线相比，D-NOVA的速度提高了41.7倍，能效提高了71倍；与最先进的存储内RAG加速器相比，其吞吐量提高了12.13倍，能效提高了1.26倍，展示了全存储内向量搜索用于可扩展RAG加速的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了D-NOVA，一种旨在加速RAG密集向量检索的软硬件协同设计存储内加速器。通过将检索功能深度嵌入NAND内存阵列，并结合专为NAND定制的DTS距离度量和轻量级对比适配器，D-NOVA克服了传统近存计算的带宽限制，实现了极高的检索吞吐量和能效。
AI.keywords: 存储内检索加速器, 检索增强生成 (RAG), 3D NAND, 相似性搜索, 向量自适应
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将向量检索算法与3D NAND物理特性深度耦合，通过软硬件协同设计（硬件层面的DTS度量与软件层面的对比适配器），打破了传统近存计算中数据仍需移出存储阵列的局限，为解决RAG在大规模应用中的内存和带宽瓶颈提供了极具启发性的思路。

title: Program Synthesis for Simulation-Based Inference: Joint Model Selection and Parameter Estimation
summary: Neural simulation-based inference enables parameter estimation for complex models, but typically requires the user to specify a simulator encoding a fixed model structure. We present a framework for joint model selection and parameter estimation that combines large language models for program synthesis with neural simulation-based inference. Given a natural language description of the system and data under investigation, an LLM proposes candidate simulator programs which are iteratively refined via feedback-driven mutation and evaluated using neural density estimation. The approach enables simulation-based inference over a pool of models, not just parameters within a fixed model. On benchmarks spanning deterministic dynamics, stochastic epidemic models, and dark matter substructure inference from gravitational-lensing images, the method identifies plausible model families from open-ended prompts, with accuracy that reflects the information content of the data and identifiability of candidate models.

AI.title_translation: 模拟推理的程序合成：联合模型选择与参数估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型程序合成与神经模拟推理的框架，实现了在模型族和参数空间上的联合模型选择与参数估计。
AI.motivation: 传统的神经模拟推理虽然能对复杂模型进行参数估计，但通常需要用户指定一个具有固定模型结构的模拟器。为了克服这一限制，需要一种能够同时进行模型选择和参数估计的方法。
AI.method: 提出一个结合大语言模型（LLM）程序合成与神经模拟推理（SBI）的框架。该方法根据系统和数据的自然语言描述，利用LLM提出候选模拟器程序，通过反馈驱动的变异进行迭代优化，并使用神经密度估计进行评估。
AI.result: 在确定性动力学、随机流行病模型以及引力透镜图像的暗物质子结构推理等基准测试中，该方法能够从开放式提示中识别出合理的模型族，其准确性能够反映出数据的信息含量以及候选模型的可辨识性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了在模型池（而非仅在固定模型内的参数）上的模拟推理，为处理具有未知模型结构的复杂系统提供了一种有效的新途径。
AI.translation: 神经模拟推理能够对复杂模型进行参数估计，但通常需要用户指定一个编码了固定模型结构的模拟器。我们提出了一个用于联合模型选择和参数估计的框架，该框架将用于程序合成的大语言模型与神经模拟推理相结合。给定所研究系统和数据的自然语言描述，大语言模型会提出候选模拟器程序，这些程序通过反馈驱动的变异进行迭代优化，并使用神经密度估计进行评估。该方法实现了在模型池（而不仅仅是固定模型内的参数）上的模拟推理。在涵盖确定性动力学、随机流行病模型以及从引力透镜图像中推理暗物质子结构的基准测试中，该方法能够从开放式提示中识别出合理的模型族，其准确性反映了数据的信息含量和候选模型的可辨识性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将大语言模型（LLM）程序合成与神经模拟推理相结合的创新框架，用于解决联合模型选择和参数估计问题。该方法通过自然语言描述生成候选模拟器程序，利用反馈驱动的变异进行迭代优化，并使用神经密度估计进行评估，从而实现了在多个模型族（而非仅在固定模型内部参数）上的模拟推理。
AI.keywords: 模拟推理, 程序合成, 大语言模型, 模型选择, 参数估计
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将大语言模型的程序合成能力引入到科学计算和模拟推理（SBI）中，打破了传统SBI必须依赖预定义、固定物理或数学模型的局限。通过将模型结构搜索转化为代码生成与演化问题，极大地扩展了模拟推理的应用范围。局限性可能在于其对LLM生成代码质量的依赖，以及在极其复杂的物理系统上的计算开销和可扩展性。

title: Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks
summary: In robotic manipulation studies, grasping is often treated as a binary success or failure problem, usually defined by whether the object simply stays in the hand. For forceful tool use, however, this view is insufficient because grasp compliance becomes a critical factor governing how the hand and tool behave under load. Compliance arises from coupled kinematics, grasp configuration, passive mechanics, and contact conditions, producing nonlinear behavior in which deformation and interaction forces influence each other. Understanding this relationship is essential for predictive models of how a grasped tool and a compliant hand jointly respond to external loading. In underactuated hands, these effects are amplified: such designs offer low cost and adaptive grasping, but make compliance behavior more difficult to model and predict. Our goal is therefore to develop a predictive model for grasped tool behavior during forceful interactions. To address this challenge, we introduce an analytical model informed neural network (AMINN), a hybrid predictive model that combines an analytical mechanics layer with data driven learning to estimate grasp stability and in hand tool displacement under external loading. The model is evaluated on a three finger underactuated robotic hand and shows strong predictive capability with mechanically meaningful outputs across diverse loading conditions. Compared with a black box multilayer perceptron baseline, AMINN also achieves better energy based physical consistency. Beyond prediction accuracy alone, this framework advances physically interpretable learning for robotic manipulation and supports more reliable, safer, and more trustworthy autonomous tool use in safety critical settings during forceful interaction.

AI.title_translation: 基于解析模型启发神经网络的机器人手抓取顺应性预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种解析模型启发神经网络（AMINN），通过结合力学解析层与数据驱动学习，实现了对欠驱动机器人手在受载荷时抓取顺应性与工具位移的准确且具物理一致性的预测。
AI.motivation: 传统的抓取研究多将其视为二值化的成功或失败问题，但在强力工具使用中，抓取顺应性（受载荷下机器人手与工具的响应）至关重要。尤其是欠驱动机器人手，其柔顺性行为难以建模和预测，因此需要建立能够预测强力交互中被抓取工具行为的模型。
AI.method: 提出了解析模型启发神经网络（AMINN），这是一种混合预测模型，它将解析力学层与数据驱动学习相结合，用于估计外部载荷下的抓取稳定性和手内工具位移。
AI.result: 在三指欠驱动机器人手上进行了评估，结果表明该模型在多种载荷条件下具有强大的预测能力，并能输出具有物理意义的结果。相比于黑盒多层感知机（MLP）基线，AMINN 实现了更好的基于能量的物理一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架推动了机器人操作中物理可解释性学习的发展，并为安全关键环境下强力交互中更可靠、更安全和更值得信赖的自主工具使用提供了支持。
AI.translation: 在机器人操作研究中，抓取通常被视为一个二元的成功或失败问题，通常由物体是否留在手中来定义。然而，对于强力工具的使用，这种观点是不够的，因为抓取顺应性（compliance）成为了决定手和工具在负载下如何表现的关键因素。顺应性源于耦合的运动学、抓取配置、被动力学和接触条件，产生变形和相互作用力相互影响的非线性行为。理解这种关系对于预测抓取的工具和顺应手如何共同响应外部载荷的模型至关重要。在欠驱动手中，这些效应被放大：此类设计成本低且抓取自适应，但使顺应性行为更难建模和预测。因此，我们的目标是开发一种预测模型，用于预测强力交互过程中被抓取工具的行为。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了解析模型启发神经网络（AMINN），这是一种混合预测模型，它将解析力学层与数据驱动学习相结合，以估计外部载荷下的抓取稳定性和手内工具位移。该模型在三指欠驱动机器人手上进行了评估，在不同的载荷条件下展现出强大的预测能力，并具有机械学意义的输出。与黑盒多层感知机基线相比，AMINN 还实现了更好的基于能量的物理一致性。除了预测精度之外，该框架还推进了机器人操作中具有物理可解释性的学习，并支持在强力交互的安全关键设置中更可靠、更安全、更具可信度的自主工具使用。
AI.summary: 本文针对欠驱动机器人手在强力工具使用时抓取顺应性难以建模的问题，提出了一种名为 AMINN 的混合预测模型。该模型结合了解析力学层与数据驱动学习，能够准确预测外部载荷下工具在手内的位移和抓取稳定性。在三指欠驱动手机械臂上的实验表明，相比传统黑盒多层感知机，该方法不仅预测精度高，而且具备更好的物理一致性和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 机器人抓取, 抓取顺应性, 物理启发神经网络, 欠驱动机器人手, 工具操作
AI.comments: 1. 创新性：将解析力学先验知识引入神经网络（AMINN），解决了传统纯数据驱动模型在抓取顺应性预测中缺乏物理约束和解释性的问题。2. 实用性：针对欠驱动机器人手这一低成本但难以建模的硬件，提供了有效的顺应性预测，对实际强力工具操作具有重要意义。3. 局限性：摘要中仅提到在特定的三指欠驱动手上进行了评估，其对更复杂多指手或不同材质物体的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: Finite-Time Curvature-Constrained Vector Field for Saturation-Free Motion Planning of Nonholonomic Robots
summary: Accurately steering a robot to a target configuration is fundamental in engineering, yet remains challenging for nonholonomic mobile robots. Vector fields (VFs) provide a natural framework by specifying desired motion directions throughout the workspace and enabling direct integration with feedback control. However, most existing VF-based methods cannot explicitly generate trajectories satisfying curvature constraints. Actuator limits are therefore often enforced by input saturation, which may invalidate stability guarantees and degrade closed-loop performance when not considered in controller design. In addition, these methods usually ensure only asymptotic convergence without an explicit settling-time bound. To address these issues, we propose a generalized motion planning and control framework consisting of a finite-time curvature-constrained vector field (FT-C2VF) and a saturation-free control law. Depending on the motion objective, the framework drives the robot to the target configuration in finite time or through it periodically. First, the FT-C2VF is constructed using complementary gains to achieve finite-time convergence while ensuring that the curvature of its integral curves is continuous, bounded, and monotonically decreasing with the radial ratio. Second, an almost globally C1-smooth, saturation-free controller is developed to track the FT-C2VF without Jacobian information, while keeping all control inputs within prescribed actuator limits. Third, dynamical-systems analysis establishes almost-global finite-time stability of the target equilibrium. Numerical simulations show improved performance over representative VF-based methods, and outdoor experiments on an Ackermann-steered vehicle confirm the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed approach.

AI.title_translation: 非完整机器人无饱和运动规划的有限时间曲率约束向量场
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的有限时间曲率约束向量场（FT-C2VF）和无饱和控制算法，解决了非完整机器人在执行机构限制和曲率约束下的有限时间精确运动规划与控制问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于向量场（VF）的方法无法显式生成满足曲率约束的轨迹。此外，执行器限制通常通过输入饱和来强制执行，这在控制器设计中未被考虑时，会破坏稳定性保证并降低闭环性能。同时，现有方法通常仅能确保渐近收敛，缺乏明确的有限时间整定边界。
AI.method: 提出一个通用的运动规划与控制框架，包含：（1）利用互补增益构建有限时间曲率约束向量场（FT-C2VF），实现有限时间收敛，并确保积分曲线曲率连续、有界且单调递减；（2）开发一种几乎全局 $C^1$ 光滑、无饱和的控制器，在无需雅可比信息的情况下跟踪 FT-C2VF，同时将控制输入保持在规定的执行器限制内；（3）通过动力学系统分析确立目标平衡点的近乎全局有限时间稳定性。
AI.result: 数值仿真表明，该方法比代表性的基于向量场的方法具有更好的性能；在阿克曼转向车辆上的室外实验证实了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够根据运动目标，在有限时间内将非完整机器人驱动到目标配置或周期性通过目标配置，同时满足曲率和执行器输入限制，并保证系统的近乎全局有限时间稳定性。
AI.translation: 准确地引导机器人到达目标配置是工程中的基础问题，但对非完整移动机器人来说仍然具有挑战性。向量场（VF）通过在整个工作空间中指定期望的运动方向并实现与反馈控制的直接集成，提供了一个自然的框架。然而，大多数现有的基于VF的方法无法显式生成满足曲率约束的轨迹。因此，执行器限制通常通过输入饱和来强制执行，这在控制器设计中未予以考虑时，可能会使稳定性保证失效并降低闭环性能。此外，这些方法通常仅能确保渐近收敛，而没有明确的调节时间边界。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个通用的运动规划和控制框架，由有限时间曲率约束向量场（FT-C2VF）和无饱和控制律组成。根据运动目标，该框架在有限时间内将机器人驱动到目标配置，或周期性地通过目标配置。首先，利用互补增益构建FT-C2VF以实现有限时间收敛，同时确保其积分曲线的曲率连续、有界且随径向比单调递减。其次，开发了一种几乎全局 $C^1$ 光滑、无饱和的控制器，以在不需要雅可比信息的情况下跟踪FT-C2VF，同时将所有控制输入保持在规定的执行器限制内。第三，动力学系统分析确立了目标平衡点的几乎全局有限时间稳定性。数值仿真表明，与代表性的基于VF的方法相比，该方法性能有所提高，在阿克曼转向车辆上的室外实验证实了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对非完整移动机器人的运动规划问题，提出了一种结合有限时间曲率约束向量场（FT-C2VF）与无饱和控制律的通用框架。该框架不仅保证了积分曲线曲率的有界性与连续性，还实现了无需雅可比信息的控制器设计，确保控制输入不超出执行器物理极限，并证明了目标状态的近乎全局有限时间稳定性。仿真和实车实验验证了该方案的优越性与实用性。
AI.keywords: 非完整机器人, 向量场, 有限时间收敛, 曲率约束, 无饱和控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将有限时间收敛性、显式曲率约束以及执行器饱和限制集成到一个统一的向量场控制框架中。通过引入互补增益和免雅可比的 $C^1$ 光滑控制器，优雅地解决了非完整约束（如阿克曼转向）机器人运动规划中的硬约束问题。实验设计完整，既有理论稳定性证明，又有室外实车验证，具有很高的实用价值。

title: The Curvature Shadow: An Apparent Failure of Maximum-Entropy Equilibrium Selection is a Removable Artifact
comments: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Diagnostic companion to arXiv:2606.28308. Fully reproducible: a single self-contained notebook regenerates every number, table, and figure
summary: In two-player zero-sum games whose Nash equilibria form a convex set, regularized solvers such as Regularized Nash Dynamics (R-NaD) empirically select the maximum-entropy member: the information projection (I-projection) of a uniform reference onto the Nash set. On a panel of small games this match is exact, with one apparent exception: in Kuhn poker R-NaD lands at bluff coordinate 0.180 while the maximum-entropy member sits at 0.201, a coordinate gap of about 0.021, even though R-NaD attains 99.7 percent of the maximum entropy. We ask whether this gap is a genuine selection bias or an artifact, and answer it quantitatively. We show that for selection on a one-dimensional Nash manifold the coordinate gap factorizes as $\mathrm{gap} \approx \sqrt{2δ/κ}$, where $δ$ is the entropy shortfall of the solver and $κ$ is the curvature of the entropy landscape at its peak. Across five games this relation holds to within $2 \times 10^{-4}$ (under 1 percent relative error). The four matrix games have $δ\approx 0$ (R-NaD reaches the maximum-entropy member exactly) and therefore no gap regardless of curvature; only the sequential game (Kuhn) has $δ> 0$. A causal sweep of the magnet strength drives $δ\to 0$ and the gap toward zero along the predicted curve (fitted scaling exponent 0.50, $R^2 > 0.999999$, against the exact prediction of 1/2), until the dynamics destabilize at a stability floor: behavior consistent with a removable shortfall and inconsistent with a fixed bias. We quantify the curvature half of the law from measured curvatures and flag a moving-target pitfall in the natural Tsallis-entropy experiment. The Kuhn gap is thus the curvature shadow of a small, removable entropy shortfall on an unusually flat peak; the I-projection account is upheld up to a flatness-limited residual.

AI.title_translation: 曲率之影：最大熵均衡选择的表观失败是一个可消除的人工假象
AI.tldr: 本文研究了正则化纳什动力学在库恩扑克中选择最大熵均衡时的表观偏差，证明该偏差并非真正的选择偏见，而是由于熵景观极度平坦（低曲率）导致微小熵赤字被放大的“曲率之影”这一可消除的假象。
AI.motivation: 在双人零和博弈中，正则化求解器（如R-NaD）在经验上会选择最大熵纳什均衡（I-投影）。然而在库恩扑克中，R-NaD的求解结果与最大熵成员之间存在明显的坐标差距（0.180对0.201），尽管其达到了99.7%的最大熵。本文旨在探究这一差距是真正的选择偏见，还是由于某种原因造成的人工假象。
AI.method: 理论上，作者推导出一维纳什流形上的坐标差距公式：$\text{gap} \approx \sqrt{2\delta/\kappa}$（其中 $\delta$ 为求解器的熵赤字，$\kappa$ 为峰值处的熵景观曲率）。实验上，通过在5个博弈（包括4个矩阵博弈和库恩扑克）中验证该关系，并对磁场强度进行因果扫描以驱动 $\delta \to 0$。
AI.result: 1. 该公式在5个博弈中均成立，相对误差小于1%（误差在 $2 \times 10^{-4}$ 以内）。2. 4个矩阵博弈的 $\delta \approx 0$，无差距；仅顺序博弈（库恩扑克）的 $\delta > 0$。3. 扫频实验成功使 $\delta \to 0$，差距沿着预测曲线降至零（拟合标度指数为0.50，$R^2 > 0.999999$，与理论预测的1/2完全吻合），直到动力学在稳定底限解体，表明该差距是可消除的。
AI.conclusion: 库恩扑克中的坐标差距并非固定的选择偏见，而是由于在异常平坦的峰值（低曲率）上存在微小且可消除的熵赤字所造成的“曲率之影”。最大熵（I-投影）选择假说在平坦度限制的残差范围内依然成立。
AI.translation: 在纳什均衡构成凸集的双人零和博弈中，正则化求解器（如正则化纳什动力学，R-NaD）在经验上会选择最大熵成员：即均匀参考分布在纳什集上的信息投影（I-projection）。在一组小型博弈中，这种匹配是精确的，但有一个明显的例外：在库恩扑克（Kuhn poker）中，尽管 R-NaD 达到了最大熵的 99.7%，但它停留在诈唬坐标 0.180 处，而最大熵成员则位于 0.201 处，坐标差距约为 0.021。我们探究这一差距是真正的选择偏见还是人工假象，并对其进行了定量解答。我们展示了对于一维纳什流形上的选择，坐标差距可以分解为 $\mathrm{gap} \approx \sqrt{2\delta/\kappa}$，其中 $\delta$ 是求解器的熵赤字，$\kappa$ 是熵景观在峰值处的曲率。在五个博弈中，这一关系在 $2 \times 10^{-4}$ 以内成立（相对误差低于 1%）。四个矩阵博弈的 $\delta \approx 0$（R-NaD 精确达到了最大熵成员），因此无论曲率如何都没有差距；只有顺序博弈（库恩扑克）的 $\delta > 0$。对磁铁强度进行因果扫描可以驱动 $\delta \to 0$，并使差距沿着预测曲线趋于零（拟合的标度指数为 0.50，$R^2 > 0.999999$，而精确预测值为 1/2），直到动力学在稳定底限处去稳定化：这一行为与可消除的赤字相一致，而与固定偏见不一致。我们根据测量的曲率量化了该定律的曲率部分，并在自然的 Tsallis 熵实验中指出了一个“移动目标”陷阱。因此，库恩扑克中的差距是一个在异常平坦的峰值上微小、可消除的熵赤字所产生的“曲率之影”；最大熵投影（I-projection）的解释在平坦度限制的残差范围内得以维持。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了正则化纳什动力学（R-NaD）在求解库恩扑克时，其结果与最大熵纳什均衡之间存在微小坐标差距的现象。作者证明了该差距并非算法固有的选择偏见，而是由于熵景观在峰值处极其平坦（低曲率），导致微小的熵赤字被放大。通过推导差距与熵赤字、曲率之间的定量关系 $\text{gap} \approx \sqrt{2\delta/\kappa}$ 并进行实验验证，本文证实了该差距是一个可消除的人工假象，从而捍卫了最大熵均衡选择（I-投影）假说。
AI.keywords: 最大熵均衡选择, 正则化纳什动力学, 库恩扑克, 熵景观曲率, 信息投影
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于为看似失败的最大熵均衡选择提供了一个优美且严格的数学解释。通过将坐标偏差与熵赤字和曲率联系起来，不仅解决了一个具体的理论悬案（库恩扑克中的偏差），还揭示了优化景观几何结构（如平坦度）对算法收敛行为的微妙影响。这对于理解正则化强化学习和博弈论求解器的收敛行为具有重要的理论和实践指导意义。

title: Retain or Consolidate? Budget-Dependent Operator Selection for Language Agent Memory
summary: Language agents depend on memory across interactions. However, the limited context windows of large language models (LLMs) and their inference costs constrain how much memory can be used at once. Existing systems mainly follow two strategies: memory retention and memory consolidation. Retention keeps raw records and preserves exact details, but relevant evidence may not fit under a tight budget; consolidation compresses and combines records, improving coverage per token but risking the loss of query-critical details. Neither strategy is universally preferable. This raises two central questions: when should consolidation replace retention, and which operator -- Merge, Abstract, or Rewrite -- should be selected? We formalize this decision by decomposing each operator's utility into a coverage effect on evidence omitted by retention and a signed replacement effect on raw evidence that already fits. Their balance explains why the preferred action changes with relative budget pressure. We implement this mechanism with Offline Abstraction-Safety (OAS), a lightweight learner that estimates action utilities from pre-generation features with held-out harm calibration. The public LongMemEval and LoCoMo benchmarks show the same budget-dependent pattern. On LongMemEval, consolidation improves absolute accuracy by up to 48% under tight budgets, whereas retention is preferable under loose budgets; LoCoMo replicates this crossover at a smaller budget, consistent with its shorter evidence. On both datasets, cross-note abstraction and merging generally outperform local rewriting when compression is necessary.

AI.title_translation: 保留还是合并？语言智能体记忆中依赖预算的算子选择
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于预算的记忆算子选择机制（OAS），在紧张预算下采用合并/抽象策略（准确率提升达48%），在宽松预算下采用保留策略，以优化大模型智能体的长期记忆性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的上下文窗口限制和推理成本制约了其一次性可使用的记忆量。现有的记忆保留（保留原始细节但可能超出预算）和记忆合并（压缩记录但可能丢失关键细节）策略各有优劣，缺乏在不同预算限制下选择最佳策略和算子（合并、抽象或重写）的机制。
AI.method:
1. 将记忆算子的效用分解为：对保留策略所遗漏证据的“覆盖效应”（coverage effect）和对已容纳原始证据的“替代效应”（replacement effect）。
2. 实现离线抽象安全（OAS）机制，这是一种轻量级学习器，通过生成前特征和预留的损害校准（held-out harm calibration）来估计动作效用。
AI.result:
在LongMemEval和LoCoMo基准测试中：
1. 紧张预算下，记忆合并使绝对准确率提升高达48%，而宽松预算下保留策略更佳。
2. 在需要压缩时，跨笔记的抽象和合并普遍优于局部重写。
AI.conclusion: 记忆管理策略的选择高度依赖于预算压力。通过量化覆盖效应和替代效应并使用OAS轻量级学习器，可以有效地在不同预算约束下动态选择保留或合并算子，从而优化语言智能体的长期记忆性能。
AI.translation: 语言智能体在交互中依赖于记忆。然而，大语言模型（LLM）有限的上下文窗口及其推理成本限制了单次可使用的记忆量。现有系统主要采用两种策略：记忆保留和记忆合并。保留策略保存原始记录并维持精确细节，但在紧张的预算下，相关证据可能无法完全容纳；合并策略压缩并结合记录，提高了每个Token的覆盖率，但存在丢失查询关键细节的风险。这两种策略并非在所有情况下都更优。这引出了两个核心问题：何时应该用合并取代保留，以及应该选择哪种算子——合并（Merge）、抽象（Abstract）还是重写（Rewrite）？我们通过将每个算子的效用分解为对保留策略所遗漏证据的覆盖效应，以及对已容纳原始证据的有符号替代效应，从而将这一决策形式化。两者的平衡解释了为什么首选操作会随着相对预算压力的变化而改变。我们利用离线抽象安全（OAS）实现了这一机制，这是一种轻量级学习器，它通过生成前特征和预留的损害校准来估计动作效用。公开的LongMemEval和LoCoMo基准测试展示了相同的依赖预算的模式。在LongMemEval上，在紧张预算下，合并策略使绝对准确率提高了高达48%，而在宽松预算下，保留策略更佳；LoCoMo在更小的预算下复制了这种交叉现象，这与其更短的证据相一致。在这两个数据集上，当需要进行压缩时，跨笔记的抽象和合并通常优于局部重写。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了语言智能体在面临LLM上下文和成本限制时的记忆管理问题。作者提出了一种基于预算依赖的记忆算子选择机制，通过将决策形式化为“覆盖效应”和“替代效应”的平衡，并利用轻量级学习器OAS动态选择保留、合并、抽象或重写算子。实验表明，该方法在紧张预算下可提升高达48%的准确率，实现了高效的自适应记忆管理。
AI.keywords: 语言智能体, 记忆管理, 预算依赖, 上下文压缩, 离线抽象安全
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：本文创新地将记忆管理（保留与合并）决策形式化为“覆盖效应”与“替代效应”的博弈，并引入了轻量级的OAS决策机制。
2. 重要性：针对LLM上下文限制和高昂的推理成本，提出了自适应的记忆优化方案，对构建长文本、低成本的智能体系统具有重要应用价值。
3. 局限性：摘要中未提及该机制在多大程度上依赖于预训练模型的先验能力，以及在超大规模并发场景下的决策延迟。

title: Human-in-the-Loop User Feedback Affects Perceived Accuracy and Trust, but Task Subjectivity Matters
summary: While ML can produce complex models beyond those that a human could produce manually, incorporating human input can often improve performance beyond purely data-driven models. While this feedback could come from system designers or domain experts, in many cases, the end users who regularly use the system will naturally develop an understanding of its flaws and desire the ability to change the system's behavior based on their knowledge. While soliciting feedback from end users can result in significant model improvement over time, introducing these feedback techniques can also affect several human factors-such as trust or perception of system accuracy-that are not yet fully understood and have different effects reported in the existing literature. Therefore, we sought to build on the existing research to further explore how the act of providing feedback can affect user understanding of an intelligent system and its accuracy in different contexts. We present three controlled experiments that study the effects of interactive feedback collections on user impressions in domains with objective and subjective feedback. The results show that in a context where there is an objectively correct answer, providing HITL feedback lowered both participants' trust in the system and their perception of system accuracy, regardless of whether the system accuracy improved in response to their feedback. However, when the feedback being provided involved subjective opinion, no such negative bias was observed. Furthermore, in the objective context, participants distrusted the system over time, whereas participants in the subjective context mistrusted the system over time. These results highlight the importance of considering the effects of allowing different types of end-user feedback on user trust when designing intelligent systems.

AI.title_translation: 人机协同用户反馈影响感知准确性与信任度，但任务主观性至关重要
AI.tldr: 研究发现，在客观任务中提供人机协同反馈会降低用户对系统的信任度和感知准确性，而在主观任务中则不会产生这种负面偏差。
AI.motivation: 尽管从终端用户那里收集反馈可以改善模型，但引入反馈机制如何影响用户的信任度和感知准确性等人类因素尚未被充分理解，且现有研究结论不一。因此，本研究旨在探索在不同背景下，提供反馈这一行为如何影响用户对智能系统的理解和准确性感知。
AI.method: 进行了三项受控实验，研究在包含客观和主观反馈的领域中，交互式反馈收集对用户印象的影响。
AI.result: 在存在客观正确答案的背景下，提供人机协同反馈降低了参与者对系统的信任度和对其准确性的感知（无论系统准确性是否因反馈而提高）；而在涉及主观意见的背景下，则没有观察到这种负面偏差。此外，在客观背景下，参与者随着时间的推移对系统产生怀疑（distrusted），而在主观背景下，参与者随着时间的推移对系统产生不信任（mistrusted）。
AI.conclusion: 在设计智能系统时，必须考虑允许不同类型的终端用户反馈对用户信任度所产生的影响，任务的主观性在其中起着关键作用。
AI.translation: 尽管机器学习可以产生超出人类手动构建的复杂模型，但引入人类输入通常可以比纯数据驱动模型进一步提高性能。虽然这些反馈可以来自系统设计者或领域专家，但在许多情况下，经常使用该系统的终端用户自然会对系统的缺陷产生理解，并希望能够根据他们的知识改变系统的行为。虽然向终端用户征求反馈随着时间的推移可以带来显著的模型改进，但引入这些反馈技术也会影响一些人类因素——例如信任度或对系统准确性的感知——这些因素尚未被完全理解，且现有文献中报道了不同的影响。因此，我们试图在现有研究的基础上，进一步探索提供反馈这一行为在不同背景下如何影响用户对智能系统的理解及其准确性。我们展示了三个受控实验，研究了在具有客观和主观反馈的领域中，交互式反馈收集对用户印象的影响。结果表明，在存在客观正确答案的背景下，提供人机协同（HITL）反馈降低了参与者对系统的信任度以及他们对系统准确性的感知，无论系统准确性是否因他们的反馈而得到改善。然而，当提供的反馈涉及主观意见时，没有观察到这种负面偏差。此外，在客观背景下，参与者随着时间的推移对系统产生怀疑（distrusted），而在主观背景下，参与者随着时间的推移对系统产生不信任（mistrusted）。这些结果强调了在设计智能系统时，考虑允许不同类型的终端用户反馈对用户信任度产生的影响的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文通过三项受控实验，探讨了人机协同（HITL）反馈对用户在客观和主观任务背景下对智能系统信任度及感知准确性的影响。研究表明，在客观任务中提供反馈会降低用户的信任和准确性感知，而在主观任务中则不会，这强调了在设计智能系统反馈机制时考虑任务主观性的重要性。
AI.keywords: 人机协同 (Human-in-the-Loop), 用户反馈 (User Feedback), 信任度 (Trust), 感知准确性 (Perceived Accuracy), 主观性 (Subjectivity)
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了人机交互中一个非常实用但常被忽视的心理学现象：用户提供反馈的行为本身会如何反向影响他们对系统的信任。其创新之处在于区分了“客观”和“主观”任务背景，并发现了截然不同的用户心理偏见（如客观任务中的负面偏见）。这一发现对于设计更符合人类心理预期的交互式AI系统（如推荐系统、辅助决策系统）具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: (A)iSpy: Parasitic Trojans for Machine Learning Infrastructure
summary: Modern machine learning (ML) pipelines depend heavily on third party libraries for graph compilation and hardware acceleration. While current practices audit data and model artifacts or rely on file integrity checks, the execution environment remains implicitly trusted. This blind spot enables active threats where a malicious runtime module interacts directly with live training and inference dynamics: exploiting this interaction allows the Trojan to support complex objectives that are challenging for static code or binary modifications, achieving manipulations impossible for standard data and model level attacks. We expose this vulnerability by presenting (A)iSpy, a parasitic infrastructure Trojan that subverts ML systems through an active observe and execute paradigm. Operating within the computation graph, (A)iSpy monitors transient tensor states to perform targeted, stealthy manipulations with negligible overhead. To violate confidentiality, the Trojan identifies all critical training hyperparameters and covertly exfiltrates them via model weights or output logits. To break integrity, it acts as a gradient amplifier: by observing steganographic triggers, it transforms otherwise weak data poisoning into effective backdoor attacks, increasing success rates from near zero to 100%. We further demonstrate broad extensibility across the machine learning lifecycle by validating auxiliary attacks in the appendix, including subpopulation label flipping, availability disruptions, and inference stage manipulations. Importantly, the (A)iSpy module easily evades standard malware scanners, while the associated poisoned inputs and resulting compromised models bypass typical inspection tools. We demonstrate the practicality of this threat with an implementation in the ONNX Runtime training and inference engines.

AI.title_translation: (A)iSpy：面向机器学习基础设施的寄生式木马
AI.tldr: (A)iSpy是一种新型机器学习运行时木马，它通过在计算图内部进行观察和执行，实现隐蔽的攻击操控并绕过现有的安全防御。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习管道过于依赖第三方库且默认信任执行环境，导致存在无法通过静态代码或二进制分析检测到的动态运行时威胁。
AI.method: 提出(A)iSpy寄生式基础设施木马，在计算图内部运行，通过观察瞬时张量状态实现目标操控；利用梯度放大技术增强数据投毒效果，并利用模型权重或输出逻辑进行数据窃取。
AI.result: (A)iSpy在ONNX Runtime中实现，能以极低的开销实现超高成功率的后门攻击（从近0%提升至100%），并能有效窃取敏感超参数，同时成功规避了主流恶意软件扫描器和检查工具。
AI.conclusion: (A)iSpy证明了机器学习运行时环境是一个关键的攻击面，现有的基于静态审计和文件完整性检查的防御措施不足以应对此类动态威胁。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习（ML）管道高度依赖第三方库进行图编译和硬件加速。虽然目前的实践审计数据和模型工件或依赖文件完整性检查，但执行环境仍然是被隐式信任的。这一盲点使得恶意运行时模块可以直接与实时训练和推理动态交互，从而产生主动威胁：利用这种交互，木马可以支持静态代码或二进制修改难以实现的复杂目标，达到标准数据和模型级攻击无法实现的操控效果。我们通过提出(A)iSpy暴露了这一漏洞，这是一种通过主动“观察和执行”范式颠覆ML系统的寄生式基础设施木马。在计算图内运行，(A)iSpy监控瞬时张量状态以执行目标明确、隐蔽的操控，且开销可忽略不计。为了破坏机密性，木马识别所有关键训练超参数，并通过模型权重或输出Logits隐蔽地泄露它们。为了破坏完整性，它充当梯度放大器：通过观察隐写触发器，它将原本微弱的数据投毒转化为有效的后门攻击，将成功率从近乎零提高到100%。我们进一步通过验证附录中的辅助攻击，证明了其在机器学习生命周期中的广泛扩展性，包括子群体标签翻转、可用性中断和推理阶段操控。重要的是，(A)iSpy模块容易规避标准恶意软件扫描器，而相关的投毒输入和生成的受损模型也会绕过典型的检查工具。我们在ONNX Runtime训练和推理引擎中的实现证明了这种威胁的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对机器学习基础设施的寄生式木马(A)iSpy，它通过在计算图运行时监控张量状态，实现对模型训练和推理过程的隐蔽操控。该木马能有效进行超参数窃取和增强型后门攻击，且能绕过现有的安全检测机制。
AI.keywords: 机器学习基础设施, 寄生式木马, 计算图, 运行时攻击, 后门攻击
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了机器学习基础设施中一个常被忽视的安全漏洞：对运行时环境的盲目信任。通过在计算图层面植入寄生式木马，该研究展示了攻击者如何利用动态执行流进行更隐蔽、更复杂的攻击，这对现有的模型安全防御体系构成了严峻挑战。

title: Hierarchy-Aware and Anatomy-Guided Learning for Lung Ultrasound Video Classification
summary: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is a bedside tool for assessing pulmonary edema in patients at risk due to heart failure or impaired kidney function. However, automated LUS analysis remains challenging because of speckle noise, imaging artifacts, and operator-dependent acquisition variability. In this work, we present a deep learning framework for multi-class LUS video classification that explores two components: hierarchy-aware training, and anatomy-guided learning. Starting from a strong baseline, we introduce hierarchical training strategies and then introduce pleural line mask supervision to guide model attention toward anatomically relevant regions. We study four clinically relevant classes--healthy, B-lines, consolidations, and mixed B-lines with consolidations--using an open-access dataset of 1,886 videos from 219 patients, evaluated with patient-level five-fold cross-validation. Results show that hierarchy-aware training improves pathological separation relative to flat classification, while mask-guided attention supervision achieves the highest mean macro-F1 of 65.7\% and produces more localized attention patterns. Transfer experiments on the external COVID-BLUeS dataset further show competitive and parameter-efficient adaptation while preserving pleural-focused attention behavior. These findings suggest that combining clinically structured objectives with anatomy-guided supervision is a practical approach to robust, interpretable LUS video analysis. Code and model implementations are available at https://github.com/Alya-Almsouti/LUS-video-classification.

AI.title_translation: 面向肺部超声视频分类的层次感知与解剖引导学习
AI.tldr: 通过引入层次化训练和胸膜线解剖引导，提升了肺部超声视频分类的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 肺部超声分析面临散斑噪声、成像伪影及操作依赖性等挑战，现有的自动化分析方法性能有待提升，且缺乏临床可解释性。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含层次感知训练和解剖学引导学习（胸膜线掩码监督）的深度学习框架，旨在引导模型关注临床相关的解剖区域。
AI.result: 在包含1886个视频的数据集上达到了65.7%的平均宏F1分数，且在外部数据集上展现了良好的迁移能力和参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 结合临床结构化目标与解剖学引导的监督学习，是实现鲁棒且可解释的肺部超声视频分类的有效途径。
AI.translation: 肺部超声（LUS）是一种用于评估心力衰竭或肾功能受损风险患者肺水肿的床旁工具。然而，由于散斑噪声、成像伪影和操作依赖性的采集变异性，自动LUS分析仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个用于多类LUS视频分类的深度学习框架，探索了两个组件：层次感知训练和解剖学引导学习。在强大的基线基础上，我们引入了层次化训练策略，并引入了胸膜线掩码监督，以引导模型注意力指向解剖学相关的区域。我们使用了一个包含219名患者的1,886个视频的开放数据集，研究了四种临床相关类别——健康、B线、实变和混合B线伴实变，并进行了患者级五折交叉验证。结果表明，层次感知训练比扁平分类更能改善病理分离效果，而掩码引导的注意力监督实现了65.7%的最高平均宏F1，并产生了更局部的注意力模式。在外部COVID-BLUeS数据集上的迁移实验进一步表明，该方法在保持专注于胸膜的注意力行为的同时，实现了具有竞争力和参数效率的适配。这些发现表明，结合临床结构化目标与解剖学引导的监督是实现稳健、可解释的LUS视频分析的实用方法。代码和模型实现可在https://github.com/Alya-Almsouti/LUS-video-classification获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于肺部超声视频分类的深度学习框架，通过引入层次感知训练策略和基于胸膜线掩码的解剖学引导监督，显著提升了病理分类的准确性与模型注意力的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 肺部超声, 视频分类, 层次化学习, 解剖学引导, 注意力机制
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将医学领域的先验知识（层次结构和解剖学特征）有效地融入到深度学习框架中，不仅提升了分类性能，还增强了模型的可解释性。这对于临床辅助决策系统具有重要意义。局限性在于主要依赖于胸膜线掩码，对于其他复杂病灶的细粒度定位可能仍有提升空间。

title: Enhanced ODMA for Massive Sparse Access: Hybrid Data-Frozen Bit Transmission and Fixed-Point Analysis over Block Fading Channels
summary: This paper proposes a novel on-off division multiple access (ODMA) transmission scheme that enables efficient joint multi-user channel estimation and iterative decoding by inserting a small number of frozen symbols into the codewords. Functionally analogous to pilots, these symbols are sparsely distributed within the codeword. Unlike conventional pilot-based methods, our approach requires only a minimal number of frozen symbols (e.g., $5\sim20$ symbols per user in a 300-user system), which serve dual purposes as both estimation references and decoding aids. By employing low-complexity single-user channel estimation and decoding, combined with simple iterative interference cancellation, the scheme achieves performance equivalent to that with perfectly known user channels, even when accounting for the additional energy and bandwidth costs of the frozen symbols. Furthermore, for the large-scale ODMA sparse multiple access system, this paper proposes a fixed-point analysis method, which can accurately estimate the iterative convergence performance over multi-user block fading channels by only leveraging the decoding functions under the single-user AWGN channel. This method is applicable to performance analysis for arbitrary code lengths, code rates, and decoding algorithms. It eliminates the need for extensive Monte Carlo simulation time, and provides an efficient tool for the design of multi-user codes.

AI.title_translation: 面向海量稀疏接入的增强型ODMA：块衰落信道下的混合数据-冻结比特传输与定点分析
AI.tldr: 提出了一种低开销的ODMA方案，通过少量冻结符号实现高效联合信道估计与译码，并提供了一种无需大规模仿真的定点性能分析方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于导频的信道估计方法在大规模稀疏接入场景下开销巨大且复杂，亟需一种低开销、低复杂度的联合信道估计与译码方案，并缺乏高效的性能评估工具。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合数据-冻结比特传输方案，在码字中稀疏插入少量冻结符号作为估计参考和译码辅助，结合低复杂度的单用户信道估计、译码及迭代干扰消除技术；同时提出了一种基于单用户AWGN信道译码函数的定点分析方法，用于预测多用户块衰落信道下的迭代收敛性能。
AI.result: 该方案在仅需少量冻结符号的情况下，达到了与已知信道状态相当的性能；定点分析方法能够准确估计多用户块衰落信道下的迭代收敛性能，适用于任意码长、码率和译码算法，显著减少了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 该方案通过极少的冻结符号实现了接近理想信道状态下的性能，且提出的定点分析方法为大规模多用户系统的设计与评估提供了高效的理论框架。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的开关分多址接入（ODMA）传输方案，通过在码字中插入少量冻结符号，实现了高效的联合多用户信道估计和迭代译码。在功能上类似于导频，这些符号稀疏地分布在码字中。与传统的基于导频的方法不同，我们的方法仅需要极少量的冻结符号（例如，在300用户系统中每个用户仅需5~20个符号），这些符号同时作为估计参考和译码辅助。通过采用低复杂度的单用户信道估计和译码，结合简单的迭代干扰消除，该方案即使在考虑了冻结符号的额外能量和带宽成本的情况下，也能实现与已知用户信道相当的性能。此外，针对大规模ODMA稀疏多址接入系统，本文提出了一种定点分析方法，仅利用单用户AWGN信道下的译码函数，即可准确估计多用户块衰落信道下的迭代收敛性能。该方法适用于任意码长、码率和译码算法的性能分析，消除了对大量蒙特卡洛仿真时间的依赖，并为多用户码的设计提供了一种高效工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型ODMA传输方案，通过在码字中插入少量冻结符号，实现了高效的联合多用户信道估计与迭代译码。该方法在保证系统性能接近理想信道的同时，降低了复杂度和资源开销。此外，论文还提出了一种基于单用户AWGN信道特性的定点分析方法，能够高效评估大规模多用户系统的迭代收敛性能，无需复杂的仿真。
AI.keywords: 开关分多址接入 (ODMA), 海量稀疏接入, 冻结符号, 信道估计, 定点分析
AI.comments: 该研究通过在码字中插入极少量冻结符号，巧妙地实现了信道估计与迭代译码的结合，显著降低了多用户大规模接入系统的复杂度和开销。其提出的定点分析方法是该论文的一大亮点，为大规模多用户系统性能评估提供了高效的理论工具，摆脱了对大规模蒙特卡洛仿真的依赖。

title: Volatility-Aware Extreme Event Detection in High-Frequency Financial Markets
summary: Predicting extreme price movements in high-frequency financial markets is a challenging task due to non-stationarity, heavy-tailed return distributions, and severe class imbalance. In particular, rare but impactful events are often difficult to detect using conventional modeling approaches, which typically treat extreme movements as isolated observations. This study proposes a volatility-aware approach for extreme event detection using high-frequency Bitcoin limit order book (LOB) data. Motivated by empirical evidence of volatility clustering, the target formulation is extended to incorporate both large future returns and high-volatility regimes. This redefinition increases the proportion of informative samples and aligns the learning objective with the underlying market dynamics. Using a tree-based model (XGBoost) with time-series cross-validation and imbalance-aware evaluation, the proposed method achieves a Precision-Recall AUC of approximately 0.40, significantly outperforming the baseline formulation with a PR-AUC of around 0.06. This represents more than a sixfold improvement in detecting rare events. The results highlight that target design plays a critical role in financial machine learning, often exceeding the impact of model complexity. By incorporating volatility structure into the labeling process, the proposed approach provides a more effective and realistic framework for extreme event detection in high-frequency cryptocurrency markets.

AI.title_translation: 高频金融市场中波动率感知的极端事件检测
AI.tldr: 通过将波动率特征融入预测目标而非仅关注价格变动，该方法在检测高频金融市场极端事件方面的性能提升了六倍以上。
AI.motivation: 高频金融市场具有非平稳性、厚尾分布和严重的类别不平衡特性，使得传统方法难以有效捕捉罕见但具影响力的极端价格变动。
AI.method: 提出一种波动率感知的方法，将预测目标扩展为包含大额未来收益与高波动率机制的组合；采用基于树的模型（XGBoost），结合时间序列交叉验证及考虑数据不平衡的评估方法。
AI.result: 所提方法在极端事件检测上取得了约 0.40 的 PR-AUC，远高于基准方法的 0.06，实现了超过六倍的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了将波动率结构整合到目标设计中，能显著提升高频金融市场中极端事件的检测性能，证明了针对特定市场动态定制目标函数的重要性。
AI.translation: 在高频金融市场中，由于非平稳性、厚尾收益分布和严重的类别不平衡，预测极端价格波动是一项具有挑战性的任务。特别是，罕见但具有影响力的事件往往难以通过传统建模方法检测，因为这些方法通常将极端波动视为孤立的观察结果。本研究提出了一种使用高频比特币限价订单簿（LOB）数据的波动率感知极端事件检测方法。受波动率聚类经验证据的启发，研究将目标定义扩展为包含未来大额收益和高波动率机制。这种重新定义增加了信息样本的比例，并使学习目标与潜在的市场动态保持一致。使用带有时间序列交叉验证和不平衡感知评估的树模型（XGBoost），所提方法实现了约 0.40 的 Precision-Recall AUC，显著优于基准方法（PR-AUC 约为 0.06）。这代表在检测罕见事件方面实现了超过六倍的提升。结果强调了目标设计在金融机器学习中的关键作用，其影响往往超过了模型复杂度的影响。通过将波动率结构纳入标记过程，该方法为高频加密货币市场中的极端事件检测提供了一个更有效且更现实的框架。
AI.summary: 本文针对高频金融市场极端价格波动难以预测的问题，提出了一种波动率感知的方法。通过结合波动率聚类特性重新定义预测目标，不仅增加了信息样本比例，还更符合市场动态。实验证明，该方法在比特币限价订单簿数据上显著优于传统建模方式。
AI.keywords: 极端事件检测, 高频交易, 波动率聚类, 机器学习, 比特币限价订单簿
AI.comments: 该研究强调了在金融机器学习中，目标函数的精心设计（Target Engineering）往往比单纯增加模型复杂度更具决定性意义。通过将波动率聚类特性融入标签设计，有效缓解了极端事件检测中的数据不平衡难题，为处理高频金融数据提供了极具价值的思路。

title: Why Does Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation Fail to Improve Retrieval-Interleaved Search Agents?
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising approach for training large language models without relying on a separate teacher model. However, its effectiveness on complex agentic tasks remains largely unexplored. In this work, we instantiate Feedback-Augmented Self-Distillation (FA-SD), a self-distillation algorithm for agentic search that leverages successful demonstrations as privileged information. We identify that models can rely on recurring reasoning-and-search output templates, producing trajectories that appear diverse but are largely agnostic to the input question, making the KL-based self-distillation signal uninformative. We term this phenomenon decoding collapse, a failure mode that can be missed by existing evaluation metrics. To understand its underlying cause, we show that although the self-teacher achieves stronger performance, learning remains inherently unstable due to inconsistent supervision signals. We further decompose this inconsistency into model inconsistency and prompt inconsistency, and show that the latter can significantly degrade the quality of the supervision signal, limiting the effectiveness of self-teacher learning. To mitigate this inconsistency, we introduce an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher to stabilize the self-teacher and provide more consistent supervision signals. Although the EMA teacher requires a warm-up phase during which performance may temporarily regress, it ultimately improves model performance by providing more stable supervision.

title: COLIP-2: Olfaction-Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: The Contrastive Olfaction-Language-Image Pre-training 2 (COLIP-2) model is a multimodal embeddings space that places olfaction as a first-class citizen among vision and language. Molecular structure, gas-sensor readings, odor-descriptor language, and images are all trained into a single shared representation space, so that a robot can localize a detected aroma to objects in a scene probabilistically. No ImageNet-scale datasets of paired image-scent examples exists which warrants the need for their collection. Our intent with the release of COLIP-2 is to demonstrate the limit of what can be built for robotics with open-sourced olfactory data in order to ground the argument for why new methodologies and datasets are necessary in order to enable advanced olfactory-oriented perception capabilities. We enumerate results from internal testing of the COLIP-2 architecture and make necessary optimizations to run the model at the edge for real-time robotics applications. While developed with robotics in mind, the design of COLIP-2 has been influenced by experts across many disciplines of science in academia and industry, and we hope that the model can be useful in any multimodal domain requiring olfactory intelligence.

AI.title_translation: COLIP-2：嗅觉-视觉-语言嵌入模型
AI.tldr: COLIP-2 是一种将嗅觉纳入视觉和语言多模态空间的新型模型，旨在提升机器人的气味识别与定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态模型缺乏对嗅觉信息的有效整合，且缺乏大规模的嗅觉-视觉配对数据集，限制了机器人嗅觉感知能力的发展。
AI.method: 采用对比学习方法，将分子结构、气体传感器读数、气味描述语言和图像映射到同一个共享的嵌入表示空间中，并针对边缘计算进行了实时优化。
AI.result: 模型实现了将检测到的气味与场景中的物体进行概率定位，并优化了架构以支持在边缘计算设备上进行实时机器人应用。
AI.conclusion: COLIP-2 成功构建了一个共享的多模态表示空间，展示了在机器人中实现嗅觉感知的前景，并强调了未来大规模数据集建设的重要性。
AI.translation: 对比嗅觉-语言-图像预训练 2 (COLIP-2) 模型是一个多模态嵌入空间，它将嗅觉置于与视觉和语言同等的地位。分子结构、气体传感器读数、气味描述语言和图像都被训练到一个单一的共享表示空间中，从而使机器人能够以概率方式将检测到的气味定位到场景中的物体上。由于不存在 ImageNet 规模的图像-气味配对数据集，因此有必要进行此类数据的收集。我们发布 COLIP-2 的目的是展示利用开源嗅觉数据在机器人领域所能达到的极限，从而论证为何需要新的方法和数据集来启用先进的嗅觉导向感知能力。我们列举了 COLIP-2 架构的内部测试结果，并进行了必要的优化，以在边缘端运行模型用于实时机器人应用。虽然 COLIP-2 是为机器人技术而开发的，但其设计受到了学术界和工业界多学科专家的影响，我们希望该模型能够对任何需要嗅觉智能的多模态领域有所帮助。
AI.summary: COLIP-2 是一种新型多模态嵌入模型，通过将分子数据、传感器读数、文本描述和图像整合到统一空间，使机器人能够识别并定位气味来源。该模型旨在推动嗅觉感知技术的发展，并为边缘端实时应用提供了优化方案。
AI.keywords: 多模态嵌入, 嗅觉感知, 机器人技术, 对比学习, 传感器融合
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的多模态嵌入框架，将嗅觉与视觉、语言同等对待，为机器人感知领域填补了关键空白。其局限在于目前缺乏大规模的嗅觉-视觉配对数据集，该工作更多起到引领和示范作用，呼吁学术界关注嗅觉感知数据集的构建。

title: Reinforcement Learning: From Algorithms To Foundation Models
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for sequential decision making under explicit objectives. In its classical form, RL studies how an agent should act to maximise long-term reward in a dynamic environment. In richer settings, the problem extends beyond a single agent and fixed environment: intelligent behavior may require strategic interaction, adaptation to uncertainty, and reasoning over high-dimensional worlds. This thesis studies RL from two perspectives: algorithms in games and RL in the era of foundation models.
  The first part focuses on multi-agent RL in games. It examines how incentives, policies, and equilibrium concepts interact in competitive and general-sum environments, spanning two-player zero-sum games, large-scale video games, and multi-player settings with general structure. These works investigate learning in multi-agent systems and the behavior of RL methods in interactive environments. The second part studies RL with generative and foundation models, motivated by the idea that prior knowledge can enrich sequential decision making. Pretrained generative models and learned world models serve as representation tools and structured priors for planning, control, and policy optimization. The thesis develops diffusion-based world models, investigates RL for efficient video generation, explores generative models as policy classes, and studies interactive video world models in which actions shape future observations. It also addresses long-horizon modeling through architectures with memory. Together, these contributions present a unified view of RL as objective-driven adaptation in complex sequential domains. From strategic games to generative world models, the thesis highlights how RL connects decision making, environment modeling, and emerging foundation-model capabilities, offering a broader perspective on the principles underlying intelligent behavior.

AI.title_translation: 强化学习：从算法到基础模型
AI.tldr: 本文通过结合多智能体博弈分析与生成式基础模型，提出了一种将强化学习作为复杂环境目标驱动适应的统一框架，展示了如何利用先验知识提升决策智能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决强化学习在面对战略交互、环境不确定性以及高维世界建模时的挑战，并探索如何利用基础模型中的先验知识来增强强化学习在复杂序列决策中的能力。
AI.method: 该研究采用双重路径：第一部分利用博弈论分析多智能体强化学习中的激励、策略与均衡；第二部分利用预训练生成模型和基于扩散的世界模型作为先验知识，改进规划、控制和策略优化，并探索了长序列记忆架构。
AI.result: 研究表明，将生成式基础模型与强化学习集成，能够有效提升智能体在复杂交互环境中的适应能力，并为长期任务建模提供了高效的视频生成与策略优化手段。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一种将强化学习视为复杂序列领域中目标驱动适应的统一视角，证明了通过结合生成式基础模型，可以显著增强强化学习在处理复杂环境和长期决策时的表现。
AI.translation:
强化学习（RL）为显式目标下的序列决策提供了一个框架。在其经典形式中，RL研究智能体应如何行动以最大化动态环境中的长期奖励。在更丰富的设置中，问题超出了单一智能体和固定环境的范畴：智能行为可能需要战略交互、对不确定性的适应以及对高维世界的推理。本论文从两个角度研究RL：游戏中的算法以及基础模型时代的RL。
第一部分侧重于游戏中的多智能体RL。它研究了激励、策略和均衡概念如何在竞争和一般和环境中相互作用，涵盖了双人零和博弈、大规模视频游戏以及具有一般结构的多人设置。这些工作调查了多智能体系统中的学习以及RL方法在交互环境中的行为。第二部分研究了带有生成模型和基础模型的RL，其动机是先验知识可以丰富序列决策。预训练生成模型和学习到的世界模型可作为规划、控制和策略优化的表示工具和结构化先验。本论文开发了基于扩散的世界模型，研究了用于高效视频生成的RL，探索了作为策略类别的生成模型，并研究了行动可以塑造未来观察的交互式视频世界模型。它还通过具有记忆的架构解决了长程建模问题。总的来说，这些贡献提出了一个统一的观点，即RL是复杂序列领域中目标驱动的适应。从战略游戏到生成世界模型，本论文强调了RL如何连接决策、环境建模和新兴的基础模型能力，为理解智能行为背后的原则提供了更广阔的视角。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了强化学习从传统算法到基础模型的发展。论文分为两部分：一是分析多智能体博弈中的策略与均衡；二是研究如何利用生成式模型和世界模型作为先验，提升强化学习在复杂环境中的决策、规划与长序列建模能力，从而构建了目标驱动适应的统一理论框架。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 基础模型, 多智能体系统, 世界模型, 序列决策
AI.comments: 该论文通过将传统强化学习与现代生成式基础模型相结合，探索了智能决策的新范式。其创新之处在于将世界模型、扩散模型等生成式技术引入强化学习框架，为解决复杂序列决策问题提供了新思路。论文涵盖了从博弈论到生成式建模的广泛领域，具有重要的学术价值。

title: Self-Directed Spectrum Allocation Framework for Integrated TN-NTN 6G Networks
comments: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE 17th International Conference on Ubiquitous and Future Networks (ICUFN 2026)
summary: This paper proposes a self-adaptive channel assignment framework based on Q-learning, where agents learn optimal policies by observing network load, interference conditions, and temporal traffic dynamics within a Markov decision process (MDP). A multi-objective reward function is designed to jointly optimize system throughput, user fairness, and interference mitigation, while an ε-greedy strategy is employed to facilitate effective exploration. Simulation results demonstrate stable convergence, achieving an average reward of 37.5 and an average throughput of 28.5 Mbps. Moreover, the proposed approach achieves a Jain's fairness index of 0.75 and reduces interference by 26.3% compared to random allocation by adaptively responding to dynamic traffic patterns.
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the IEEE 17th International Conference on Ubiquitous and Future Networks (ICUFN 2026)

title: FlexiGrad: Adaptive Gradient Modulation for Hierarchical Fine-Grained Classification
summary: Many fine-grained recognition tasks contain hierarchical labels such as order, family and species. Although this supervision should be beneficial, jointly optimising all levels often leads to unstable training because coarse and fine classifiers impose inconsistent gradients on the shared backbone. This hierarchical gradient conflict prevents the model from learning a coherent coarse-to-fine representation. In this paper, we propose FlexiGrad, a simple and parameter-free method that regulates gradient interactions during backpropagation. FlexiGrad removes only the harmful conflicting component when tasks disagree and reinforces the shared direction when they partially agree through a smooth hierarchy-aware weighting function. This produces stable optimisation and preserves both global structure and fine-grained discriminative cues. FlexiGrad integrates into existing architectures without modification while improves multi-granularity accuracy on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft and Stanford Cars. The code will be available at PRIS-CV/FlexiGrad.

title: ZifaMem: Structured Memory for Persona, Preference, and Emotional Continuity in AI Companions
summary: AI companions are judged not only by single-turn fluency but by whether they sustain emotional continuity: remembering who the companion is, what the user prefers, and how the relationship has felt. We present ZifaMem, a structured memory system that organizes dialogue into session summaries, episodic memories, and a consolidated user model. Against a deployment-honest comparator that supplies the full raw dialogue history, and under a fixed LLM-as-a-judge protocol with route audits, structured memory raises pooled four-backbone emotional-intelligence scores by 11.4% (95% CI 6.3% to 17.1%), and persona grounding improves on all four backbones (Claude +42% relative). Multi-turn affect context wins a +39% net preference over a single-turn snapshot (exploratory), whereas an additional emotion state machine yields no measurable gain on any of five endpoints. Under an identical preregistered protocol, three memory systems (ZifaMem, Mem0, and filtered verbatim retrieval) each improve significantly over raw-history deployment, and ZifaMem and Mem0 are statistically equivalent within +/-5 points on the preregistered primary preference endpoint. The ZifaMem SDK, CLI, and portable Agent Skills are open-sourced at https://github.com/zifacorp/zifamem.

title: Topology-Aware Propagation-Based Assessment of Extreme-Weather Impacts on Distribution System Resilience
summary: Extreme weather events and the increasing integration of distributed energy resources (DERs) introduce growing uncertainty and resilience challenges for distribution systems. Unlike conventional deterministic contingencies, weather-driven disruptions exhibit probabilistic and spatial-temporal characteristics, where outage consequences depend on both geographic exposure and feeder topology. Existing approaches commonly focus on deterministic outage analysis, while topology-aware operational impact assessment under forecast uncertainty remains limited. This paper proposes an event-conditioned uncertainty modeling and topology-aware impact propagation framework for distribution systems under torrential rain events. The proposed framework integrates probabilistic event-track modeling, branch-level fault screening, downstream impact propagation analysis, and operational impact assessment within a unified workflow. Finally, case studies on the IEEE 33-bus distribution feeder demonstrate that the proposed framework can distinguish geographic exposure from topology-dependent operational impacts and support progressive early-warning impact assessment under uncertain scenarios. Furthermore, the impact zones are visualized on the CURENT Large-scale Testbed (LTB)-AGVis platform.

title: CoCurve: Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature for Training-Free Structured LLM Pruning
summary: Structured pruning compresses large language models (LLMs) by removing whole computational units, such as attention heads and feed-forward (FFN) channel groups. Most training-free methods, however, rank these units independently, implicitly treating the loss from pruning a set as the sum of its individual losses. This view fails for Transformers, whose sublayers are coupled through a shared residual stream. Two individually weak units can thus be jointly indispensable, yet independent scoring is blind to such dependence and removes them together. We introduce CoCurve (Cross-Module Co-Pruning Curvature), a calibration-only, fine-tuning-free method that prunes attention and FFN units jointly. A second-order Taylor expansion of the token-level KL between the frozen model and its masked copy yields a single Fisher matrix whose diagonal is classical node saliency and whose off-diagonal entries are co-pruning curvature edges: the extra damage of removing two units together. Under a single-ablation additivity approximation this matrix reduces to a Gram product of single-unit ablation features, so the full M x M interaction is recovered from M forward passes, with no pairwise sweeps or gradients. Pruning then reduces to one budgeted quadratic program, solved in a single shot under a shared attention--FFN budget, with no labels, fine-tuning, or recovery.

title: Cross-Domain Acceleration of Open Modification Search: From Commodity Platforms to Emerging Memory and Storage Devices
comments: Accepted manuscript. Published in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems (JETCAS), Early Access, 2026. Sumukh Pinge and Chang Eun Song are co-first authors and contributed equally to this work
summary: Open modification search (OMS) in mass spectrometry (MS) is a data-intensive workload whose performance is dominantly limited by reference data movement rather than computation. Prior OMS accelerators have largely been evaluated in isolation, making it difficult to understand system-level trade-offs across platforms. This paper presents the first workload-driven, cross-platform survey of accelerators for MS search by studying not only commodity platforms, but also emerging memory- and storage-centric architectures, including GPUs, near-storage FPGAs, DRAM near-memory processing, ReRAM/PCM in-memory processing, and 3D NAND/FeNAND in-storage processing, under consistent algorithmic and accuracy assumptions. Leveraging a binary hyperdimensional computing (HDC)-based OMS formulation that reduces similarity evaluation to lightweight bitwise primitives and tolerates device-level non-idealities, we enable a robust execution on memory-centric architectures despite device-level non-idealities and limited computing capability. Overall, this study identifies memory- and storage-centric architectures as a key architectural breakthrough for large-scale, high-speed search acceleration, delivering up to >100x speedup and >40,000x improvement in energy efficiency.
comment: Accepted manuscript. Published in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems (JETCAS), Early Access, 2026. Sumukh Pinge and Chang Eun Song are co-first authors and contributed equally to this work

title: A Weisfeiler-Leman Characterization of Global-Attention Graph Transformers for Mixed-Integer Linear Programs
comments: Accepted to Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) 2026 (20 pages, 10 figures) [Lightning Oral Presentation]
summary: Graph foundation models (GFMs) with global attention are increasingly used to represent mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), aiming to capture structure beyond the locality of standard graph neural networks. We study their expressive power through graph isomorphism testing, asking which MILP instances they map to identical representations. We prove that a broad class of hierarchical graph transformers combining global linear attention, edge-weighted cross-attention, and bipartite message passing is bounded by the one-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test: under any parameter setting, 1-WL-equivalent MILP graphs receive identical graph embeddings. Our compositional proof shows that each architectural component is a symmetric multiset function and thus preserves 1-WL equivalence. We validate this characterization across ten diverse graph encoders, including Graphormer-, GraphGPS-, Set-Transformer-, and Gasse-style models. Across model capacities, graph scales, and pooling operators, every tested encoder maps 1-WL-equivalent non-isomorphic graph pairs to numerically identical embeddings. Consequently, graph invariants that vary within a 1-WL equivalence class cannot be recovered from these representations. We further show that expressiveness beyond 1-WL arises from input encoding rather than attention: random-walk positional encodings separate the constructed pairs, while additional constructions expose the limits of this remedy. These results characterize the expressive power of global-attention GFMs and provide an encoder-agnostic diagnostic for detecting 1-WL-induced representation equivalence.
comment: Accepted to Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) 2026 (20 pages, 10 figures) [Lightning Oral Presentation]

title: Terascale Query Processing in the Browser: Rethinking GPU Acceleration
summary: Recursive query computation, central to graph algorithms and relational databases, demands GPU acceleration due to its inherent computational intensity. While substantial prior work addresses GPU implementations of recursive queries that require fixed-point evaluation, existing systems are restricted to native execution environments. We introduce WGLog, the first web-browser-native GPU engine for compute-bound recursive database queries. WGLog is built entirely on WebGPU compute shaders, a cross-platform API that enables GPU acceleration in web browsers. WGLog leverages two key technical innovations. First, we replace hash-table-based joins with atomic-free sorted-array joins, eliminating the serialization bottleneck that hash tables suffer on skewed graphs. Second, we develop an asynchronous execution pipeline using WebGPU's indirect dispatch capability, which eliminates GPU-host synchronizations that would otherwise dominate per-iteration overhead. On representative workloads, WGLog delivers a 1.48--4.68x speedup over native GPU systems and orders-of-magnitude improvement over CPU and WebAssembly implementations.

title: AGG: Jacobian-Aggregated Group Gradient for Efficient GRPO Training of Diffusion Models
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a powerful reinforcement learning algorithm for aligning generative models with human preferences. While successful in large language models~\cite{shao2024deepseekmathpushinglimitsmathematical}, its extension to diffusion and flow matching models introduces a severe computational bottleneck: gradients must be back-propagated through the high-capacity DiT backbone at \emph{every} timestep of the sampling trajectory, making high-resolution text-to-image (T2I) training prohibitively expensive. Training-free DiT inference acceleration methods (e.g., $Δ$-DiT, ScalingCache) exploit the fact that DiT hidden states and velocity predictions vary \emph{smoothly and nearly linearly} along the trajectory. We ask whether the same linearity can reduce the backward-pass cost of DiT RL training, and answer affirmatively with \textbf{JAGG} (\textbf{J}acobian-\textbf{A}ggregated \textbf{G}roup \textbf{G}radient), which reduces full transformer backward passes from $W$ to $2$ per group of $W$ consecutive steps. JAGG approximates intermediate-step Jacobians via $t$-weighted interpolation of the endpoint Jacobians, then aggregates per-step upstream signals into two composite gradients applied through a single joint backward pass. We prove this interpolation is \emph{exact} when the velocity is linear in $(z,t)$, and a cosine-similarity routing rule (\texttt{jagg\_frac}) deploys JAGG only where the assumption holds. Experiments on T2I benchmarks show JAGG delivers $\sim$2$\times$ backward speedup with negligible quality degradation.

title: Quantum-Resilient Banking Transaction Security using DW-HKEM: A Hybrid RSA/ML-KEM Cryptographic Gateway with Real-Time
summary: The increasing number of online banking and financial services on public-facing networks has caused security of cryptographic protocols to become a serious, systemic problem. RSA-2048 is the key length that is used in the majority of transactions that travel over the Internet every day. A very insidious threat vector, the Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) paradigm, is already in existence with the adversarial nation-state actors and well-funded threat actors. The exposure window is not a time in the future it is the NOW moment! Quantum computation is a certain threat to the current public-key cryptographic infrastructure, and one that is moving ever closer. In this paper, the authors take up both of these challenges, designing, implementing and testing an integrated system based on a Dual-Wrap Hybrid Key Encapsulation Mechanism (DW-HKEM) and a live cryptographic analytics dashboard. Both the RSA-256 and ML-KEM-768 are hosted within the DW-HKEM framework and an AES-256 session key is wrapped in each of them, with a composite key created using a Key Derivation Function based on SHA-256, resulting in combinatorial security against classical and quantum adversaries and backwards compatibility with existing banking systems. The CryptoX real-time dashboard offers time tracking for each operation, session-level analytics and visualization of performance trends for immediate use in enterprise banking security operations. The results from empirical benchmarking across 100 independent iterations show a total overhead of about 1.58ms, which is well within the enterprise deployment threshold, proving the architecture viable as a practical, scalable reference for the financial-sector's cryptographic infrastructure and applications to move to a post-quantum era. We also provide complete source code of the work carried out.

title: Predictive Training with Latent Imagination for Visual Quadruped Navigation
summary: Reinforcement-learning navigation policies for legged robots select actions reactively from current observations and short-term memory, with limited capacity to anticipate how moving obstacles will evolve in the near future. In dynamic environments, this reactivity causes the robot to respond too late because collision risk depends on short-horizon scene structure rather than on current obstacle positions alone. Lightweight predictive supervision applied to the policy's recurrent state during training can encode anticipatory obstacle dynamics without modifying the inference-time controller. We augment a reactive LSTM-SRU navigation backbone with an auxiliary JEPA-style predictor and SIGReg regularization: during training, the predictor supervises the deterministic hidden state to anticipate its own next state; at inference, it is fully discarded, incurring zero additional computational cost. On simulated and real-world navigation benchmarks with dynamic obstacles, our method substantially improves navigation success while reducing collision rates through the predictive training signal alone, without additional inference-time parameters. Real-robot deployment on a Unitree Go2 demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer: the controller navigates cluttered indoor and dynamic outdoor environments without fine-tuning, with evasive behavior consistent with the collision reduction observed in simulation.

title: A Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning Framework for LLM Guardrails
summary: We propose ARBITER, a novel LLM guardrail framework that introduces two key ideas: (i) dual-hypothesis reasoning, a reasoning method for LLM guardrails that explicitly considers both safe and unsafe interpretations of a prompt before making a safety decision, and (ii) multi-component supervised fine-tuning (MC-SFT), a structured training loss for reasoning-based guardrails that decomposes LLM outputs into logical components and weights them according to their importance. Existing reasoning-based guardrails often rely on expensive procedures, such as generating reasoning traces using larger or closed-source teacher models and applying full-parameter fine-tuning. In contrast, ARBITER uses a cost-effective self-generation strategy for reasoning traces and LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning while still achieving better performance than these expensive approaches. Additionally, ARBITER provides faithful evidence-phrase explanations for unsafe decisions, enabling a more transparent and interpretable guardrail method. Experiments on three safety moderation benchmarks show that ARBITER outperforms existing reasoning-based and non-reasoning guardrail baselines, with clear gains in out-of-domain evaluations.

title: pyHB: an open-source automatic-differentiation-enhanced semi-analytical solver for nonlinear dynamics
summary: The Harmonic Balance (HB) method is widely used to compute and analyze the periodic responses of nonlinear systems. However, its application to high-dimensional complex systems is limited by the burden of handling the partial derivatives of the nonlinearities. This work presents pyHB, an open-source, automatic-differentiation-enhanced semi-analytical framework that integrates the complete HB workflow for general user-defined nonlinear systems. The proposed formulation exploits localized nonlinearities and applies PyTorch-based automatic differentiation (AD) only to the reduced nonlinear force, thereby avoiding the need for user-supplied derivatives of the nonlinear force and maintaining controllable GPU memory usage. Weighted arc-length continuation, sparse matrix assembly, a blocked solution strategy for the augmented continuation equations, and Floquet-based stability analysis are incorporated within a modular architecture that separates model definition from reusable numerical procedures. Hence, pyHB can provide a complete landscape of the nonlinear system's periodic response based solely on the user-defined dynamical equations. Four examples, including a quasi-zero-stiffness isolator, a nonlinear piezoelectric energy harvester, a 284 degrees of freedom (DOFs) aeroengine model, and a 2000 DOFs Bernoulli beam, demonstrate the ability of pyHB to trace stable and unstable solution branches and capture subharmonic resonance, combination resonance, and mixed-order electromechanical responses. Notably, in the Bernoulli beam example with 202000 HB unknowns, the AD-enhanced solver requires approximately 0.44s per continuation point, achieving several-hundred-fold speedup compared to the Newmark-$β$ method and remaining 637.8MB of additional RAM and 243.5MB of GPU memory. The proposed pyHB provides a general, one-stop benchmark platform for HB-based nonlinear dynamics analysis.

title: Scalable Model-Assisted Multi-Target Estimation in Large Image Collections
comments: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
summary: Computer vision models are increasingly used as measurement tools to estimate population-level quantities from large image collections, but prediction errors introduce bias and the resulting estimates lack statistical guarantees required in scientific applications. Prior work uses a Monte Carlo framework to combine model predictions with ground-truth annotations by sampling some images for humans to label and is able to provide unbiased estimates with controllable accuracy, but primarily addresses single-scalar estimation. We study the more general problem of multi-target estimation, where many quantities (e.g., class counts or proportions) must be estimated simultaneously, and adapt sampling and estimation strategies from survey sampling to this setting. Evaluations on five detection and segmentation datasets with 7-80 classes show that importance sampling excels with moderate annotation budgets or fewer targets, whereas uniform sampling with control variates is superior when estimating many targets or operating with minimal labels. Additionally, a subset-based ratio estimator remains highly competitive across all regimes. Ultimately, our framework effectively combines biased model predictions and limited human labels into rigorous scientific measurements.
comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)

title: ANNLib: A Development Framework for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
summary: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) plays a pivotal role in modern deep learning pipelines. Recently, many ANNS systems have been proposed to either provide broad functionality or reach high performance. However, it is yet difficult to achieve both with minimal programming efforts. We propose ANNLib to address the gap. ANNLib is a library that provides a programming framework for achieving high performance and flexible functionality in ANNS systems, based on popular graph-based ANNS algorithms. We carefully decouple and independently optimize both the algorithm and the data structure components of an ANNS system. In addition, we integrate state-of-the-art algorithms and data structures into ANNLib as modules, along with our new designs. Users can choose combinations of components to implement sophisticated settings with high performance, such as filter search, fully dynamic updates, and historical queries on snapshots. Our experiments show that our new solution provides a simple interface for various applications and achieves comparable or even better performance than previous work, specifically for each application.

title: Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
summary: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable efficient high-resolution image synthesis by denoising in a VAE-compressed latent space. However, fixed visual tokenizers can discard fine textures and structural details, while separate representation and diffusion training creates a mismatch between reconstruction and generation objectives. These limitations have renewed interest in pixel-space diffusion, which models raw pixels directly, removes the VAE bottleneck, and supports end-to-end optimization. This formulation better matches the demands of high-fidelity generation but introduces challenges in high-dimensional modeling, including noise scheduling, loss weighting, token efficiency, and scalable architecture design. Pixel-space modeling also offers a promising basis for unified multimodal systems: raw pixels, text, and task conditions can be represented in a shared token space and jointly processed by a single Transformer, narrowing the gap between visual understanding and generation. This paper reviews Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers (pDiTs) from the perspectives of model architecture, continuous generative mechanisms, and unified multimodal modeling. We summarize representative methods, identify key technical challenges, and discuss future directions toward high-fidelity, end-to-end vision foundation models that integrate generation and understanding.

title: Detection, Attribution, Narration: An End-to-End Pipeline for Explainable Money Mule Identification
summary: Money mule accounts are critical facilitators of financial fraud, yet detecting them at scale remains challenging due to the heterogeneous nature of transactional and behavioural data. We present an end-to-end pipeline for customer-level mule detection comprising three stages: (1) a LightGBM classifier trained on 280 engineered features spanning transaction patterns, account demographics, network topology, and temporal behaviour; (2) a TreeSHAP attribution layer that decomposes each prediction into feature contributions; and (3) a large language model (LLM) module that converts SHAP attributions into analyst-facing natural-language narratives. We evaluate across three open-weight LLM families and assess explanation quality through analyst feedback. In a live production deployment, the system achieves a yield rate of 89%, up from 61% under the incumbent rule-based system, with monthly alert volume expanding from 211 to 302, reflecting broader true-positive coverage rather than increased noise. This corresponds to a 60% incremental adverse detection beyond existing review workflows, substantially outperforming the rule-based approach. Qualitative feedback from analysts indicates that LLM-generated narratives reduce cognitive load during alert triage. We further discuss implications of deploying LLM-augmented explainability in regulated financial environments.

title: Faster and simpler traversal of 0/1-polytopes
summary: Recently, Merino and Mütze (FOCS'23+SICOMP'24) presented an algorithm for computing a Hamilton path on the skeleton of any 0/1-polytope ${\rm conv}(X)$, where $X\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$. The algorithm uses as a black box an algorithm for solving the classical linear optimization problem $\min\{w\cdot x\mid x\in X\}$ for some weight vector $w\in\mathbb{R}^n$. The resulting delay per visited vertex on the Hamilton path is only by a $\log n$ factor larger than the time to solve one instance of the optimization algorithm. In this paper, we make the Hamilton path algorithm simpler and faster. Namely, we obtain an amortized delay that is only by a constant factor larger than the running time of the optimization algorithm, thus removing the $\log n$ factor. As concrete results, this yields improved algorithms for generating bases and independent sets in a matroid, spanning trees, forests, matchings and maximum matchings in a graph, vertex covers, minimum vertex covers, independent sets and maximum independent sets in a bipartite graph, and antichains, maximum antichains and ideals in a poset. All of these listings correspond to Hamilton paths on the corresponding polytopes. Furthermore, we obtain an $\mathcal{O}(t_{\rm LP})$ amortized delay algorithm for the vertex enumeration problem on 0/1-polytopes $\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n\mid Ax\leq b\}$, where $A\in \mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ and $b\in\mathbb{R}^m$, and $t_{\rm LP}$ is the time needed to solve the linear program $\min\{w\cdot x\mid Ax\leq b\}$. This improves upon the $\mathcal{O}(t_{\rm LP} \log n)$ delay algorithm of Merino and Mütze, and the previous $\mathcal{O}(t_{\rm LP}\,n)$ delay algorithm of Bussieck and Lübbecke from 1998.

title: SSTMark: Robust Training-Free Semantic-Level Speech Watermarking
summary: As speech generation models become increasingly realistic and widely accessible, concerns about the misuse, attribution, and governance of synthetic speech continue to grow. Watermarking provides a practical way to make synthesized speech traceable and verifiable. Most existing speech watermarking methods embed watermark information into signal-level representations, such as waveforms or spectrograms. Under sufficiently strong distortions, the embedded watermark may be weakened or destroyed, leading to degraded detectability. In this paper, we propose SSTMark, a training-free speech watermarking framework that operates at the semantic level through text watermarking. Unlike conventional signal-level watermarking methods, SSTMark encodes watermark information into the semantic content conveyed by generated speech, and detects the watermark from the recovered linguistic content. Experiments on AudioMarkBench demonstrate that SSTMark exhibits the strongest average robustness. Compared with the state-of-the-art baselines at a fixed false positive rate of 1\%, SSTMark improves the average detection rate by 4.6\% and 16.9\% on signal-processing edits and compression edits, respectively.

title: Miles: Metric Learning with Expandable Subspace for Pre-Trained Model-Based Class-Incremental Learning
comments: This work has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Class Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new concepts consistently from a data stream without forgetting. Unlike typical CIL methods which need to learn a model from scratch, pre-trained model (PTM) can easily adapt to a new task with fine-tuning. However, existing PTM-based CIL methods fail to achieve a trade-off between performance and computational expenditure, i.e., they either adopt the same parameter space so that leading catastrophic forgetting, or expand a new branch for each task but adding more computational cost. To this end, we propose MetrIc Learning with Expandable Subspace (Miles) to harness the prior information within pre-trained knowledge, thereby orchestrating an efficient expansion of the parameter space through guided optimization. Specifically, it decouples the learnable modules with the pre-trained model, exploiting prior information from intermediate features of the backbone network to enable more flexible parameter expansion. Then, a central loss is adopted to guide the new category to cluster towards the corresponding prototype in the new task subspace while incorporating an auxiliary distance regularization term to maintain metric equilibrium across tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that Miles achieves state-of-the-art performance in various CIL settings.
comment: This work has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing

title: Concentration and Mean-Square Bounds for Contractive Stochastic Approximation: A Unified Elementary Approach
comments: Submitted to Stochastic Processes and their Applications
summary: We establish mean-square and concentration bounds for stochastic approximation (SA) with arbitrary norm contractive mappings, under a multiplicative noise model where the noise may scale affinely with the norm of the iterates, and the iterates are potentially unbounded. These settings arise in reinforcement learning, where operators are often contractive in the $\ell_\infty$ norm and the noise scales with the iterates. To address the arbitrary norm, earlier works replace the non-smooth squared norm with a smooth Lyapunov function constructed via the generalized Moreau envelope. For concentration analysis, these works handle multiplicative noise and unbounded iterates through a multi-stage bootstrapping argument that starts from a time-varying worst-case bound and iteratively refines it. We instead present a unified and elementary analysis that yields both bounds. Using an averaged noise sequence and corresponding auxiliary iterates, we obtain a one-step Lyapunov drift inequality for the normed error directly, without smoothing the norm or constructing an envelope. For the mean-square bound, we combine this drift inequality with an induction argument showing that the iterates remain bounded in expectation. For the concentration bound, we develop a probabilistic induction over a sequence of "good" events on which the iterates are controlled, allowing the standard Azuma-Hoeffding bound to be applied. Our approach yields the first sub-Gaussian tailed maximal (all-time) concentration bound for SA under multiplicative noise, by allowing the stepsize to depend logarithmically on the confidence level. Beyond the specific setting considered here, we discuss the generalizability of these proof techniques to other noise models and iterative algorithms.
comment: Submitted to Stochastic Processes and their Applications

title: Is Progressive Disclosure All You Need for Long-Context Agents?
summary: Long-document question answering usually forces a choice between loading the whole document into the context window and bolting on a separate retriever. Agentic AI suggests a broader option, giving the agent the document path and letting it decide how and what to read. Agent Skills, a standard for packaging expertise into folders an agent loads on demand, supply a ready mechanism: progressive disclosure, which exposes only what a query needs, from a short description down to the specific passages. Practitioners rapidly adopted this pattern for book-length understanding tasks, but the evidence to support such choices has been anecdotal. We run the first controlled study of the pattern, comparing raw-document navigation and several designs of Agent Skills packs against a classical hybrid retriever across three agent harnesses and three model families on InfiniteBench. On a single book, the gain depends on the harness, running large when the agent navigates the raw document poorly but near zero when a strong agent harness already divides and retrieves on its own.
