AI.comments: 该论文集是逻辑编程领域的重要文献，全面展示了该领域的最新研究进展和方向。

title: LaT: LLM-as-Trainer for Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Solvers
summary: Multi-task neural solvers aim to handle multiple Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) variants within a unified model, avoiding separate training for each constraint combination. However, VRP variants differ in optimization difficulty, while existing methods lack stage-wise feedback on their training status, making the model biased to some specific variants. Although meta-learning can support adaptive training, it typically requires bi-level optimization and additional gradient updates, increasing computational cost. To address this limitation, we propose LLM-as-Trainer (LaT), a plug-and-play training paradigm that uses a pretrained large language model as an external trainer. LaT periodically analyzes cross-task validation metrics to generate a stage-wise guidance vector. This vector is combined with the current task's constraint vector and injected into each encoder layer, providing the neural solver with additional training information during subsequent policy optimization. Experiments on 16 VRP variants show that LaT improves the solution quality of several state-of-the-art multi-task neural solvers on both trained and unseen variants, supporting the effectiveness and generality of the proposed training paradigm.

AI.title_translation: LaT：LLM即训练器，用于多任务车辆路径规划求解器
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为LLM-as-Trainer (LaT) 的新颖训练范式，利用大型语言模型作为外部训练器，通过分析跨任务验证指标来生成阶段性指导向量，以改进多任务车辆路径规划（VRP）求解器的训练，解决了现有方法在处理不同优化难度和缺乏阶段性反馈的问题，实验证明LaT能提升求解器在已知和未知VRP变体上的解题质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的多任务神经求解器在处理不同优化难度和缺乏阶段性反馈方面存在不足，导致模型偏向某些特定变体。元学习虽然能支持自适应训练，但计算成本高。
AI.method: 提出LLM-as-Trainer (LaT) 训练范式，使用预训练的大型语言模型作为外部训练器，周期性地分析跨任务验证指标，生成阶段性指导向量，并将其与当前任务的约束向量结合，注入到编码器层，为神经求解器提供额外的训练信息。
AI.result: 在16种VRP变体上的实验表明，LaT能够提高最先进的多任务神经求解器在已训练和未训练变体上的解题质量。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-Trainer (LaT) 是一种有效且通用的即插即用训练范式，能够通过提供阶段性指导来改进多任务车辆路径规划求解器的训练。
AI.translation: 多任务神经求解器旨在通过统一的模型处理多种车辆路径问题（VRP）变体，避免为每种约束组合单独训练。然而，VRP变体的优化难度各不相同，而现有方法缺乏对其训练状态的阶段性反馈，导致模型偏向某些特定变体。尽管元学习可以支持自适应训练，但通常需要双层优化和额外的梯度更新，增加了计算成本。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了LLM-as-Trainer (LaT)，一种即插即用的训练范式，它使用预训练的大型语言模型作为外部训练器。LaT周期性地分析跨任务验证指标，生成一个阶段性指导向量。该向量与当前任务的约束向量相结合，并注入到每个编码器层，在随后的策略优化过程中为神经求解器提供额外的训练信息。在16种VRP变体上的实验表明，LaT在已训练和未训练的变体上都提高了几种最先进的多任务神经求解器的求解质量，证明了所提出的训练范式的有效性和通用性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为LLM-as-Trainer (LaT) 的新训练范式，旨在解决多任务车辆路径规划（VRP）求解器在处理不同优化难度和缺乏阶段性反馈的问题。LaT利用预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）作为外部训练器，通过分析跨任务验证指标生成阶段性指导向量，并将其整合到神经求解器的训练过程中。实验结果表明，LaT能够显著提升求解器在多种VRP变体上的性能，无论这些变体是否在训练中出现过，证明了该方法的有效性和通用性。
AI.keywords: LLM-as-Trainer, 多任务车辆路径规划, 神经求解器, 阶段性指导, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种新颖的利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为“训练器”的范式（LaT），以解决多任务车辆路径规划（VRP）求解器训练中的关键挑战，即如何有效地处理不同变体的优化难度和提供阶段性训练反馈。通过将LLM的分析能力应用于跨任务指标，LaT能够生成指导信号，帮助神经求解器进行更优化的策略学习。这种方法避免了传统元学习的高昂计算成本，并展现出良好的通用性和有效性，尤其是在处理未见过的问题变体方面。该研究的创新性在于将LLM的能力从生成任务扩展到模型训练的辅助角色，为神经组合优化领域提供了一种新的思路。未来的工作可以探索不同类型的指标分析和指导信号生成方式，以及将LaT应用于更广泛的多任务学习场景。

title: Planning with Transformers: Chain of Computation and Structured Context Windows
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have had a remarkable impact across many areas of machine learning. However, recent studies have shown that they struggle to reliably solve planning problems. At the same time, theoretical results have shown that transformers, the core architecture underlying modern LLMs, are Turing-complete. In this work, we investigate this apparent gap between the theoretical computational power of LLMs and their empirical planning performance. We propose Chain of Computation (COC), a computational architecture that places a transformer-based LM inside an iterative loop, leveraging its strength as a pattern-matching system. The COC uses a Structured Context Window (SCW) which provides a constant-sized context window with support for choosing which window is used at each planning step. Within this architecture, the LM is able to learn a planning policy, predicts the world model, and performs the arithmetic operations required during planning. We show that, when given an append-only SCW (resembling a Turing Machine tape), even relatively small LMs trained from scratch can learn planning policies and generalize from a small number of training instances within each planning domain, achieving success rates above 99.89\% on BlocksWorld and the Pancake puzzle. Our analysis of failure cases in Tower of Hanoi (TOH) reveals that they arise from arithmetic operations or from encountering previously unseen tokens. We show that COC can solve TOH problem instances with up to 20 disks, requiring over 1 million actions, while requiring substantially less training data by either (1) planning with symbolical support for arithmetic or by (2) using a deterministic pushdown automaton (PDA) formulation for the SCW.

AI.title_translation: 基于 Transformer 的规划：计算链与结构化上下文窗口
AI.tldr: 通过将 Transformer 置于迭代循环并引入结构化上下文窗口，该研究使模型能够高效解决复杂的规划任务，并在多个测试中达到 99.89% 以上的成功率。
AI.motivation: 尽管 Transformer 在理论上是图灵完备的，但在处理复杂的规划问题时表现不佳，研究旨在弥合这一理论能力与实际性能之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出 Chain of Computation (COC) 架构，将 Transformer 置于迭代循环中；引入 Structured Context Window (SCW) 提供可选择的常量大小上下文窗口，并结合符号化算术支持或确定性下推自动机（PDA）实现规划。
AI.result: 在 BlocksWorld 和 Pancake 拼图任务中成功率超过 99.89%；能够解决涉及超过 100 万个动作的 20 盘 Tower of Hanoi 问题，且显著降低了对训练数据的需求。
AI.conclusion: Chain of Computation (COC) 架构通过迭代循环和结构化上下文窗口，显著提升了Transformer模型在复杂规划任务中的表现，证明了即使是小型模型也能通过适当的架构设计实现高效的规划与逻辑推理。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在机器学习的许多领域产生了显著影响。然而，最近的研究表明它们难以可靠地解决规划问题。与此同时，理论结果表明，作为现代 LLMs 核心架构的 Transformer 是图灵完备的。在这项工作中，我们研究了 LLMs 的理论计算能力与其经验规划性能之间的明显差距。我们提出了计算链（COC），这是一种将基于 Transformer 的语言模型置于迭代循环中的计算架构，利用其作为模式匹配系统的优势。COC 使用结构化上下文窗口（SCW），它提供了一个固定大小的上下文窗口，并支持在每个规划步骤中选择使用哪个窗口。在此架构内，语言模型能够学习规划策略、预测世界模型并执行规划期间所需的算术运算。我们展示了，当给定一个仅能追加的 SCW（类似于图灵机带）时，即使是从零开始训练的相对较小的语言模型，也能在每个规划领域内学习规划策略并从少量训练实例中泛化，在 BlocksWorld 和 Pancake 拼图中实现了超过 99.89% 的成功率。我们对河内塔（TOH）失败案例的分析表明，它们源于算术运算或遇到以前未见过的标记。我们展示了 COC 可以解决多达 20 个盘子的 TOH 问题实例，需要超过 100 万个动作，同时通过（1）在算术符号支持下进行规划或（2）为 SCW 使用确定性下推自动机（PDA）公式，显著减少了训练数据需求。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Chain of Computation (COC) 架构，通过在迭代循环中集成 Transformer 和结构化上下文窗口，成功解决了大语言模型在规划任务中表现不佳的问题。该方法通过模拟图灵机或下推自动机，使小型模型能够高效学习规划策略，并在多个经典规划任务中取得了极高的成功率。
AI.keywords: Transformers, 规划任务, Chain of Computation, 结构化上下文窗口, 图灵完备性
AI.comments: 该研究通过将Transformer置于迭代循环中，成功弥合了其理论计算能力与实际规划能力之间的差距。其核心创新点在于引入了类似图灵机带的结构化上下文窗口（SCW），使得小模型也能具备强大的规划和逻辑推理能力。该方法对于理解Transformer的计算极限具有重要意义，但对于复杂问题的泛化能力仍依赖于符号化支持或特定数据结构。

title: Learning to Detect Cross-Modal Negation: An Analysis of Latent Representations and an Attention-Based Solution
comments: This manuscript is an accepted version of the article (published at ICNLP2026). Published in IEEE Xplore, DOI:10.1109/ICNLP69856.2026.11527861 document: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11527861
summary: Detecting high-level semantic concepts like negation across modalities remains a challenge for current multimodal systems. We analyze this as a fundamental representation learning problem, providing the first evidence that negation does not form a linearly or non-linearly separable class in the latent spaces of standard vision-language models (VLMs). We demonstrate that pretrained embeddings primarily encode modality-specific features, lacking a generalizable negation signal. To overcome this, we propose a novel cross-modal attention architecture that explicitly models inter-modal dependencies, achieving performance gains of up to +7.03% F1 over unimodal baselines. Our analysis reveals a key asymmetry: while textual negation often appears independently, visual negation is semantically dependent on linguistic context, a finding validated through our statistical analysis of 3,222 political video-text pairs automatically annotated via \textsc{Qwen2.5-VL}. By combining this analysis with self-supervised video representations (JEPA2), we advance the modeling of temporal negation. This work provides new methods and insights for learning robust, semantically-aligned representations in multimodal systems.
comment: This manuscript is an accepted version of the article (published at ICNLP2026). Published in IEEE Xplore, DOI:10.1109/ICNLP69856.2026.11527861 document: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11527861

AI.title_translation: 跨模态否定学习检测：潜在表征分析与基于注意力机制的解决方案
AI.tldr: 跨模态否定检测具有挑战性，现有模型在潜在空间中无法有效分离否定。本文提出一种新的跨模态注意力模型，并结合自监督视频表征，以解决此问题，并分析了文本和视觉否定的不对称性。
AI.motivation: 当前的跨模态系统在检测跨模态否定等高级语义概念方面存在挑战，并且预训练的嵌入主要编码特定模态的特征，缺乏可泛化的否定信号。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的跨模态注意力架构，显式地对模态间的依赖关系进行建模，并结合自监督视频表征（JEPA2）来改进时间否定建模。
AI.result: 与单一模态基线相比，所提出的模型性能提升高达+7.03% F1。通过对3,222个政治视频-文本对的统计分析，发现文本否定通常独立出现，而视觉否定在语义上依赖于语言上下文。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为多模态系统中学习鲁棒的、语义对齐的表征提供了新的方法和见解，并强调了跨模态注意力机制在捕捉模态间依赖性方面的重要性。
AI.translation: 跨模态否定检测仍然是当前多模态系统面临的一项挑战。我们将此问题视为一个基础的表征学习问题，首次证明了否定在标准视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的潜在空间中既不是线性可分离的，也不是非线性可分离的。我们发现，预训练的嵌入主要编码特定模态的特征，缺乏可泛化的否定信号。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的跨模态注意力架构，该架构显式地对模态间的依赖关系进行建模，与单一模态基线相比，性能提升高达+7.03% F1。我们的分析揭示了一个关键的不对称性：文本否定通常独立出现，而视觉否定在语义上依赖于语言上下文。这一发现通过我们对通过	extsc{Qwen2.5-VL}自动标注的3,222个政治视频-文本对进行的统计分析得到了验证。通过结合这种分析和自监督视频表征（JEPA2），我们改进了时间否定的建模。这项工作为学习多模态系统中鲁棒的、语义对齐的表征提供了新的方法和见解。
AI.summary: 本研究解决了多模态系统中跨模态否定检测的挑战。研究人员发现，标准视觉-语言模型在潜在空间中难以有效分离否定概念，因为它们的嵌入主要关注特定模态的特征。为解决此问题，他们提出了一种新颖的跨模态注意力架构，该架构通过显式建模模态间依赖性来提升性能，相比单一模态基线，F1分数提高了7.03%。此外，研究还揭示了文本否定和视觉否定在语义上的不对称性，即视觉否定更依赖于语言上下文。通过结合这种分析和自监督视频表征，该模型在时间否定建模方面取得了进展，为多模态表征学习提供了新的方法和见解。
AI.keywords: 跨模态否定检测, 视觉-语言模型, 注意力机制, 表征学习, 时间否定
AI.comments: 该研究在跨模态否定检测领域取得了重要进展，首次系统地分析了否定概念在多模态模型潜在空间中的表征问题，并提出了有效的解决方案。研究中发现的文本否定和视觉否定之间的不对称性是一个有趣的见解，为未来的研究提供了方向。然而，该研究仅在政治视频-文本对上进行了验证，其泛化能力有待进一步考察。

title: AEGIS: Awareness-Enhanced Guidance for Iterative Safeguard
summary: Span-level rationales are often assumed to improve controllability in text detoxification, but it remains unclear when such guidance helps and when it introduces trade-offs. We present Awareness-Enhanced Guidance for Iterative Safeguard (AEGIS) as an exploratory framework for studying span-guided multilingual detoxification across English, Mandarin Chinese, and Korean. AEGIS combines span-level detector outputs with frozen generator backbones, allowing harmful spans, intensity labels, and target attributes to be provided as structured guidance during rewriting. Rather than claiming state-of-the-art detoxification performance, we analyze how span guidance affects the balance between toxicity reduction and meaning preservation across generator families, model scales, and languages. Our results suggest that span-guided detoxification is conditionally useful: explicit rationales change the trade-off between toxicity reduction and meaning preservation, but their effects depend strongly on the generator backbone and the linguistic context. These findings highlight both the promise and the limitations of span-level control signals for multilingual detoxification.

AI.title_translation: AEGIS：增强意识以进行迭代安全保障的指导
AI.tldr: AEGIS是一个框架，用于研究跨语言的文本去毒化，发现显式的跨度指导对于减少毒性是有条件的，并且效果很大程度上取决于生成器骨干和语言背景。
AI.motivation: 研究跨语言文本去毒化中跨度级指导何时有效以及何时会带来权衡。
AI.method: AEGIS框架结合了跨度级检测器输出和冻结的生成器骨干，在重写过程中提供有害跨度、强度标签和目标属性作为结构化指导。
AI.result: 跨度指导的去毒化在减少毒性和保留意义之间的权衡会发生变化，但其效果很大程度上取决于生成器骨干和语言背景。
AI.conclusion: 显式的跨度指导在文本去毒化中有潜力，但也存在局限性，其有效性是有条件的，并强烈依赖于生成器骨干和语言背景。
AI.translation: 跨度级解释通常被认为可以改善文本去毒化的可控性，但目前尚不清楚何时这种指导会有帮助，何时会带来权衡。我们提出了AEGIS（Awareness-Enhanced Guidance for Iterative Safeguard）作为研究跨度指导的多语言去毒化的探索性框架，涵盖英语、普通话和韩语。AEGIS将跨度级检测器输出与冻结的生成器骨干相结合，允许在重写过程中提供有害跨度、强度标签和目标属性作为结构化指导。我们并不声称达到最先进的去毒化性能，而是分析跨度指导如何影响不同生成器系列、模型规模和语言之间毒性降低与意义保留之间的平衡。我们的结果表明，跨度指导的去毒化是有条件地有用的：显式的解释改变了毒性降低与意义保留之间的权衡，但其效果在很大程度上取决于生成器骨干和语言背景。这些发现突显了跨度级控制信号在多语言去毒化中的潜力和局限性。
AI.summary: AEGIS框架通过结合跨度级检测器输出和生成器骨干，研究了跨度指导对多语言文本去毒化的影响，并分析了其在不同模型和语言中的表现，强调了指导的条件有效性。
AI.keywords: 文本去毒化, 跨度指导, 多语言, AEGIS, 可控性
AI.comments: 这项研究通过AEGIS框架探索了跨度指导在多语言文本去毒化中的作用，强调了其效果的条件性，并指出了未来研究方向，即如何更好地利用跨度信号以平衡毒性降低和意义保留。

title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
comments: 12 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ACM SIGKDD 2026
summary: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears to be a natural complement, naively combining compression with non-prefix KV reuse often leads to severe accuracy degradation. In this work, we propose C$^2$KV, a unified framework for non-prefix KV reuse that jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation. C$^2$KV learns a composable and compressed KV cache manifold that is explicitly designed to be position-agnostic. Our approach introduces a lightweight sidecar Extractor with learnable compression tokens and a structured attention flow, enabling modular KV representations that can be flexibly reused and concatenated without modifying the frozen base model. We further employ a compression-concatenation co-training strategy to align extraction-time representations with their downstream reuse behavior. Extensive experiments across multiple long-context benchmarks and model families demonstrate that C$^2$KV significantly reduces KV cache storage and transfer costs, achieving up to 17$\times$ inference speedup under long contexts, while preserving generation quality.
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, accepted by ACM SIGKDD 2026

AI.title_translation: 压缩和可组合的键值缓存复用以实现高效的大语言模型推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 C$^2$KV 的新框架，用于高效地处理长上下文大语言模型推理。它通过联合优化键值（KV）缓存的提取和连接，实现了 KV 缓存的压缩和可组合复用，从而显著降低了存储和传输成本，并将推理速度提高了 17 倍，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理方法虽然关注计算节省，但忽视了存储和访问大型 KV 缓存的成本。直接将 KV 压缩与非前缀 KV 重用结合会导致准确性下降。
AI.method: C$^2$KV 框架通过一个轻量级的提取器（Extractor）和可学习的压缩标记（compression tokens）来实现 KV 缓存的压缩和位置无关的表示。它还采用压缩-连接联合训练策略，以匹配提取时表示和下游重用行为。
AI.result: C$^2$KV 显著降低了 KV 缓存的存储和传输成本，在长上下文场景下实现了高达 17 倍的推理速度提升，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.conclusion: C$^2$KV 框架通过联合优化 KV 提取和推理时连接，成功实现了 KV 缓存的压缩和可组合复用，解决了长上下文 LLM 推理中的关键瓶颈，并在速度和质量上取得了显著的改进。
AI.translation: 长上下文推理是现代大型语言模型（LLM）应用（如检索增强生成和多文档推理）的核心。为了缓解不断增长的推理成本，最近的工作探索了键值（KV）缓存复用来减少冗余的预填充计算。然而，现有的复用方法主要关注计算节省，而忽略了长上下文 LLM 服务中的一个关键瓶颈：存储和访问大型 KV 缓存的成本。虽然 KV 压缩似乎是自然的补充，但直接将压缩与非前缀 KV 复用结合通常会导致严重的准确性下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了 C$^2$KV，一个用于非前缀 KV 复用的统一框架，它联合优化 KV 提取和推理时连接。C$^2$KV 学习了一个可组合且压缩的 KV 缓存流形，该流形明确设计为位置无关。我们的方法引入了一个带有可学习压缩标记和结构化注意力流的轻量级侧边提取器，实现了模块化的 KV 表示，可以灵活地复用和连接，而无需修改冻结的基础模型。我们进一步采用压缩-连接联合训练策略，以匹配提取时表示与其下游复用行为。在多个长上下文基准和模型家族上的广泛实验表明，C$^2$KV 显著降低了 KV 缓存的存储和传输成本，在长上下文下实现了高达 17 倍的推理速度提升，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.summary: 该研究提出 C$^2$KV 框架，通过联合优化 KV 缓存提取和连接，实现了 KV 缓存的压缩和可组合复用，解决了长上下文 LLM 推理中的存储和访问瓶颈，显著提高了推理速度并保持了生成质量。
AI.keywords: KV 缓存复用,长上下文推理,模型压缩,大语言模型,C$^2$KV
AI.comments: 该研究有效地解决了大语言模型长上下文推理中的关键瓶颈问题，即 KV 缓存的存储和访问成本。通过提出 C$^2$KV 框架，该研究不仅实现了 KV 缓存的压缩和高效复用，还通过联合优化提取和连接策略，以及引入轻量级提取器和压缩标记，在不影响生成质量的前提下，显著提升了推理速度。特别是其提出的位置无关的 KV 缓存流形和模块化表示，为未来的 LLM 推理优化提供了有价值的思路。然而，该方法在不同模型架构和任务上的泛化能力以及实际部署的复杂性仍有待进一步验证。

title: PC-Seg: Progressive Cross-View Consistency for 3D OCT Segmentation from Sparse 2D Annotations
summary: Volumetric segmentation of optical coherence tomography (OCT) images is essential for diagnosing ocular diseases but requires labor-intensive voxel-wise annotations. While semi-supervised learning (SSL) can reduce annotation costs, most existing methods process data slice by slice and fail to exploit the inherent 3D spatial context. We propose PC-Seg, a progressive cross-view consistency framework that learns high-accuracy 3D segmentation models from sparse 2D annotations. Unlike conventional multi-view approaches, PC-Seg uses a single 2D model to learn cross-view consistency from standard B-scans and orthogonal slices, thereby generating reliable volumetric pseudo-labels. These pseudo-labels are then distilled into a 3D model, followed by a co-training stage in which the 2D and 3D models mutually refine each other through ensemble pseudo-labeling. Experiments on the MSHC and Duke DME datasets demonstrate that PC-Seg achieves accuracy comparable to fully supervised learning while using labels for only about 0.7% of the training data, outperforming state-of-the-art semi-supervised and retinal layer segmentation methods. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/gsisaoki/pc-seg-official.

AI.title_translation: PC-Seg：用于从稀疏2D注释进行3D OCT分割的渐进式跨视图一致性
AI.tldr: PC-Seg是一种新的框架，利用稀疏的2D注释从3D OCT图像中进行分割，通过渐进式跨视图一致性生成伪标签，然后蒸馏到3D模型中，并进行协同训练，实现了接近全监督的准确性，同时大大降低了标注成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的OCT图像分割方法需要耗费大量人力进行逐个体素的标注。虽然半监督学习可以减少标注成本，但大多数现有方法是逐层处理数据，未能利用固有的3D空间上下文。
AI.method: PC-Seg框架利用单个2D模型学习标准B扫描和正交切片的跨视图一致性，生成可靠的3D伪标签。然后将这些伪标签蒸馏到一个3D模型中，并进行协同训练，2D和3D模型通过集成伪标签相互改进。
AI.result: PC-Seg在MSHC和Duke DME数据集上的实验表明，其准确性可与全监督学习相媲美，而仅使用了约0.7%的训练数据标注，并且优于最先进的半监督和视网膜层分割方法。
AI.conclusion: PC-Seg通过渐进式跨视图一致性框架，能够从稀疏的2D注释中学习高精度的3D OCT分割模型，在显著降低标注成本的同时，达到了与全监督学习相当的性能。
AI.translation: 眼组织成像（OCT）图像的体积分割对于诊断眼部疾病至关重要，但需要耗费大量人力的逐个体素标注。虽然半监督学习（SSL）可以降低标注成本，但大多数现有方法是逐层处理数据，未能利用固有的3D空间上下文。我们提出了PC-Seg，一个渐进式跨视图一致性框架，可以从稀疏的2D注释中学习高精度的3D分割模型。与传统的多视图方法不同，PC-Seg使用单个2D模型从标准B扫描和正交切片中学习跨视图一致性，从而生成可靠的体积伪标签。然后将这些伪标签蒸馏到3D模型中，之后进行协同训练阶段，其中2D和3D模型通过集成伪标签相互改进。在MSHC和Duke DME数据集上的实验表明，PC-Seg在仅使用约0.7%训练数据的情况下，达到了与全监督学习相当的准确性，优于最先进的半监督和视网膜层分割方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/gsisaoki/pc-seg-official公开获取。
AI.summary: PC-Seg是一种创新的框架，旨在通过利用稀疏的2D注释来解决3D OCT图像分割中的标注成本问题。该方法通过渐进式跨视图一致性学习，从2D切片生成高质量的3D伪标签，随后将这些伪标签用于训练3D模型，并结合协同训练机制，使2D和3D模型相互促进。实验结果表明，PC-Seg在MSHC和Duke DME数据集上取得了与全监督方法相当的性能，同时标注成本极低（仅0.7%数据）。
AI.keywords: 3D OCT分割,稀疏标注,跨视图一致性,伪标签,半监督学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的PC-Seg框架，有效地解决了3D OCT图像分割中对大量标注数据的依赖问题。通过巧妙地利用跨视图一致性生成伪标签，并结合蒸馏和协同训练策略，实现了在极低标注成本下的高性能。该方法对于医学图像分割领域具有重要的理论和应用价值。代码的公开也为后续研究提供了便利。

title: SR-Agent: An Experience-Driven Agentic Framework for Post-Ranking Strategies Refinement in E-Commerce Recommendation
summary: User experience is a first-class objective in industrial e-commerce recommender systems (RS). Post-ranking strategies, which govern diversity, similarity, and exposure over a ranked list, are widely deployed in industrial RS for their simplicity and low serving cost. However, as the online recommendation environment evolves continuously, these statically configured strategies gradually become stale, degrading the user experience. Refining them typically relies on manual inspection, diagnosis, and updates, a process that is slow, costly, and hard to reuse. Although recent LLM-based agents (e.g., RecUserSim, SimUSER, and Self-EvolveRec) offer promising directions, none of them close the full loop of automated, self-evolving strategy refinement. To bridge this gap, we introduce SR-Agent, a Strategy Refinement agentic framework that, to the best of our knowledge, is the first deployed for refining post-ranking strategies in industrial RS. SR-Agent unifies three components: (i) a UserSim agent that applies staged inspection skills to surface user-perceived bad cases; (ii) an Analysis agent that consolidates recurring bad cases into structured, reusable diagnoses; and (iii) a constrained Strategy Refinement Harness that maps diagnoses to typed and bounded actions, gated by a four-stage reward pipeline with reversible rollback. Deployed on the Kuaishou e-commerce platform, SR-Agent continuously runs this refinement loop and, in a one-month online A/B test, increases order volume by 0.71%, browsing depth by 0.34%, and clicked-category diversity by 0.48%, while markedly shortening the refinement cycle and lowering operational cost.

AI.title_translation: SR-Agent：一种以用户体验为驱动的电子商务推荐场景下排序后策略优化的代理框架
AI.tldr: SR-Agent是一个创新的代理框架，用于自动化电子商务推荐系统中的排序后策略优化，通过模拟用户行为、分析不良案例和约束性策略调整，有效提升了用户体验和业务指标，并降低了成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的排序后策略（如多样性、相似性、曝光度）配置静态，在不断变化的在线推荐环境中会逐渐过时，导致用户体验下降。手动优化过程缓慢、成本高且难以复用。尽管有基于LLM的代理方法，但未能实现策略优化的全闭环自动化和自适应演进。
AI.method: SR-Agent框架包含三个核心组件：1. UserSim代理：运用分阶段的检查技能，识别用户感知到的不良推荐案例。2. Analysis代理：将反复出现的不良案例进行整合，形成结构化、可复用的诊断。3. 约束性策略优化引擎：将诊断映射为有类型和边界的调整动作，并通过一个包含四阶段奖励和可逆回滚机制的管道进行控制。
AI.result: 在快手电商平台长达一个月的A/B测试中，SR-Agent将订单量提升了0.71%，浏览深度增加了0.34%，点击类目多样性提高了0.48%。此外，该框架显著缩短了策略优化周期，并降低了运营成本。
AI.conclusion: SR-Agent是首个用于工业界推荐系统排序后策略优化的自动化、自适应代理框架，通过其创新的设计和部署，成功实现了用户体验和业务指标的双重提升，并带来了显著的成本效益。
AI.translation: 用户体验是工业界电子商务推荐系统（RS）中的一等目标。排序后策略，负责控制排序列表的多样性、相似性和曝光度，因其简单性和低服务成本而被广泛应用于工业界RS。然而，随着在线推荐环境的不断演变，这些静态配置的策略逐渐变得陈旧，导致用户体验下降。对其进行优化通常依赖于手动检查、诊断和更新，这个过程缓慢、成本高且难以复用。尽管最近基于LLM的代理（例如RecUserSim、SimUSER和Self-EvolveRec）提供了有前景的方向，但它们都未能实现自动化、自适应的策略优化全闭环。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了SR-Agent，一个策略优化代理框架，据我们所知，它是首个应用于工业界RS中排序后策略优化的部署框架。SR-Agent整合了三个组件：（i）一个UserSim代理，应用分阶段的检查技能来发现用户感知到的不良案例；（ii）一个Analysis代理，将反复出现的不良案例整合为结构化、可复用的诊断；（iii）一个约束性策略优化引擎，将诊断映射为有类型和边界的动作，并通过一个包含四个阶段的奖励管道进行控制，该管道支持可逆回滚。SR-Agent已部署在快手电商平台，持续运行此优化循环，并在为期一个月的在线A/B测试中，使订单量增加了0.71%，浏览深度增加了0.34%，点击类目多样性增加了0.48%，同时显著缩短了优化周期并降低了运营成本。
AI.summary: SR-Agent是一个新颖的代理框架，旨在自动化电子商务推荐系统中排序后策略的优化过程。它通过用户模拟（UserSim）识别不良推荐案例，通过分析（Analysis）将这些案例归纳为结构化诊断，并利用一个约束性优化引擎根据诊断调整策略。该框架已在快手电商平台成功部署，并通过A/B测试证明了其有效性，能够提升订单量、浏览深度和类目多样性，同时降低了优化成本和周期。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统, 排序后策略, 代理框架, 用户体验, 自动化优化
AI.comments: SR-Agent在解决工业界推荐系统中的一个关键痛点——排序后策略的静态性问题——方面取得了显著进展。其最大的创新在于闭环自动化和基于用户体验的优化方法，这与许多现有研究仅关注特定方面或需要手动干预形成鲜明对比。框架的设计，特别是UserSim、Analysis和Strategy Refinement Harness的结合，以及奖励管道和回滚机制，展示了其在实际应用中的鲁棒性和有效性。然而，对于UserSim代理模拟用户行为的准确性、Analysis代理诊断的泛化能力以及策略调整对长期用户行为的潜在影响，仍需进一步的深入研究和评估。

title: KernelDiag: Agent-Based Root Cause Diagnosis for Kernel Crashes
summary: The Linux kernel is one of the most complex software systems, where automated fuzzing continuously exposes thousands of crashes, yet root-cause diagnosis remains a manual and time-consuming bottleneck. Existing LLM-based root cause analysis (RCA) techniques, effective for distributed systems, do not readily generalize to kernel debugging due to sparse low-level artifacts, heterogeneous diagnostic evidence (e.g., syscalls, logs, and crash reports), and complex non-linear fault propagation that demands fine-grained method-level reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose KernelDiag, an agent-based framework for kernel root-cause diagnosis via structured causal reasoning. KernelDiag first aligns heterogeneous diagnostic artifacts through log-to-code mapping, and then employs artifact-specialized agents to iteratively reason over source-level program semantics and crash-specific kernel configurations. The inferred causal dependencies are incrementally organized into structured Evidence Graphs, enabling accurate faulty-method localization and causal explanations. We evaluate KernelDiag on the real-world KGYM benchmark. KernelDiag consistently outperforms state-of-the-art localization approaches at both file and method levels, achieving significant improvements in Top@k accuracy, including up to 4x and 2x gains in challenging settings without explicit hints. Furthermore, both human and LLM-assisted evaluations show that KernelDiag generates accurate, coherent, and actionable diagnostic explanations. Overall, this work lays the foundation for automated kernel root-cause diagnosis by bridging low-level diagnostic evidence with source-level causal reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 内核崩溃的基于智能体的根因诊断
AI.tldr: Linux内核崩溃的根因诊断是一个耗时且耗力的手动过程，现有方法（如基于LLM的技术）难以处理内核调试的稀疏低级伪影、异构证据和复杂的非线性故障传播。KernelDiag是一个基于智能体的框架，通过结构化因果推理来解决这些问题。它将异构诊断伪影与日志到代码映射对齐，然后使用专门的智能体迭代地推理源代码级程序语义和崩溃特定的内核配置。推断出的因果依赖关系被增量地组织成结构化证据图，以实现准确的故障方法定位和因果解释。在KGYM基准测试中，KernelDiag在文件和方法级别都优于最先进的定位方法，在具有挑战性的设置下取得了显著的改进，并且能够生成准确、连贯和可操作的诊断解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的根因分析技术在处理Linux内核调试的稀疏低级伪影、异构诊断证据（如系统调用、日志和崩溃报告）以及复杂的非线性故障传播方面存在不足，这些问题阻碍了准确的根因诊断。
AI.method: KernelDiag是一个基于智能体的框架，通过结构化因果推理进行内核根因诊断。它首先通过日志到代码映射对齐异构诊断伪影，然后使用专门的智能体迭代地推理源代码级程序语义和崩溃特定的内核配置。推断出的因果依赖关系被增量地组织成结构化证据图，以实现准确的故障方法定位和因果解释。
AI.result: KernelDiag在KGYM基准测试中，在文件和方法级别均优于最先进的定位方法，在Top@k准确率方面取得了显著改进，在无显式提示的挑战性设置下，准确率分别提高了4倍和2倍。此外，人工和LLM辅助评估均表明KernelDiag生成的诊断解释准确、连贯且可操作。
AI.conclusion: KernelDiag通过将低级诊断证据与源代码级因果推理相结合，为自动内核根因诊断奠定了基础，并在真实世界的基准测试中表现出优越的性能和可操作的解释。
AI.translation: Linux内核是最复杂的软件系统之一，其中自动模糊测试不断暴露数千次崩溃，但根因诊断仍然是一个手动且耗时的瓶颈。现有的基于LLM的根因分析（RCA）技术，虽然对分布式系统有效，但由于稀疏的低级伪影、异构的诊断证据（例如，系统调用、日志和崩溃报告）以及需要细粒度方法级推理的复杂非线性故障传播，因此不易推广到内核调试。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了KernelDiag，一个用于通过结构化因果推理进行内核根因诊断的基于智能体的框架。KernelDiag首先通过日志到代码映射对齐异构诊断伪影，然后采用特定于伪影的智能体迭代地推理源代码级程序语义和崩溃特定的内核配置。推断出的因果依赖关系被增量地组织成结构化证据图，从而能够进行准确的故障方法定位和因果解释。我们在真实的KGYM基准测试中评估了KernelDiag。KernelDiag在文件和方法级别的准确率始终优于最先进的定位方法，在Top@k准确率方面取得了显著改进，在具有挑战性的无显式提示的设置下，准确率分别提高了4倍和2倍。此外，人工和LLM辅助评估均表明KernelDiag生成的诊断解释准确、连贯且可操作。总的来说，这项工作通过连接低级诊断证据与源代码级因果推理，为自动内核根因诊断奠定了基础。
AI.summary: KernelDiag是一个创新的基于智能体的框架，旨在解决Linux内核根因诊断的挑战。它通过日志到代码映射和专门的智能体来处理稀疏的低级伪影、异构证据和复杂的故障传播，从而实现结构化的因果推理。该框架通过构建证据图来定位故障方法并提供因果解释。实验结果表明，KernelDiag在KGYM基准测试中显著优于现有方法，并能生成准确可操作的诊断解释，为自动化内核调试开辟了新途径。
AI.keywords: 内核诊断, 根因分析, 基于智能体的推理, 因果推理, Linux内核
AI.comments: KernelDiag在解决Linux内核根因诊断这一关键但充满挑战的问题上取得了重要进展。该框架通过其创新的基于智能体的结构和结构化因果推理方法，有效地弥合了低级诊断证据与源代码级理解之间的差距。在真实世界基准测试中取得的显著性能提升，以及生成准确、连贯且可操作的诊断解释的能力，凸显了其在实际应用中的潜力。然而，进一步的研究可以探索该方法在处理更广泛的内核版本和不同类型的硬件体系结构方面的可扩展性和鲁棒性。此外，对智能体之间交互和学习机制的深入分析，可能会为未来的改进提供见解。

title: A domain decomposition online-learning-enhanced nonlinear elimination preconditioner
summary: Nonlinearly preconditioned inexact Newton methods form an effective class of solvers for large-scale nonlinear algebraic systems arising from the discretization of partial differential equations. A central challenge in nonlinear elimination (NE) preconditioning is the reliable identification of the slowly converging components to be eliminated. Existing selection strategies often rely on problem-specific physical information or user-tuned thresholds applied directly to the raw nonlinear residual, which may contain irregular oscillatory structures near stagnation regions, making the selected bad subset highly sensitive to threshold parameters. In this work, we propose an online-learning-enhanced NE preconditioner that identifies the bad subset from the dominant structure of the nonlinear residual rather than from the raw residual itself. Residual snapshots are collected online during the stagnation phase of the current Newton solve, and an unsupervised extraction model is trained to capture the principal nonlinear imbalance. We consider both a linear extractor based on principal component analysis and nonlinear extractors based on autoencoder neural networks. Moreover, we integrate the approach into a parallel domain decomposition framework, which trains a local extraction model independently on each subdomain. The learned residual reconstruction is then used to define the bad subset and guide the nonlinear elimination process. Numerical experiments on lid-driven cavity flows at Reynolds numbers up to 10,000 show that the proposed method produces more reliable and coherent bad subsets, is robust with respect to both NE and learning parameters, and outperforms the baseline NE preconditioner in terms of the convergence.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于区域分解的在线学习增强型非线性消除预条件器
AI.tldr: 通过在线训练机器学习模型自动识别非线性求解中的缓慢收敛成分，提升了非线性预条件器的鲁棒性与收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的非线性消除预条件器在识别缓慢收敛的“坏子集”时，往往依赖于特定问题的物理信息或对原始残差设置敏感的人工阈值，导致识别过程不稳定且难以调整。
AI.method: 提出一种在线学习增强的非线性消除（NE）预条件器，通过在牛顿法停滞阶段收集残差快照，利用主成分分析（PCA）或自编码器神经网络提取主导非线性失衡结构，并将其集成到并行区域分解框架中，以指导“坏子集”的识别。
AI.result: 在雷诺数高达10,000的顶盖驱动流问题实验中，该方法识别出的坏子集更可靠、更具连贯性，对参数设置具有更强的鲁棒性，并且在收敛性能上优于基准的非线性消除预条件器。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的在线学习增强型非线性消除预条件器能够有效识别非线性残差中的主导失衡结构，在处理大规模非线性代数系统时展现出比传统方法更优的鲁棒性和收敛效率。
AI.translation: 非线性预条件不精确牛顿法是求解由偏微分方程离散化产生的大规模非线性代数系统的一类有效求解器。非线性消除（NE）预条件中的一个核心挑战是可靠地识别需要消除的缓慢收敛分量。现有的选择策略通常依赖于特定问题的物理信息或直接应用于原始非线性残差的用户调整阈值，而原始残差在停滞区域附近可能包含不规则的振荡结构，使得所选的坏子集对阈值参数高度敏感。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种在线学习增强的NE预条件器，它从非线性残差的主导结构中识别坏子集，而不是直接从原始残差中识别。残差快照在当前牛顿求解的停滞阶段在线收集，并训练一个无监督提取模型来捕获主要的非线性失衡。我们考虑了基于主成分分析的线性提取器和基于自编码器神经网络的非线性提取器。此外，我们将该方法集成到一个并行区域分解框架中，该框架在每个子域上独立训练局部提取模型。学习到的残差重构随后被用于定义坏子集并指导非线性消除过程。针对雷诺数高达10,000的顶盖驱动流进行的数值实验表明，所提方法产生了更可靠和连贯的坏子集，对NE参数和学习参数均具有鲁棒性，且在收敛性方面优于基准NE预条件器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过在线学习增强非线性消除（NE）预条件器的方法，旨在解决大规模非线性系统求解中“坏子集”识别困难的问题。通过在牛顿法求解过程中在线训练PCA或自编码器模型来提取残差的主导结构，并结合并行区域分解框架，该方法实现了更鲁棒、更高效的非线性迭代求解。
AI.keywords: 非线性消除, 区域分解, 在线学习, 自编码器, 牛顿法
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入机器学习（PCA和自编码器）来自动化识别非线性消除法中的“坏子集”，克服了传统方法对人工阈值和特定领域知识的依赖。其创新之处在于将在线学习与区域分解并行框架相结合，显著增强了求解器在复杂流体力学问题中的鲁棒性和收敛性能，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Lifelong Multi-Subsystem Pickup and Delivery with Buffer-Limited Handover Stations
summary: Coordinating payload transfers between subsystems is a critical challenge in lifelong Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD). We study systems where agents are confined to separate regions and must exchange payloads through shared handover stations. These stations, equipped with single docks and finite buffers, are inherently vulnerable to blocking and starvation. We formalize this problem as Multi-Subsystem MAPD with Buffer-limited Handover Stations (MS-MAPD-BHS). We then propose Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing (HARR), an online controller that couples per-subsystem planners. HARR uses a shared dock reservation calendar and a deterministic rolling-horizon projection of buffer occupancy to coordinate actions. A candidate route is accepted only if its dock interval is free and the resulting buffer occupancy projection remains within capacity. Under perfect execution, these checks ensure collision-free dock use and buffer-safe committed operations within the reservation horizon. In simulation, HARR achieves up to 77% higher throughput and 92% lower backlog than a fixed-dock ablation at moderate load, while also reducing planning time relative to a coupled station-aware Token Passing baseline. These results show that explicit interface coordination substantially improves stability in modular multi-subsystem transport.

AI.title_translation: 带有限缓冲区的交接站的终身多子系统拾取和交付
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为MS-MAPD-BHS的问题，即在具有有限缓冲区的交接站的多子系统拾取和交付问题。他们还提出了一种名为HARR的在线控制器，该控制器可以协调子系统之间的通信，以提高吞吐量并减少积压。
AI.motivation: 协调子系统之间的载荷转移是终身多代理拾取和交付（MAPD）中的关键挑战，特别是在代理被限制在单独的区域并通过共享的、具有有限缓冲区和单个泊位的交接站交换载荷的系统中，这些交接站容易发生阻塞和饥饿。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为HARR（Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing）的在线控制器，该控制器结合了每个子系统的规划器。HARR使用共享的泊位预订日历和确定性的滚动视界投影来预测缓冲区占用情况，以协调动作。只有当候选路线的泊位可用且由此产生的缓冲区占用情况预测在容量范围内时，才接受该路线。这种方法确保了在预订视界内无冲突的泊位使用和缓冲区安全的提交操作。
AI.result: 与固定的泊位消融方法相比，HARR在适度负载下可实现高达77%的吞吐量和92%的积压减少，同时还减少了与基于令牌传递的基线相比的规划时间。
AI.conclusion: 明确的接口协调可以显著提高模块化多子系统运输的稳定性。
AI.translation: 协调子系统之间的载荷转移是终身多代理拾取和交付（MAPD）中的关键挑战。我们研究了代理被限制在单独的区域，并通过共享的交接站交换载荷的系统。这些交接站配备了单个泊位和有限的缓冲区，容易发生阻塞和饥饿。我们将此问题形式化为具有缓冲区限制交接站的多子系统MAPD（MS-MAPD-BHS）。然后，我们提出了Handover-Aware Reservation and Routing（HARR），一种在线控制器，它结合了每个子系统的规划器。HARR使用共享的泊位预订日历和确定性的滚动视界投影来预测缓冲区占用情况，以协调动作。只有当候选路线的泊位间隔可用且由此产生的缓冲区占用情况投影保持在容量范围内时，才接受候选路线。在完美执行下，这些检查可确保在预订视界内无冲突的泊位使用和缓冲区安全的提交操作。在模拟中，与固定的泊位消融方法相比，HARR在适度负载下可实现高达77%的吞吐量和92%的积压减少，同时还减少了与耦合的、站点感知的令牌传递基线相比的规划时间。这些结果表明，明确的接口协调可以显著提高模块化多子系统运输的稳定性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个名为MS-MAPD-BHS的问题，该问题涉及在具有有限缓冲区的交接站的多子系统拾取和交付场景。为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了一种名为HARR的在线控制器，它通过协调各个子系统规划器来管理交接站的泊位预订和缓冲区使用情况。模拟结果表明，与基线方法相比，HARR显著提高了吞吐量，减少了积压，并降低了规划时间，证明了显式接口协调在提高多子系统运输系统稳定性方面的重要性。
AI.keywords: 多子系统拾取和交付, 交接站, 缓冲区限制, 在线控制, 协调
AI.comments: 该研究解决了多子系统拾取和交付问题中的一个关键挑战，即在具有有限资源的交接站进行协调。所提出的HARR控制器通过结合预订日历和缓冲区占用预测，有效地解决了这一问题。该方法在模拟中显示出优越的性能，但未来的工作可以探索其在实际系统中的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Fast VEM Fluid Simulation
summary: The intricate motion arising from fluid--boundary interactions is visually compelling, yet notoriously difficult and computationally expensive to simulate in the presence of complex boundaries. Accurately resolving boundary geometry requires body-fitted grids constructed via cut-cell methods, which often leads to poorly conditioned linear systems in the pressure projection stage and, consequently, prohibitive computational cost. We present FastVEM, an efficient boundary-conforming fluid simulation framework that enables high-fidelity flow--boundary interaction at substantially reduced cost. Computational efficiency is achieved through a coordinated, top-down design spanning numerical discretization, grid construction, and linear solvers. FastVEM adopts a Virtual Element Method (VEM) discretization to robustly enforce incompressibility and boundary conditions on irregular body-fitted grids, and employs a VEM polynomial-space Particle-in-Cell scheme for advection. Complementing this discretization, a convexity-preserving cut-cell strategy is introduced to construct simulation-friendly body-fitted grids. To accelerate pressure projection, we develop a Galerkin geometric multigrid solver featuring a diffusion-free prolongation operator that prevents coarse-level matrix densification, along with a nested, boundary-aware grid hierarchy that ensures well-posed placement of coarse-level degrees of freedom. Compared to prior cut-cell--based fluid simulators, FastVEM speeds up the computationally dominant pressure projection stage by up to 100x, while robustly handling even more challenging boundary geometries.

AI.tldr: FastVEM 通过结合虚拟元方法和专门设计的几何多重网格求解器，将复杂边界下的流体仿真压力投影速度提升了 100 倍。
AI.motivation: 在存在复杂边界的情况下，传统的切割网格流体仿真方法会导致压力投影阶段出现病态线性系统，从而产生极高的计算成本，限制了其应用效率。
AI.method: 1. 采用虚拟元方法 (VEM) 进行离散化以处理不规则边界；2. 引入凸性保持切割网格策略；3. 开发了具备无扩散延拓算子的 Galerkin 几何多重网格求解器，并配合嵌套的边界感知网格层次结构。
AI.result: FastVEM 在处理复杂几何边界时，将计算开销最大的压力投影阶段的速度提升了高达 100 倍，且保持了高保真的流体-边界交互模拟能力。
AI.conclusion: FastVEM 框架通过创新的 VEM 离散化、凸性保持切割网格生成以及定制化的几何多重网格求解器，成功解决了复杂边界流体仿真中计算效率低下的问题，实现了高达 100 倍的压力投影加速。
AI.translation: 由流体与边界相互作用产生的复杂运动在视觉上非常引人注目，但在存在复杂边界的情况下，对其进行模拟既困难又昂贵。精确解析边界几何形状需要通过切割网格方法构建贴体网格，这通常会导致压力投影阶段出现病态线性系统，从而产生高昂的计算成本。我们提出了 FastVEM，这是一个高效的贴体流体仿真框架，能够在大幅降低成本的同时实现高保真的流体-边界相互作用。计算效率是通过跨越数值离散化、网格构建和线性求解器的协同自顶向下设计实现的。FastVEM 采用虚拟元方法 (VEM) 离散化，在不规则贴体网格上稳健地强制执行不可压缩性和边界条件，并采用 VEM 多项式空间粒子网格法 (PIC) 进行平流。作为对该离散化的补充，引入了一种保持凸性的切割网格策略来构建模拟友好的贴体网格。为了加速压力投影，我们开发了一种 Galerkin 几何多重网格求解器，其特点是具有无扩散的延拓算子，可防止粗层矩阵致密化，以及嵌套的边界感知网格层次结构，确保了粗层自由度的良好放置。与以往基于切割网格的流体模拟器相比，FastVEM 将计算量占主导地位的压力投影阶段的速度提高了 100 倍，同时能够稳健地处理更具挑战性的边界几何形状。
AI.summary: FastVEM 是一种高效的边界拟合流体仿真框架，通过集成虚拟元方法、凸性保持切割网格生成及专门优化的几何多重网格求解器，显著降低了复杂边界流体模拟的计算代价，实现了高保真度与计算效率的兼顾。
AI.keywords: 流体仿真, 虚拟元方法, 边界拟合, 计算效率, 几何多重网格
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将虚拟元方法（VEM）应用于流体仿真，并结合专门优化的几何多重网格求解器，解决了复杂边界下流体仿真计算量大的核心痛点。其优势在于无需牺牲边界拟合精度即可实现极高的计算效率，是计算流体力学与计算机图形学结合的一个优秀范例。

title: MXSens: Sensitivity-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: 4-bit quantization enables efficient LLM inference, but suffers from significant accuracy degradation due to outliers. Prior work addresses this problem via data rotation or mixed-precision integer quantization, but often relies on software-managed scaling and frequent dequantization, incurring substantial overhead. Microscaling formats, such as MXINT, eliminate these inefficiencies by encoding scales in hardware, yet remain incompatible with rotation-based methods. Our analysis reveals that outliers vary in severity, from rare extremes to frequent mild deviations, and that quantization sensitivity is unevenly distributed across layers and columns. These insights motivate a fine-grained, sensitivity-guided approach. We introduce MXSens, a training-free method that assigns mixed mantissa bitwidths (4/6/8) based on column- and layer-wise sensitivity, naturally leveraging the block-wise structure of MXINT. MXSens outperforms state-of-the-art quantization methods across a range of models and tasks. Under the W4A4KV4 setting, MXSens achieves perplexities of 3.77 and 7.63 on LLaMA-2-70B and LLaMA-3-8B, respectively, substantially improving over existing baselines on WikiText-2. Our work establishes a new balance between accuracy and resource efficiency for LLM quantization.

AI.title_translation: MXSens：面向高效大模型推理的敏感度感知混合精度量化
AI.tldr: MXSens 是一种无需训练的混合精度量化方法，通过利用硬件友好的 MXINT 格式并根据敏感度动态分配位宽，显著提升了 LLM 的推理精度和效率。
AI.motivation: 4-bit 量化虽能提升效率但会导致明显的精度下降，而现有的旋转或混合精度方案往往伴随高额的软件开销，且与硬件友好的 MXINT 格式不兼容。
AI.method: 提出 MXSens 方法，这是一种无需训练的量化策略，根据列级和层级的敏感度差异，为权重分配 4/6/8 位的不同尾数位宽，并利用 MXINT 的块状结构实现高效硬件加速。
AI.result: 在 W4A4KV4 设置下，MXSens 在 LLaMA-2-70B 和 LLaMA-3-8B 上分别达到了 3.77 和 7.63 的困惑度，显著优于现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: MXSens 通过敏感度引导的细粒度混合精度量化，成功在 LLM 推理中实现了更优的精度与资源效率平衡，证明了其在多种模型上的优越性。
AI.translation: 4-bit 量化能够实现高效的大语言模型（LLM）推理，但由于离群值的存在，通常会导致显著的精度下降。先前的工作通过数据旋转或混合精度整数量化来解决这一问题，但往往依赖于软件管理的缩放和频繁的反量化，带来了巨大的开销。微缩放格式（如 MXINT）通过在硬件中编码缩放因子消除了这些低效问题，但却与基于旋转的方法不兼容。我们的分析表明，离群值的严重程度各不相同，从罕见的极端值到频繁的轻微偏差不等，且量化敏感度在层与列之间分布不均。这些见解促使我们采用一种细粒度的、敏感度引导的方法。我们引入了 MXSens，这是一种无需训练的方法，它根据列级和层级的敏感度分配混合尾数位宽（4/6/8位），自然地利用了 MXINT 的块状结构。MXSens 在一系列模型和任务上优于现有的最先进量化方法。在 W4A4KV4 设置下，MXSens 在 LLaMA-2-70B 和 LLaMA-3-8B 上分别实现了 3.77 和 7.63 的困惑度，在 WikiText-2 上显著改善了现有的基准。我们的工作在大语言模型量化的精度和资源效率之间建立了一个新的平衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 MXSens，这是一种针对大语言模型推理的敏感度感知混合精度量化方法。该方法利用 MXINT 的块状结构，根据层级和列级的量化敏感度差异，动态分配 4/6/8 位尾数位宽，在无需训练的前提下实现了精度与计算效率的提升。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 混合精度量化, 微缩放格式, 敏感度分析, 推理效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将敏感度分析与硬件友好的Microscaling（MX）格式相结合，通过无需训练的细粒度位宽分配，解决了现有混合精度量化在性能和效率之间的平衡问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Pathwise skew-symmetric discretisation for SDEs with superlinear drift
summary: The skew-symmetric discretisation has recently been proposed as a new robust simulation method for weakly approximating stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with non-globally Lipschitz drift. This work develops a pathwise version of the scheme by representing the noise increment as a skew-normal distribution and coupling it with the driving Brownian increments, thereby enabling its use in the multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) framework. Under suitable conditions, we establish strong convergence of order 1/2 in $L^2$. Subsequently, the associated MLMC estimator is shown to have computational complexity $\mathcal{O} \bigl(\varepsilon^{-2} (\log (1/\varepsilon))^2 \bigr)$ to achieve a mean-squared error $\varepsilon^2$. We then analytically compare the proposed scheme with the tamed Euler scheme, another benchmark for robust discretisation. Under a strong inward-drift regime with the current state being far from the stable region, we show that the probability of moving in the wrong direction tends to vanish in the skew-symmetric scheme, whereas the tamed Euler scheme makes such moves with a non-trivial probability. Furthermore, in the MLMC setting, employing a one-dimensional stochastic Ginzburg-Landau model, we specify the range of step sizes for which the asymptotic variance of the coupled level difference obtained via the pathwise skew-symmetric scheme is lower than that obtained via the tamed Euler scheme. Numerical experiments on several model examples support the theoretical rate of strong convergence and demonstrate the stability and effectiveness of the resulting MLMC in the superlinear drift setting.

AI.title_translation: SDEs的路径wise斜对称离散化与超线性漂移
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的路径wise斜对称离散化方法，用于模拟具有超线性漂移的随机微分方程（SDEs），并建立了其强收敛性，同时证明了其在多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架下的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 开发一种新的鲁棒的SDEs模拟方法，特别适用于具有非全局Lipschitz漂移的方程，并将其应用于多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架。
AI.method: 通过将噪声增量表示为斜正态分布并与布朗运动增量耦合，开发了斜对称离散化的路径wise版本。在适当条件下，建立了$L^2$范数下1/2阶的强收敛性。
AI.result: 证明了所提出方案的计算复杂度为$\	ext{O}(\	ext{ε}^{-2} (\	ext{log}(1/\	ext{ε}))^2)$，可以达到$\	ext{ε}^2$的均方误差。在强向内漂移情况下，与tamed Euler方案相比，该方案能使向错误方向移动的概率趋于消失。在MLMC框架下，通过一维随机Ginzburg-Landau模型，确定了路径wise斜对称方案的渐近方差优于tamed Euler方案的步长范围。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的路径wise斜对称离散化方法在模拟具有超线性漂移的SDEs方面是稳定且有效的，并且在MLMC框架下具有良好的计算效率。它在某些情况下比tamed Euler方案更优越，尤其是在强向内漂移的情况下。
AI.translation: 最近提出了一种新的鲁棒的弱近似模拟随机微分方程（SDEs）具有非全局Lipschitz漂移的方法，即斜对称离散化。本工作通过将噪声增量表示为斜正态分布并与驱动布朗运动增量耦合，开发了该方案的路径wise版本，从而使其能够用于多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架。在适当条件下，我们建立了$L^2$范数下1/2阶的强收敛性。随后，证明了相关的MLMC估计器的计算复杂度为$\	ext{O}(\	ext{ε}^{-2} (\	ext{log}(1/\	ext{ε}))^2)$，可以达到$\	ext{ε}^2$的均方误差。然后，我们解析地将所提出的方案与另一种鲁棒离散化基准——tamed Euler方案进行了比较。在强向内漂移的情况下，当当前状态远离稳定区域时，我们证明了向错误方向移动的概率在斜对称方案中趋于消失，而tamed Euler方案则以非平凡的概率进行此类移动。此外，在MLMC设置中，使用一维随机Ginzburg-Landau模型，我们确定了通过路径wise斜对称方案获得的耦合水平差的渐近方差小于通过tamed Euler方案获得的渐近方差的步长范围。在几个模型示例上的数值实验支持了强收敛的理论速率，并证明了所产生的MLMC在超线性漂移设置下的稳定性和有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于模拟具有超线性漂移的随机微分方程（SDEs）的路径wise斜对称离散化方法。该方法通过将噪声增量与布朗运动增量耦合，实现了1/2阶的强收敛性，并适用于多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）框架。与tamed Euler方案相比，该方法在强向内漂移的情况下具有更低的向错误方向移动的概率。数值实验证实了其理论收敛速率和MLMC估计器的稳定性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 随机微分方程, 斜对称离散化, 路径wise, 多层蒙特卡洛, 超线性漂移
AI.comments: 这项工作在SDEs的数值模拟领域取得了重要进展，特别是在处理具有挑战性的超线性漂移的情况下。路径wise斜对称离散化方法的提出及其在MLMC框架下的应用，为提高模拟精度和效率提供了新的途径。然而，文中提到的“适当条件”和“强向内漂移”等具体细节在摘要中未详述，这可能限制了对其适用范围的全面理解。此外，与tamed Euler方案的比较虽然展示了优势，但具体的性能提升幅度仍需通过更广泛的实验来验证。

title: Skew CRT codes and their decoding in poly skew metric
summary: In this paper, we introduce skew CRT codes and the poly-skew metric with associated error model, and we provide a decoding algorithm for this family of codes under the poly-skew metric.

AI.title_translation: Skew CRT码及其在poly-skew度量下的解码研究

AI.motivation: 旨在解决特定数学结构下的编码与纠错问题，通过引入新的度量和码字构造来提升解码效率或适应性。
AI.method: 引入skew CRT码概念，定义poly-skew度量及相关错误模型，并开发了针对该度量的专门解码算法。

AI.conclusion: 本文成功定义了skew CRT码及其poly-skew度量，并提出了一种有效的解码算法，为该类码的实用化奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们介绍了skew CRT码和具有相关错误模型的poly-skew度量，并为该类码在poly-skew度量下提供了一种解码算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的skew CRT码，引入了poly-skew度量及对应的错误模型，并设计了相应的解码算法。
AI.keywords: skew CRT码, poly-skew度量, 编码理论, 解码算法, 纠错码
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“skew CRT码”和“poly-skew度量”，为处理特定错误模型提供了一种新的代数编码理论框架，具有一定的理论创新性，但具体应用场景需进一步挖掘。

title: Large Language Models for Citation Function Classification
comments: Published at the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)
summary: Citation function classification plays a crucial role in understanding the relationships between scientific publications and advancing bibliometric analysis. This study presents one of the first comprehensive evaluations of multiple state-of-the-art (SOTA) large language models (LLMs) for citation function classification, achieving new SOTA results on the ACL-ARC dataset. We systematically compare five models (Mistral 7B, Orca 2-7B, LLaMA 3.1-8B, Falcon 7B, and SciBERT) across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning approaches. Our fine-tuned Falcon 7B model achieves a 73.3% macro F1 score on ACL-ARC, representing a significant improvement over previous methods. Additionally, we introduce AC3, a novel dataset featuring a seven-category annotation scheme that distinguishes between neutral acknowledgments and explicit evaluative stances (more opinion-oriented citations - criticizing, complimenting, contradicting). The dataset is implemented across four context extraction variants to systematically evaluate the impact of contextual scope on classification performance. We also provide detailed analysis of model performance, experimental configurations, and limitations to guide future research in this domain. To our knowledge, this is one of the first studies dedicated to comprehensive model comparison for citation function classification, addressing a gap identified in recent surveys.
comment: Published at the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)

AI.title_translation: 用于引文功能分类的大语言模型
AI.tldr: 本研究通过微调Falcon 7B模型在引文功能分类任务上取得了SOTA性能，并推出了全新的AC3七分类标注数据集，为学术文献分析提供了重要参考。
AI.motivation: 引文功能分类对理解文献关系和文献计量分析至关重要，但目前缺乏对前沿大语言模型在该任务上性能的全面对比研究。
AI.method: 系统对比了Mistral 7B、Orca 2-7B、LLaMA 3.1-8B、Falcon 7B和SciBERT五种模型，采用了零样本（zero-shot）、少样本（few-shot）和微调（fine-tuning）三种策略，并引入了包含七类标注方案的AC3数据集。
AI.result: 微调后的Falcon 7B模型在ACL-ARC数据集上达到73.3%的宏观F1得分，刷新了该任务的SOTA记录。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了微调LLM在引文功能分类任务上的有效性，特别是Falcon 7B模型取得了最优性能，并发布了AC3数据集以促进该领域的进一步发展。
AI.translation: 引文功能分类在理解科学出版物之间的关系和推进文献计量分析方面发挥着至关重要的作用。本研究对多种最先进（SOTA）的大语言模型（LLMs）在引文功能分类任务上的表现进行了首次全面评估，并在ACL-ARC数据集上取得了新的SOTA结果。我们系统地比较了五种模型（Mistral 7B、Orca 2-7B、LLaMA 3.1-8B、Falcon 7B和SciBERT）在零样本、少样本和微调方法下的表现。我们微调后的Falcon 7B模型在ACL-ARC上实现了73.3%的宏观F1得分，较以往方法有显著提升。此外，我们引入了AC3，这是一个包含七个类别标注方案的新数据集，用于区分中立确认与明确的评价立场（更倾向于观点导向的引用——如批评、赞美、反驳）。该数据集通过四种上下文提取变体实现，以系统评估上下文范围对分类性能的影响。我们还提供了关于模型性能、实验配置和局限性的详细分析，以指导该领域的未来研究。据我们所知，这是首批致力于引文功能分类模型综合对比的研究之一，解决了近期综述中提到的研究空白。
AI.summary: 本文全面评估了多种大语言模型在引文功能分类任务中的表现，通过微调Falcon 7B模型在ACL-ARC数据集上取得了新的SOTA结果。此外，作者构建了涵盖七类标注的AC3数据集，旨在通过分析不同上下文范围的影响，推动引文功能分类研究的深入发展。
AI.keywords: 引文功能分类, 大语言模型, ACL-ARC, 学术文献分析, AC3数据集
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统评估多种大语言模型在引文功能分类任务中的表现，填补了领域内的研究空白。其创新之处在于提出了AC3数据集，该数据集引入了更细致的七分类标注方案，有效区分了中立引用与评价性立场，为后续深入研究学术文献关系提供了宝贵的资源。

title: Semantically Similar, Logically Distinct: Diagnosing the Semantic-Answerability Gap in Table RAG
summary: Tables are a critical knowledge source in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but a retrieved table may lack sufficient evidence to answer a query, a property we call answerability. While answerability broadly concerns whether a source or collection of sources contains sufficient evidence, retrieval models optimized for semantic relevance do not guarantee it even in the single-source case, creating a fundamental mismatch. To study this, we introduce TCR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for Table Content-level Answerability in RAG, built around sibling tables, i.e., tables with highly similar schemas but subtle content differences. On TCR-Bench, the dense retrievers we evaluate persistently exhibit a Semantic-Answerability Gap: they often retrieve the correct sibling group yet struggle to pinpoint the uniquely answerable table within it, dropping QA performance from 0.755 (oracle) to 0.330 (top-5 retrieved). Our analysis suggests this gap is associated with semantic accumulation, schema-level cue dependence, and weak row-column binding. As a diagnostic probe into the source of this gap, we test whether a lightweight two-stage pipeline, Answerability-Aware Reranking (AAR), applying direct query-table answerability judgment, can recover performance: it raises top-1 target retrieval from 18.2% to 57.4%, and this large gain is itself evidence that much of the observed failure reflects a missing answerability verification step, rather than an inherent limitation of model capacity alone.

title: WuYu-EnvLE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Environmental Law Enforcement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for environmental enforcement, but their ability to produce traceable enforcement decisions remains unclear. We introduce WuYu-EnvLE-Bench, a benchmark built from real enforcement cases, regulatory standards, and expert review. It contains 2,521 benchmark instances, 14 tasks, and 12 pollution-medium subdomains across pre-enforcement, in-enforcement, and post-enforcement workflows. Using Absolute Environmental Enforcement Score (AES) and Intelligent Enforcement Index (IEI), we evaluate open-source and closed-source LLMs across capability, response quality, and resource efficiency. Results show that LLMs perform well on rule-bounded tasks but remain unreliable in evidence-chain construction, contradiction detection, multi-source integration, and procedural judgment. Model scaling also shows diminishing returns: medium-sized models approach leading models in structured tasks, while larger models do not reliably overcome evidence-reasoning bottlenecks. WuYu-EnvLE-Bench highlights the need for evidence-grounded, rule-aware, and task-adaptive enforcement reasoning.

title: Mobile Network Control with a World Model
summary: The increasing complexity of mobile networks necessitates intelligent and dynamic control strategies for efficient, energy-conserving management. We propose a world model-based approach for network control that enables adaptive configuration of crucial parameters. The world model is trained from historical data and predicts the impact of its actions on future network states. Our controller leverages the model's uncertainty estimate to robustly find optimal network configuration changes. Furthermore, the optimization objective can be changed dynamically without model retraining. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in simulated closed-loop control of a mobile network energy-saving feature. Our results show improved performance in balancing energy savings with quality of service, compared to traditional methods and reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, we show the world model performance on real network data from, and evaluate counterfactual actions proposed by the controller under various throughput constraints.

title: MagicSelector: Joint Optimization for Agent Tool Selection via Counterfactual Decomposition and Progressive Reranking
summary: We present MagicSelector, a joint optimization framework integrating Counterfactual task decomposition, Progressive reranking, and Dynamic Top-K, designed to address the fundamental challenges of tool retrieval in agents. MagicSelector is a specialized framework capable of translating ambiguous user instructions into executable atomic subtasks and guiding high-precision tool retrieval, effectively mitigating redundant noise and severe context distraction in out-of-domain (OOD) scenarios.We empower MagicSelector with these capabilities through three key contributions: (1) a preferenceguided counterfactual task decomposition mechanism that utilizes a counterfactual reward to quantify the marginal causal gain of decomposition on retrieval ranking, effectively imposing fine-grained structural supervision on logical coherence; (2) a progressive tool reranking method driven by self-distillation hard negative mining, which optimizes both point-wise and list-wise relevance to enhance fine-grained discrimination among highly similar tools; and (3) a dual semantic boundary-aware dynamic Top-K strategy that adaptively monitors reranking score cliffs and inter-tool semantic shifts to dynamically truncate the candidate list, maximizing relevant tool recall while filtering long-tail noise. Evaluated on MTDTool, the first task decomposition benchmark we constructed tailored for mobile multi-turn interactions with process-level annotations, MagicSelector yields promising performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MagicSelector significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of tool retrieval accuracy, OOD generalization capability, and overall token efficiency, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed framework.

title: DA-Fusion: Deformable Attention-Based RGB-D Fusion Transformer for Unseen Object Instance Segmentation
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025)
summary: In logistics automation, precise segmentation of unseen objects is crucial for efficient robotic manipulation in cluttered environments. Tasks such as bin-picking and shelf-picking require robust perception to handle occlusions, varying object shapes, and complex spatial arrangements. Traditional RGB-based methods tend to over-segment objects due to their reliance on texture, while depth-based methods often under-segment by focusing primarily on geometric features. To address these limitations, we propose DA-Fusion, a deformable attention-based RGB-D fusion Transformer designed for unseen object instance segmentation. DA-Fusion effectively combines the strengths of both RGB and depth data, enhancing segmentation accuracy in cluttered and multi-layered object environments. We also introduce the Object Clutter Bin Dataset (OCBD), a benchmark dataset specifically tailored for evaluating bin-picking scenarios in top-down views. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DA-Fusion outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse environments, making it particularly suited for real-world logistics tasks.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2025)

AI.title_translation: DA-Fusion：用于未见物体实例分割的基于可变形注意力的RGB-D融合Transformer
AI.tldr: 一种通过可变形注意力机制融合RGB-D数据的新型Transformer，显著提升了复杂物流环境下对未见物体的分割精度。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在处理遮挡、复杂空间排列和未见物体时，单纯依赖RGB或深度信息存在过分割或欠分割的问题，难以满足物流自动化中机器人抓取的需求。
AI.method: 提出DA-Fusion架构，利用可变形注意力机制实现RGB与深度数据的深度融合，并引入Object Clutter Bin Dataset (OCBD)数据集进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DA-Fusion在多种环境下均优于当前最先进的分割方法，证明了其在处理复杂遮挡和多样化物体时的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DA-Fusion通过融合RGB-D多模态数据和可变形注意力机制，有效解决了复杂物流环境下的未见物体实例分割问题，在实验中表现出优于现有最先进方法的性能。
AI.translation: 在物流自动化中，精确分割未见物体对于复杂环境下的机器人高效操作至关重要。箱式拣选和货架拣选等任务需要强大的感知能力来处理遮挡、不同的物体形状和复杂的空间排列。传统的基于RGB的方法由于依赖纹理往往会导致物体过分割，而基于深度的方法往往因为主要关注几何特征而导致欠分割。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了DA-Fusion，这是一种专为未见物体实例分割设计的基于可变形注意力的RGB-D融合Transformer。DA-Fusion有效地结合了RGB和深度数据的优势，提高了在杂乱和多层物体环境中的分割精度。我们还引入了对象杂乱箱数据集（OCBD），这是一个专门为评估自顶向下视图的箱式拣选场景而定制的基准数据集。广泛的评估表明，DA-Fusion在不同环境中的表现优于最先进的方法，使其特别适合现实世界的物流任务。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于可变形注意力的RGB-D融合Transformer（DA-Fusion），旨在提升物流场景中未见物体实例分割的精度。通过结合RGB纹理与深度几何信息，并配合新构建的OCBD数据集，该模型有效提升了机器人对复杂堆叠物体的感知能力。
AI.keywords: 未见物体分割, RGB-D融合, 可变形注意力, 物流自动化, 实例分割
AI.comments: 该论文针对物流自动化领域中未见物体分割的难点，巧妙结合了RGB的纹理信息与深度数据的几何信息。其创新点在于引入了可变形注意力机制（Deformable Attention）来优化跨模态特征融合，并提出了针对性的OCBD数据集，具有很强的实际应用价值。

title: Seg2Grasp: A Robust Modular Suction Grasping in Bin Picking
comments: 7 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Published in the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2024)
summary: Current bin picking methods that rely heavily on end-to-end learning often falter when confronted with unfamiliar or complex objects in unstructured environments. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Seg2Grasp, a modular pipeline designed for robust suction grasping in dynamic and cluttered bin scenarios. Seg2Grasp is built on a three-step process: Segmentation, Grasping, and Classification. The Segmentation module employs a Transformer-based model to generate class-agnostic object masks from RGB-D images, ensuring accurate detection across various conditions. The Grasping module uses surface normals and mask proposals to determine the optimal suction points, enhancing grasp success. Finally, the Classification module leverages fine-tuned open-vocabulary Mask-CLIP for precise object identification, enabling versatile handling of diverse objects. Real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that Seg2Grasp outperforms existing methods in success rates and adaptability, establishing it as a powerful tool for automated bin picking in industrial settings.
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Published in the 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2024)

title: Towards Reliable Zero-Shot Crowd Forecasting: Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models for Special Event Pedestrian Forecasting
comments: 9 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for presentation at IEEE ITSC 2026
summary: Managing massive crowds during infrequent special events requires reliable real-time pedestrian-flow forecasting to ensure public safety and operational efficiency. However, supervised forecasting methods face limitations in these contexts due to scarce historical data, heterogeneous data distributions, and short in-event observation windows. To effectively support operational decision-making, forecasts should provide not only accurate point estimates but also informative predictive uncertainty. Probabilistic uncertainty quantification plays a critical role in this aspect, particularly capturing sudden volatility and tail risks. This paper investigates pretrained time series foundation models as a lightweight approach for zero-shot probabilistic forecasting without extensive local retraining. Using decision-oriented metrics tailored to short events, we conduct a comprehensive assessment of two time series foundation models on crowd forecasting, with the SAIL2025 event as a use case. We then distill practical insights for crowd managers, specifying when zero-shot forecasts remain operationally reliable.
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for presentation at IEEE ITSC 2026

title: Generalize and Guide: Decomposing Rewards for Few-Shot Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) provides a powerful framework for learning from demonstrations. However, real-world tasks often exhibit substantial natural variations (e.g., picking up mugs with varying shapes), making it impractical to collect demonstrations that fully specify a new task under every possible scenario. In practice, while demonstrations for the target task are limited, it is often easier to obtain datasets of heterogeneous but related behaviors. This motivates the problem of few-shot IRL with multi-task demonstrations (FM-IRL), where an agent must learn a new task with substantial variations from only a limited number of target-task demonstrations, together with sufficient demonstrations of related tasks and online agent experience. To do so, we must both recover the expert distribution of the new task and provide guidance when the agent deviates from it. We introduce Multitask discriminator Proximity-Guided IRL (MPG), which learns two complementary reward components: (1) a generalizable discriminator that transfers shared structure across related tasks to identify expert behavior in a new task, and (2) a proximity function that measures how far a state deviates from expert behavior and provides corrective guidance during exploration. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on multiple challenging navigation and manipulation tasks under significant variations (e.g., object configurations, table layouts, and initial robot poses), achieving an average success rate of 81.2%, outperforming the strongest per-task baseline by an average of 24.7 percentage points.

title: Time-Frequency Consistency Learning for Robust Speech Deepfake Detection
summary: Recently, speech deepfake detection (SDD) has achieved significant progress. However, its robustness evaluation remains largely confined to controlled additive noise scenarios, lacking systematic investigation of the complex distortions introduced by acoustic front-end (AFE) processing pipelines in real-world deployments. In this work, we simulate a unified AFE pipeline comprising acoustic echo cancellation, noise suppression, automatic gain control, and voice activity detection (VAD), and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of current state-of-the-art models. The results show that the nonlinear and time-frequency coupled distortions introduced by AFE significantly degrade detection performance. To address this issue, we propose a Time-Frequency Consistency Learning (TFCL) framework, which aims to learn invariant spoofing representations that remain stable before and after AFE processing. We observe that AFE not only introduces temporal misalignment (e.g., segment-level shifts caused by VAD), but also weakens or distorts critical frequency-domain cues. To this end, TFCL employs an attention-driven soft alignment mechanism to capture cross-temporal dependencies, along with frequency-domain structural consistency constraints to enforce feature invariance. As a result, the model is able to maintain stable representations under both temporal perturbations and spectral distortions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively mitigates the performance degradation caused by AFE processing, significantly improving the robustness of SDD in real-world scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/JunXue-tech/TFCL.

title: Autonomous Discovery of Wireless Communications Algorithms
summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is an emerging algorithm-discovery paradigm that has already produced novel results in several scientific fields. Yet its application to wireless communications remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce The AI Telco Engineer (AITE), a framework to autonomously design algorithms for complex communication problems, while navigating performance-complexity tradeoffs. We showcase AITE on two challenging physical-layer problems: designing an equalizer for an orthogonal time-frequency space (OTFS) system, and constructing a receiver algorithm for an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) system using a custom constellation and operating without pilots. For the first task, AITE develops algorithms that outperform the best-known solutions while reducing computational latency by a factor of 3.6 compared to the strongest baseline. For the second task, it discovers the first explicit, explainable algorithms that achieve performance parity with state-of-the-art neural receivers. These results demonstrate the strong potential of LLM-driven evolutionary search for the autonomous discovery of next-generation wireless communications algorithms.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 as a Contamination-Free Benchmark for LLM Forecasting Agents: Four Models, a Bookmaker, and 104 Matches
summary: We introduce WC2026-Agents, a benchmark and dataset for evaluating large language models (LLMs) as autonomous forecasting agents on real, future events. For every one of the 104 matches of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, four frontier models -- Claude Opus 4.8, ChatGPT (GPT-5.5, high reasoning), Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Grok (Expert Mode) -- ran an identical search-act-reflect loop: gather evidence with a web tool, commit to a 1X2 (team-A win / draw / team-B win) distribution and a virtual 100-USD bet, and, after the match, reflect given only the final score. Because every match kicked off after the models' training cutoffs, the benchmark is contamination-free by construction. Crucially, we pair the four agents with a fifth competitor drawn from the same information environment -- the pre-match betting market -- collected as per-match 1X2 odds, giving an economically grounded baseline and letting us score not just what an agent predicts but what it does with money. The release contains 416 forecasts and 414 reflections with verbatim reasoning, ground truth (including penalty shootouts), odds, and a reproducible evaluation suite. A reference evaluation surfaces findings that raw accuracy hides: the four agents issue an identical top pick in 92% of matches and none beats the market's Brier score; indeed, a naive flat stake on the market favorite out-earns all four agents. Yet the agents diverge sharply as decision-makers: betting return-on-investment ranges from -18% to +10%, fading the market is unprofitable for all four, the share of forecasts that cite the market ranges from 12% to 100%, and self-reported error rates on wrong picks range from 36% to 86%. The benchmark thus measures calibration, decision quality, and self-knowledge -- axes on which frontier models differ even when their predictions do not. Data and code: https://github.com/graphuofm/FIFA2026LLM

title: When to Use Extra Context: Evidence-Grounded Terminology Adaptation for Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Extra context is valuable for simultaneous speech translation of technical talks, but injecting the entire document context into every streaming segment is often too coarse. Through diagnostic experiments, we find that context gains mainly come from paper-specific terminology recovery rather than uniform semantic enhancement. We therefore propose EGTA, an Evidence-Grounded Terminology Adaptation framework that builds a document terminology memory, selects compact candidate terms conditioned on the current streaming state, and adapts ASR/speech-side and decoder-side decision spaces using only the selected terms. EGTA can be instantiated in cascaded, end-to-end, and generation-only SimulST settings without full-model fine-tuning. We evaluate EGTA on an ACL technical-talk SimulST evaluation suite consisting of MCIF-dev and ACL60/60-dev. On MCIF-dev, EGTA-RG improves BLEU by +1.05/+0.59, XCOMET-XL by +0.019/+0.006, named-entity recall by +79\%/+73\% relative, and acronym recall by +0.099/+0.171 on En$\rightarrow$Zh and En$\rightarrow$De. Across MCIF-dev latency settings, EGTA consistently improves XCOMET-XL, named-entity recall, and acronym recall. External validation on ACL60/60-dev further shows consistent terminology-recall gains without additional fine-tuning. Shuffled-memory controls and activation audits provide evidence that the improvements are tied to paper-specific evidence alignment rather than generic context prompting.

title: VLN-AVP: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation with Hybrid Long-Short-Term Memory for Autonomous Valet Parking
summary: Existing methods in Autonomous Valet Parking (AVP) typically rely on pre-built maps, which severely restricts their scalability to unseen environments and open-vocabulary targets. Inspired by the application of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks, we propose VLN-AVP, a zero-shot navigation framework for AVP tasks. By combining the precise spatial perception of a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) model with the general intelligence of VLMs, our framework 1) eliminates the dependency on pre-built maps, 2) interprets semantic environmental contexts in parking scenarios, and 3) enables intuitive navigation following natural language instructions. Specifically, we introduce a hybrid memory system: a short-term perception memory tracks semantic visual cues to address the limitations of VLM's single-frame reasoning in existing methods, while a long-term topological memory facilitates stable policy learning from past experiences. To bridge the gap in existing benchmarks, we also present the VLN-AVP dataset and benchmark. Featuring 10 high-fidelity parking scenes and over 1,000 navigation episodes, it has the largest number of garage scenes to date and is the first VLN benchmark for underground parking. Extensive experiments demonstrate that in simulation, our method achieves an over 25% improvement in success rate compared to VLN methods and an over 15% improvement compared to other autonomous driving methods. Furthermore, it attains a leading success rate in real-world vehicle experiments, proving its practical feasibility.

title: To Blend In, First Decouple: Rethinking Camouflage Image Generation via Context-Decoupled Representations
summary: Camouflage image generation (CIG) focuses on generating visually concealed objects that seamlessly blend into their backgrounds. Existing methods typically follow either background-guided paradigms that adapt object appearance via style transfer, or foreground-guided strategies that outpaint surrounding regions conditioned on object features. However, they still suffer from appearance discrepancy and background artifacts. We attribute these limitations to cross-context representation leakage, where object and background cues are entangled in a coupled conditional space, resulting in ambiguous control and degraded camouflage fidelity. To tackle this, we propose a new context-decoupled generative paradigm, termed CamoDreamer, which aims to isolate contextual conditional guidance and explicitly decouple latent camouflage features into coordinated object and background control streams. First, a Contrast-aware Contextual Bridge is designed to model cross-context discrepancies and construct contrast-aware dual conditional guidance. Second, Context-Decoupled Assimilation Streams are employed to separate generative interactions conditioned on the dual guidance, while facilitating background rendering with target-aware cues in the latent space. Finally, a Frequency-Adaptive Contextual Blend module integrates complementary high-frequency textures and low-frequency structures from decoupled features to improve holistic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamoDreamer consistently outperforms existing methods with a substantial margin, while maintaining a relatively lightweight design.

title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
summary: Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. While such artifacts may be tolerated in offline rendering, they become critical in humanoid execution as they lead to infeasible inverse-kinematics (IK) solutions, collisions, and unstable retargeted trajectories. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. First, we introduce a volumetric SMPL-X collision-mitigation module that projects generated signing motions toward physically plausible configurations while minimally deviating from the original trajectory. Second, we propose a vision-language-guided retargeting algorithm built on an IK backbone: a VLM serves as a visual critic over rendered humanoid motion, identifies embodiment-specific failure modes, and triggers targeted task-space corrections. Our results highlight collision handling and perception-guided refinement as key missing components for reliable humanoid signing.

title: Measuring Monosemanticity in Sparse Autoencoders via Latent Activation Coherence
comments: This is a preprint version. A shorter version of this paper has been accepted for presentation and publication in the post-workshop proceedings of the 8th International Workshop on eXplainable Knowledge Discovery in Data Mining (XKDD 2026), co-located with ECML PKDD 2026. The appendix is included only in this preprint and is not part of the peer-reviewed proceedings paper
summary: Within Explainable Artificial Intelligence, mechanistic interpretability uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract more interpretable features from neural representations. However, assessing their monosemanticity, and thus explanation quality, remains challenging. Existing metrics require external concept labels or depend on pretrained embedding models, making them sensitive to encoder's geometry. We introduce the Tversky Monosemanticity Score (TMS), a label-free metric that operationalizes monosemanticity as activation-set coherence of binarized SAE latents, and does not require external embedding encoders. We evaluate TMS on SAEs trained on features from pretrained vision and vision-language models (DINOv3, CLIP, BLIP2), two common SAE regimes (TopK, BatchTopK), multiple sparsity levels, and expansion factors. Our results show that TMS is less affected by encoder anisotropy than its embedding-based alternative, while remaining aligned with established monosemanticity indicators. TMS also reveals distinct SAE training dynamics across base models. Moreover, under encoder anisotropy, TMS provides a stronger indication of probe-based concept deletion effectiveness, while being competitive otherwise.

title: Polar Coordinate-based Differential Evolution for Moving Target Search Using Vision Sensor on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: In search and rescue operations, there is a period known as the "golden time" during which the probability of finding the target alive is highest. The objective of this work is to propose a new search algorithm for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) with a focus on improving the detection probability and execution time. We approach this problem by first modeling target dynamics as a Markov process and the detection likelihood as a function of image quality and the observer's vision. We then employ Bayesian theory to derive a fitness function representing the probability distribution of the target's location over the search area. Finally, we introduce a new algorithm named polar coordinate-based differential evolution (PDE) to generate a UAV search path that maximizes this fitness function. The PDE algorithm utilizes polar coordinates to incorporate kinematic constraints and maneuver properties of the UAV, allowing for better exploration of the solution space. A series of simulations and comparative analyses have been conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithm. Experiments involving a real UAV have also been conducted. Results demonstrate that the PDE algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of detection probability and execution time across diverse search scenarios while remaining practical for real-world applications. The source code of the algorithm is available at https://github.com/thuhangkhuat/PDE_target_search.

title: FillGauss: Fine-Grained Filling-Aware Impact Sound Generation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Synthesizing physically plausible impact sounds from visual observations remains a great challenge in multi-modal AI. Existing 3D-aware audio generation methods primarily model the surface geometry of hollow rigid bodies. However, they fundamentally overlook internal filling states, a critical physical factor that drastically modulates acoustic resonance and damping. To address this issue, we have defined a new task called Fine-Grained Filling-Aware Impact Sound Generation. As a foundational step, we first introduce the fine-grained fill-aware dataset (FillImpact), a pioneering multi-modal collection comprising over 5,000 rigorous acoustic recordings from 88 diverse real-world objects. It captures impact interactions with varying internal contents (i.e., water, rice), a continuous range of fill levels, and distinct striker materials. Furthermore, comprehensive acoustic analysis confirms that the collected data closely aligns with established physical laws governing acoustic resonance and damping, indicating its suitability for physically grounded modeling. Building on this dataset, we propose a novel generative framework (FillGauss) that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with internal state conditioning for sound generation. By fusing 3DGS geometric features, precise 3D spatial strike coordinates, and fine-grained textual physical conditions within a latent diffusion architecture, FillGauss enables position-aware, striker-aware, and filling-aware audio generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach could generate high-fidelity impact sounds that adhere to underlying physical principles, establishing a new state-of-the-art for physically grounded cross-modal audio generation.

title: Persona-as-Configuration: Generative Stakeholder Reporting for Agricultural Floods
comments: Accepted at CASA 2026 (9th Workshop on Context-Aware, Autonomous and Smart Architectures), co-located with ECSA 2026. 16 pages, 2 figures
summary: Cyber-physical systems built on deterministic edge inference, such as on-vehicle flood detection for agricultural fields, produce structured decision logs that must be interpreted differently by heterogeneous stakeholders. Pairing such systems with large language models (LLMs) to generate stakeholder-specific reports introduces a tension: the generative layer is non-deterministic, while the edge plane must remain replayable and auditable. We propose an architectural pattern resting on two invariants: unidirectional consumption, in which the generative layer is a strict read-only consumer of the deterministic plane and never writes back, and persona-as-configuration, in which stakeholder adaptation is a versioned prompt-template artifact rather than runtime improvisation. We instantiate the pattern as a context-aware dashboard layer over the JSON decision logs of a previously published edge-based standing-water detection system, and analyse how the integration boundary admits standard generative-reliability mitigations as configuration- or middleware-level extension points. A structured expert review rated the pattern favourably across five ISO/IEC 25010-aligned quality dimensions, with strongest agreement on separation of concerns. End-user evaluation with agricultural stakeholders is planned for future work.

title: CDIS: Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation via 2D Mask Tracking and 3D-2D Projection Merging
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures. Published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation is critical for robotic systems operating in unknown environments, enabling perception of previously unseen objects for reliable manipulation and navigation. Existing approaches typically project per-frame 2D instance masks into 3D and merge them, which often breaks object identities across time and yields fragmented 3D instances. We introduce Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation (CDIS), a zero-shot framework that explicitly tracks 2D instance masks across frames and associates them with 3D superpoints, creating a feedback loop between 2D and 3D. This cross-dimensional reasoning links temporally stable 2D tracks with spatially coherent 3D regions, producing globally consistent 3D instance labels without any 3D-specific training. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CDIS achieves higher accuracy and consistency than state-of-the-art zero-shot methods, while remaining efficient and scalable to diverse real-world environments.

title: Dynamic Defense Profiling Enables Cognitive Jailbreak of Text-to-Image Models
summary:
Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing high-quality visual content, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial misuse, particularly in generating Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) images. Most existing jailbreak attacks primarily rely on heuristic prompt engineering or black-box optimization, treating model feedback as a binary signal (success or failure). This coarse-grained paradigm overlooks the rich information embedded in diverse failure modes, such as textual refusal, visual blocking, and semantic sanitization, resulting in inefficient exploration and severe semantic collapse.
  In this paper, we propose MIND, a cognitive jailbreak framework that reframes adversarial prompt generation as a belief-state inference problem over latent defense mechanisms. Instead of blindly searching for bypass prompts, MIND actively models the target system's latent defense mechanisms by interpreting multi-modal feedback as high-density signals. Specifically, the framework integrates three core components: (1) a Multi-modal Judge for fine-grained feedback decomposition, (2) a Defense Profiler for iterative belief updating, and (3) a Meta-Memory module for retrieving historically effective attack strategies. These components are unified within a reasoning-driven evolutionary optimization process, enabling adaptive and semantically consistent jailbreak generation. Extensive experiments on the I2P benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of MIND. Under six representative pre-processing and post-processing defense settings applied to the Stable Diffusion v1.5 model, MIND achieves an Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 95.62%, significantly outperforming existing methods. Additionally, the effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated across four widely used commercial T2I systems, achieving the highest ASR of 91.58% on Wan-2.5.

title: ETAS: An Effect-Typed Language for Agent Systems
summary:
ETAS is a programming language for agent systems that treats model-backed agents, tool calls, prompts, typed memory, human approvals, policies, and execution traces as semantic program elements rather than library conventions. It separates deterministic computation from agentic nondeterminism and externally visible actions while preserving a direct programming style.
  We present the core design of ETAS. Its static semantics assigns ordinary types through spec conformance and tracks each computation with two behavioral indices: an escaping effect row and a persistent abstraction of the typed action trace it may request. Specs form a terminating compile-time constraint calculus: type specs provide evidence for polymorphism and resource facts, callable specs constrain function and stage shapes, and trace specs express allow, deny, and temporal constraints. Typing checks requested traces against compiled monitors and emits residual obligations when dynamic resources preclude a complete static proof. The dynamic semantics distinguish requested, handled, denied, and committed events; handlers interpret typed actions without making their requests invisible to authorization or audit.
  We formalize a core calculus and state preservation, progress, type/effect soundness, handler trace-transparency, and policy safety. We also implement ETAS in Rust with a command-line interface, typed HIR checks, effect and policy diagnostics, handler checks, and trace-aware execution hooks. ETAS provides a programming-language foundation for reasoning about authorization, nondeterminism, recovery, and audit evidence before and during agent execution.
