title: Q-VGM: Q-Value-Gradient Matching for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning of Flow-Matching VLA
summary: We propose Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching (Q-VGM), an off-policy reinforcement learning method for a central difficulty in fine-tuning flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies: improving an expressive flow-matching action expert with a learned $Q$-function. Effective improvement must exploit the critic's first-order signal $\nabla_A Q$, yet flow policies make this hard: backpropagating values through the multi-step denoising chain is unstable at VLA scale, and the tractable action likelihoods required by policy gradients are unavailable under iterative denoising. Existing value-based methods therefore backpropagate through the full chain, use the critic only for test-time selection or guidance, or distill critic-improved actions as terminal labels that never supervise the velocity field. Q-VGM instead casts policy improvement as optimal control over the denoising dynamics, where the optimal residual velocity is the gradient of a denoising-time value function: clean-action estimates improved by iterative $Q$-gradient ascent with keep-best selection are converted into residual velocity targets that directly supervise the velocity field -- no action likelihoods, no backpropagation through the denoising chain, fully offline on a fixed replay buffer, and no critic at inference time. The critic is an action-sensitive stepwise IQL critic on compact latent states from the frozen VLA backbone. This enables a few-shot-initialization, learn-from-experience paradigm: starting from a few-shot-SFT $π_{0.5}$ policy, Q-VGM improves the policy from its own rollouts without additional expert supervision, raising the average LIBERO success rate from 79.0% to 92.5%, outperforming all same-backbone, same-critic baselines, and attaining high success rates on four real-robot manipulation tasks, including fine-grained plug insertion.

title: From Text to Discovery: How Large Language Models Are Reshaping Research Across Scientific and Humanistic Disciplines
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly reshaping academic research across the natural sciences, social sciences, and humanities, yet the scientific community lacks a comprehensive, cross-disciplinary account of how these tools are being integrated, what they deliver, and where they fall short. This paper addresses that gap by mapping their current state and outlining an agenda for their responsible integration into scientific research. Our analysis reveals a consistent pattern: LLMs meaningfully accelerate research workflows -- from hypothesis generation and literature synthesis to data analysis and scientific writing -- while introducing serious challenges related to hallucination, reproducibility, dataset bias, and model opacity. Beyond technical limitations, we identify ten underexplored challenges, including the erosion of researcher autonomy, AI-driven confirmation bias, authorship ambiguity, and unequal access to these technologies -- systemic risks that demand interdisciplinary governance frameworks, robust validation standards, and expanded explainability research.

title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
comments: Technical report. 11 pages. Code and model available at https://github.com/libertywing/FlashMemory-Deepseek-V4 and https://huggingface.co/libertywing/FlashMemory-Deepseek-V4
summary:
Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose \textbf{Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)}, a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate this architecture via a \textbf{backbone-free decoupled training} strategy. By formulating the indexer as a standard dual-encoder architecture, we train it independently using standard retrieval training frameworks without ever loading the massive backbone model into GPU memory.
  We demonstrate that this ``less is more'' paradigm significantly maximizes serving efficiency while acting as an effective attention denoiser in tasks that rely on long-term global memory. Across primary long-context evaluation suites (e.g., LongBench-v2, LongMemEval, and RULER), \texttt{FM-DS-V4} compresses the average physical KV cache footprint down to merely 13.5\% of the full-context baseline, while consistently preserving or slightly elevating downstream accuracy (+0.6\% absolute margin on average). At 1M context, per-decode-token compute drops to 0.30$\times$ of the baseline and GPU KV cache shrinks by 90\% (3.73$\to$0.37 GB), translating into \textbf{2.8$\times$ aggregate throughput and 2.7$\times$ concurrency gains} in PD-disaggregated serving on 8$\times$H20 GPUs.
comment: Technical report. 11 pages. Code and model available at https://github.com/libertywing/FlashMemory-Deepseek-V4 and https://huggingface.co/libertywing/FlashMemory-Deepseek-V4

title: DECIS: Dual-Evidence Corrective Verification for Interpretable Strabismus Diagnostic Decision-Making
summary: Strabismus is a common ocular disorder that requires fine-grained subtype diagnosis for individualized treatment planning. However, existing deep learning methods mainly provide diagnostic predictions without transparent reasoning, while recent large vision-language models (LVLMs), although promising for joint image understanding and report generation, remain highly prone to hallucination in this evidence-sensitive and rule-driven medical task. To address these challenges, we propose DECIS, a Dual-Evidence Corrective verification for Interpretable Strabismus diagnostic decision-making framework. DECIS transforms black-box end-to-end generation into a structured diagnostic process consisting of candidate hypothesis generation, dual-evidence constrained context, evidence-based corrective verification, and report generation. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-Evidence Constrained Context (DECC) mechanism that jointly organizes visual evidence from the photograph of the nine cardinal positions of gaze and evidence-based clinical diagnostic rules into a constrained context for reliable diagnostic reasoning. We further develop an Evidence-Based Corrective Verification (EBCV) mechanism that verifies whether the current diagnostic hypothesis is supported by visual evidence, heatmap-based visual cues, and evidence-based clinical diagnostic rules. Hypothesis refinement is triggered when inconsistency is detected. Experiments on a fine-grained strabismus benchmark demonstrate that DECIS not only outperforms other state-of-the-art diagnostic systems, improving the weighted F1 score from 72.0% to 91.3%, but also improves the clinical reliability (consistency, alignment, and completeness) of generated diagnostic reports. These results demonstrate that DECIS provides an effective solution for building accurate, evidence-based, and clinically interpretable strabismus diagnosis systems.

title: SemDINO: DINOv3-Guided Cross-Temporal Semantic Alignment Network for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Semantic change detection (SCD) in remote sensing aims to identify land-cover transitions between bi-temporal observations while suppressing pseudo-changes caused by illumination variations, seasonal differences, and registration errors. Although Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide transferable semantic priors, their application to SCD remains challenging due to the mismatch between foundation-model representations and task-specific spatial features, as well as temporal-order sensitivity. To address these issues, this paper proposes SemDINO, an alignment-driven framework that integrates DINOv3 priors with hierarchical convolutional representations for cross-temporal semantic reasoning. Specifically, a Gated Pyramid Fusion (PyFu) module is developed to adaptively combine foundation-model semantics with CNN spatial details while reducing domain noise. A Multi-scale Temporal Bi-directional Transformer (M-TBTT) is introduced to achieve symmetric cross-temporal feature interaction and alleviate temporal-order bias. Furthermore, a Feature Change Enhancement (FeaCE) flow is designed to refine aligned representations and distinguish genuine semantic transitions from pseudo variations. Finally, a multi-branch decoupled prediction head jointly generates change masks, bi-temporal semantic maps, and edge constraints. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that SemDINO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both semantic and binary change detection tasks. The results validate the effectiveness of alignment-oriented representation learning for robust remote sensing change analysis. The code will be available in \textcolor{brown}{\textbf{https://github.com/tonxycs/SemDINO}}

title: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression
summary: Interactive video world models commonly convert bidirectional video generators into causal autoregressive systems through control fine-tuning, autoregressive training, causal initialization, and few-step distillation. This pipeline is costly, while frozen causal histories accumulate errors that degrade long-horizon fidelity and controllability. We present BiWM, the first open-source full-stack training framework for bidirectional autoregressive video world models. BiWM retains full attention within each generated chunk and requires only two stages: camera/action-control fine-tuning and few-step Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD). Both stages converge within a few hundred optimizer steps on 8 H200 GPUs. The framework supports Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, HunyuanVideo-1.5-TI2V-8B, and LTX-2.3-22B, together with real-world camera control, pluggable long-history compression, and optional low-bit deployment. Supervised and forward-KL anchors mitigate DMD mode collapse and preserve scene dynamics. BiWM provides a compact, reproducible path from pretrained bidirectional video models to interactive, controllable, and efficient world models.

title: High-Speed Generation of Periodic Traffic Patterns on P4TG for DDoS and Burst-Load Evaluation
comments: Accepted for publication at 12th IEEE International Conference on Network Softwarization (NetSoft 2026)
summary: Traffic generators are essential tools for evaluating the robustness and performance of networked systems. P4TG is an open-source, hardware-accelerated traffic generator implemented in P4 for the Intel Tofino ASIC. It has been adopted by researchers and industry due to its flexibility and multi-terabit generation capability, and its low cost compared to other traffic generators. However, like most existing generators, it primarily produces constant bit rate traffic, which does not reflect the highly time-varying behavior observed in real networks, such as flashcrowds and microbursts. Such patterns are difficult to emulate at scale with current tools. We present a data plane mechanism for P4TG that shapes periodic, time-varying traffic patterns, including patterns representative of DDoS attacks and burst-load scenarios. Pattern shaping in P4TG can be applied to its generated traffic at an aggregate throughput of up to 4 Tbit/s. We evaluate pattern accuracy and analyze scalability across different sampling resolutions and periods. Further, we demonstrate practical use cases, including zero-loss throughput determination and buffer capacity measurement. Finally, we present microburst-based attack scenarios that overload UDP receivers, switch buffers, and degrade TCP throughput on shared links while remaining undetectable to conventional rate monitoring.
comment: Accepted for publication at 12th IEEE International Conference on Network Softwarization (NetSoft 2026)

title: RoVE: Rotary Value Embeddings Attention for Relative Position-dependent Value Pathways
summary: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) make attention scores position-relative but leave the value pathway position-blind: the message sent by a value token is the same regardless of its distance from the query. We propose RoVE, a parameter-free modification that makes values position-sensitive by rotating them simultaneously with keys, and show that it turns RoPE attention into attentive convolution. This new perspective unifies several independent formulations of the same operation across computer vision, robotics, and modern LLM architectures. Trained 124M and 354M GPT-2 models show consistent empirical gains over RoPE on few-shot in-context learning, out-of-distribution perplexity, and long-context retrieval, with the clearest improvements on tasks that require long-range aggregation.

title: HairPort: In-context 3D-aware Hair Import and Transfer for Images
comments: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/
summary: Transferring hairstyles between images is an important but challenging task in computer graphics, computer vision, and visual effects. It enables users to explore new looks without physically altering their hair, with applications in virtual try-on systems, augmented reality, and entertainment. Most prior works operate best under small pose gaps, and they fall short under large viewpoint and scale differences, where missing hair content must be synthesized rather than transferred. We propose HairPort, a 3D-aware hairstyle transfer framework that attempts to solve these issues by explicitly separating hair removal from transfer and enforcing geometric consistency before synthesis. We introduce a Bald Converter, which produces realistic bald versions of faces through LoRA-based in-context adaptation of FLUX.1 Kontext. To train our Bald Converter, we introduce a new dataset, Baldy, containing 6,000 paired bald and original images across diverse identities and conditions. We also use a 3D-Aware Transfer Pipeline that reconstructs and re-renders the reference hairstyle from the target viewpoint before compositing it onto the source image. Being 3D aware, our method supports large pose and scale discrepancies between the source and target. Finally, a conditional flow-matching generator synthesizes the transferred result from the bald source and geometry-aligned reference guidance. Together, our method enables accurate, pose-consistent, and identity-preserving hairstyle transfer, outperforming existing methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/

title: Interpretable Factor Decomposition for Decision Intelligence in Large-Scale Financial Markets: Evidence from China's A-Share Market
summary: We present an interpretable machine learning pipeline to decompose cross-sectional equity return predictability into auditable factor contributions. We apply an XGBoost model with TreeSHAP attribution and conduct stress testing on 3,632 Chinese A-share stocks from 2009 until 2019. On prediction, using 60-month rolling windows over 55 months of out-of-sample data, XGBoost obtains a mean AUC of 0.547 (rank IC = 0.119) and +2.38%/month (Newey-West t = 5.94; annualized Sharpe 2.23) long-short spread for the top vs bottom quintiles. This alpha is persistent after adjusting for the Carhart four-factor model (+2.31%/month; t = 7.48). On interpretation, SHAP decomposition indicates that behavioral signals (turnover and momentum) account for 58.2% of predictive attribution compared to 10.7% for valuation ratios, on average, across 50 industry groups. Ablation analysis serves to cross-validate this ranking and provides evidence that SHAP and ablation diverge in a manner that highlights feature substitutability structure that is largely invisible to either method used in isolation.

title: GenHOI: Contact-Aware Humanoid-Object Interaction by Imitating Generated Videos without Task-Specific Training
summary: Humanoid-Object Interaction (HOI) is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots, yet it remains challenging due to the tight coupling between dynamic balance and stable interaction with diverse objects. Existing methods often require time-consuming task-specific policy training or rely on rigid trajectory replay, which limits their ability to accommodate novel interaction scenarios. In this work, we present \textit{GenHOI}, a simple yet effective framework that enables humanoid robots to perform diverse object-interaction tasks in a zero-shot manner by directly imitating a single generated video, without task-specific training or physical demonstration data. GenHOI first reconstructs the robot-object scene in simulation and renders a first-frame image, which, together with the language command, conditions the synthesis of a task-oriented interaction video. The generated video is then analyzed to identify interaction-relevant contact events and estimate hand-object contact regions, which are encoded as object-centric geometric constraints that convert visual interaction cues into physically grounded optimization priors. Guided by these priors, the reference motion recovered from the video is refined and smoothed to resolve the scale ambiguity inherent in 2D video generation, while adapting a single reference trajectory to unseen robot-object relative poses. The optimized trajectory is finally executed by a closed-loop tracking controller. We validate the proposed framework in extensive simulation and real-world experiments across diverse object-interaction tasks, including box grasping, asymmetric bimanual chair carrying, table lifting from below, and cylindrical-object enveloping.

title: Physics-Guided Spatiotemporal Learning for Coastal Wave Peak Period Estimation from Video
summary: Direct estimation of physically interpretable periodic signals from raw video constitutes a spatiotemporally grounded learning problem that proves to be difficult especially when facing label sparsity, lack of physical grounding and standardization benchmarks. The wave monitoring at coastal sites is one such real-world example where current deep learning approaches for estimating wave parameters using video as input suffer from physical interpretability and require some kind of intermediate data processing. In this study we propose a framework for wave peak period estimation using only video as input through three components: automated region-of-interest detection using temporal pixel variance, multi-stage Sim-to-Real transfer learning process, and physics-guided regularization of the output predictions. Various spatiotemporal architectures, including Transformer and recurrent-convolutional were compared during the stages of synthetic pretraining, silver label adaptation, and expert fine-tuning. It has been found out that LtViViT achieves the highest accuracy in its estimates, while TinyWaveNet shows superior temporal stability and oceanographic skill. Additionally, ablation studies have demonstrated that physics-guided regularization helps to follow the trends in predictions more consistently and prevent physically meaningless predictions. Moreover, Grad-CAM-based explainability analysis of the physics-guided TinyWaveNet showed that its spatial focus aligns with hydrodynamically active surf-zone regions. Overall, the findings support physics-guided, video-based deep learning as a cost-effective and operationally viable approach for long-term coastal wave monitoring, and demonstrate a transferable strategy for physically-constrained spatiotemporal regression from video under data-scarce conditions.

title: From Traditional Automation to Embodied Wireless Intelligence: Vision-Language-Action Empowered Physics-Aware Communication Networks
summary: Wireless network automation has progressed from rule-based self-organising networks (SON) to data-driven optimisation, yet existing systems remain fundamentally disembodied. They act on performance indicators without perceiving the physical environment that governs radio propagation. We propose the embodied intelligent empowered base station (eBS), a paradigm that adopts a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) pipeline to transform base stations into autonomous AI agents capable of situated perception, causal physical reasoning, and physics-aware action generation. The eBS employs a two-tier asynchronous architecture: a Semantic Planner powered by a frontier Vision-Language Model (VLM) generates structured action directives on human timescales, whilst a Tactical Controller executes real-time adaptation. Case studies demonstrate that a single VLA pipeline, without task-specific training, can perform zero-shot material reasoning, generalise across viewpoints, and predict dynamic events before signal degradation occurs. These results illustrate a paradigm shift from traditional rule-following network automation to embodied-intelligence-empowered future wireless networks.

title: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
summary: In this report, we present Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA, abbreviated as HyVLA-0.5, an end-to-end system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Each component serves a distinct role in this stack.

title: Learning Sparse Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Multimodal Neuroimaging
summary: Brain MRIs are routinely acquired as multiple complementary sequences with unique contrast weighting, including T1-weighed imaging (T1w) anatomic and fluid-sensitive T2-weighted (T2w) contrasts. However, methods for learning unified representations across the multitude of MRI contrast mechanisms at health-system scale are lacking. In this study, we introduce Neuro-JEPA, a sparse multimodal neuroimaging foundation model that combines a latent predictive objective with a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to encode brain MRI across core T1w, T2w, and fluid-suppressed FLAIR imaging (FLAIR). We further provide a systematic methodological study of architectural, masking, objective, and sparsity design choices beneficial for robust neuroimaging multimodal representation learning. Neuro-JEPA was pretrained on 1,551,862 scans from 428,647 studies after modality-specific preprocessing with data curation across three core structural brain MRI sequences. We evaluated the learned representations across clinical and research settings, including 25 tasks from three health systems: NYU Langone, NYU Long Island, and Massachusetts General Hospital, and 22 tasks from 12 public datasets, covering unimodal, multimodal and cross-domain evaluation configurations. Across these benchmarks, existing neuroimaging foundation models showed inconsistent gains over a simple convolutional neural network (CNN) baseline, whereas Neuro-JEPA achieved stronger and more consistent performance across all evaluated settings. These results establish a scalable methodological framework for multimodal neuroimaging representation learning and highlight the need for foundation model evaluation protocols that include simple baselines, clinically heterogeneous cohorts and controlled multimodal comparisons.

AI.title_translation: 用于多模态神经影像的稀疏潜在预测基础模型学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Neuro-JEPA，一种结合潜在预测目标与混合专家架构的稀疏多模态神经影像基础模型，在大规模多中心评估中展现出比现有模型更强且更一致的性能。
AI.motivation: 在医疗系统规模下，缺乏能够跨多种具有独特对比度权重的MRI序列（如T1w、T2w等）学习统一表示的方法。
AI.method: 提出了Neuro-JEPA，这是一种稀疏多模态神经影像基础模型，它将潜在预测目标与混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构相结合，用以编码T1w、T2w和FLAIR脑部MRI序列。此外，研究还对有利于鲁棒多模态表示学习的架构、掩码、目标和稀疏性设计进行了系统的方法学研究。该模型在经过模态特定预处理和数据整理后的1,551,862个扫描（来自428,647个研究）上进行了预训练。
AI.result: 在来自3个医疗系统的25个任务和来自12个公开数据集的22个任务中，涵盖单模态、多模态和跨领域评估。现有的神经影像基础模型相比于简单的CNN基线表现出不一致的性能提升，而Neuro-JEPA在所有评估设置中均实现了更强且更一致的性能。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为多模态神经影像表示学习建立了一个可扩展的方法学框架，并强调了在基础模型评估协议中纳入简单基线、临床异质性队列和受控多模态对比的必要性。
AI.translation: 脑部核磁共振（MRI）通常作为具有独特对比度权重的多个互补序列进行常规获取，包括T1加权（T1w）解剖和对液体敏感的T2加权（T2w）对比。然而，目前缺乏在医疗系统规模下跨多种MRI对比度机制学习统一表示的方法。在这项研究中，我们引入了Neuro-JEPA，这是一种稀疏多模态神经影像基础模型，它将潜在预测目标与混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构相结合，以对核心的T1w、T2w和液体抑制FLAIR（FLAIR）脑部MRI进行编码。我们还进一步对有利于鲁棒神经影像多模态表示学习的架构、掩码、目标和稀疏性设计选择进行了系统的方法学研究。在跨三种核心结构脑部MRI序列进行具有数据整理的特定模态预处理后，Neuro-JEPA在来自428,647个研究的1,551,862个扫描上进行了预训练。我们在临床和研究设置中评估了所学的表示，包括来自纽约大学朗格尼医学中心、纽约大学长岛医学中心和麻省总医院三个医疗系统的25个任务，以及来自12个公开数据集的22个任务，涵盖了单模态、多模态和跨领域评估配置。在这些基准测试中，现有的神经影像基础模型相比于简单的卷积神经网络（CNN）基线表现出不一致的提升，而Neuro-JEPA在所有评估设置中均实现了更强且更一致的性能。这些结果为多模态神经影像表示学习建立了一个可扩展的方法学框架，并强调了基础模型评估协议中需要包含简单基线、临床异质性群体和受控多模态对比。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Neuro-JEPA，一种专为多模态神经影像设计的稀疏基础模型。该模型结合了潜在预测目标与混合专家（MoE）架构，能够对T1w、T2w和FLAIR等多种脑部MRI序列进行统一编码。Neuro-JEPA在包含超150万扫描的大规模数据集上进行了预训练。在跨越多个医疗系统和公开数据集的数十项临床与研究任务评估中，Neuro-JEPA展现出相比于现有基础模型和简单CNN基线更强、更稳定的性能，为多模态神经影像表示学习提供了可扩展的框架。
AI.keywords: 神经影像基础模型, 联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA), 混合专家 (MoE), 多模态核磁共振 (Multimodal MRI), 表示学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与混合专家（MoE）设计相结合，成功应用于多模态脑部MRI这一具有高度临床价值但多模态融合困难的领域。其重要性不仅体现在利用超150万的大规模临床扫描数据进行了预训练，更在于其评估过程非常扎实，涵盖了多个医疗系统和公开数据集，并敏锐地指出当前许多神经影像基础模型相比于简单CNN基线提升不稳定的现状，呼吁建立更严谨的评估标准。

title: RoboPIN: Grounded Embodied Reasoning via Pinned Chain-of-Thought
summary: Embodied reasoning requires models to perceive task-relevant objects and spaces in physical environments and maintain consistent visual grounding throughout multi-step reasoning. However, current vision-language models rely on text-only or coordinate-augmented chain-of-thought, where entity references remain implicit and ambiguous. This may cause the reasoning process to decouple from visual evidence, entity references to drift across steps, and a causal disconnection between the reasoning trajectory and the final answer, with these problems further amplified in multi-view scenarios due to cross-view appearance changes. To address these issues, we propose Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT), a structured reasoning paradigm that pins every reasoning step to visual evidence. PinCoT introduces the concept of reasoning anchor, which binds each task-relevant entity to a structured visual anchor with entity name, unique identity, view index, and spatial grounding, enabling consistent entity tracking across reasoning steps and views. We build a fully automated data generation pipeline to construct PIN-170K, a high-quality PinCoT-formatted reasoning dataset. We then train RoboPIN through three-stage post-training that progressively injects embodied knowledge, structured reasoning ability, and process-supervised alignment, with rewards that directly constrain both anchor localization and identity consistency during reasoning. On 14 benchmarks covering embodied spatial reasoning, multi-view reasoning, and pointing, RoboPIN with only 4B parameters consistently outperforms 7B level open-source embodied models, achieving a 12% average improvement over the strongest 7B baseline, Mimo-Embodied. Further analysis shows that PinCoT improves grounding accuracy and cross-step identity consistency, validating the effectiveness of process supervision.

AI.title_translation: RoboPIN：基于固定思维链的具身接地推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出PinCoT范式，通过“推理锚点”将思维链每一步与视觉证据绑定，并训练了4B参数的RoboPIN模型，在14个具身推理基准上显著超越了7B级开源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在具身推理中依赖纯文本或仅坐标增强的思维链，导致实体引用隐式且模糊，容易使推理过程与视觉证据脱钩、实体引用跨步骤漂移，并在多视角场景下因外观变化导致推理轨迹与最终答案因果断裂。
AI.method:
1. 提出PinCoT（Pinned Chain-of-Thought）结构化推理范式，引入“推理锚点”将任务相关实体与结构化视觉锚点（包含实体名、唯一ID、视角索引和空间接地）绑定；
2. 构建了包含17万条高品质PinCoT格式推理数据的PIN-170K数据集；
3. 通过三阶段后训练（具身知识注入、结构化推理能力培养、过程监督对齐）训练RoboPIN模型，利用直接约束锚点定位和身份一致性的奖励进行对齐。
AI.result: 在涵盖具身空间推理、多视角推理和指向的14个基准测试中，仅有4B参数的RoboPIN模型持续超越7B级别的开源具身模型，相比最强的7B基线模型Mimo-Embodied实现了12%的平均性能提升。
AI.conclusion: PinCoT有效提升了定位准确性和跨步骤的实体身份一致性，验证了过程监督在具身推理任务中的有效性。
AI.translation: 具身推理需要模型感知物理环境中与任务相关的物体和空间，并在多步推理中保持一致的视觉接地（grounding）。然而，目前的视觉语言模型依赖于纯文本或坐标增强的思维链，其中实体引用仍然是隐式且模糊的。这可能导致推理过程与视觉证据脱钩、实体引用在不同步骤间发生漂移，以及推理轨迹与最终答案之间的因果断裂，这些问题在多视角场景下由于跨视角外观变化而被进一步放大。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了固定思维链（Pinned Chain-of-Thought, PinCoT），这是一种将每个推理步骤都固定在视觉证据上的结构化推理范式。PinCoT引入了推理锚点（reasoning anchor）的概念，将每个与任务相关的实体绑定到一个包含实体名称、唯一标识、视角索引和空间接地的结构化视觉锚点上，从而实现了跨推理步骤和跨视角的连贯实体跟踪。我们构建了一个全自动的数据生成管线，以创建高质量的PinCoT格式推理数据集 PIN-170K。随后，我们通过渐进式注入具身知识、结构化推理能力和过程监督对齐的三阶段后训练来训练RoboPIN，并采用在推理过程中直接约束锚点定位和身份一致性的奖励机制。在涵盖具身空间推理、多视角推理和指向的14个基准测试中，仅有4B参数的RoboPIN持续超越7B级别的开源具身模型，相比最强的7B基线模型 Mimo-Embodied 实现了12%的平均提升。进一步的分析表明，PinCoT提高了定位准确性和跨步骤的身份一致性，验证了过程监督的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对具身推理中实体引用模糊和多视角下实体漂移的问题，提出了PinCoT（固定思维链）推理范式。该范式通过“推理锚点”将每一步推理与具体的视觉证据（如空间定位、视角、唯一标识等）进行绑定。基于此，作者构建了PIN-170K数据集，并通过三阶段后训练和过程监督训练了4B参数的RoboPIN模型。实验结果表明，RoboPIN在14个具身推理基准上显著优于现有的7B级开源模型，大幅提升了接地准确性和跨步骤一致性。
AI.keywords: 具身推理, 思维链, 视觉接地, 多视角推理, 过程监督
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了PinCoT范式，通过引入结构化的“推理锚点”（包含名称、ID、视角和空间定位），将思维链的每一步显式地与视觉证据进行绑定。这种方法有效解决了多步推理和多视角场景下实体漂移与推理脱钩的痛点。此外，仅4B参数的RoboPIN模型在多个基准上超越7B模型，充分展示了高质量结构化推理数据（PIN-170K）和过程监督的强大威力。限制在于其表现仍依赖于自动生成的高质量数据集，未来在更复杂、动态的真实世界环境中的泛化性仍待观察。

title: Heteroskedastic Signals in Budgeted LLM Verification: Structural Heterogeneity Limits Optimization Gains
summary: Selective-compute LLM systems decide which outputs merit verification, additional reasoning, tool execution, or human audit under a limited budget. It is natural to expect that stronger online optimization over a shared uncertainty or reward signal should improve these decisions. We take a critical look at this assumption and ask: when does optimizing harder fail because the signal is not decision-comparable across inputs? In budgeted LLM verification, we find that uncertainty quality is heteroskedastic across cost strata: some regions exhibit near-random discriminability while concentrating many errors. Under an explicit local model, we characterize the resulting distortion of global allocation and show that its upper bound scales with cross-stratum signal-quality dispersion. To separate weak signals from optimizer instability and structural mismatch, we introduce a controlled intervention hierarchy: Threshold, MP-Adapt, MP-Strat, and cost-stratified thresholding (CST). We then turn the diagnosis into Heterogeneity-Gated Allocation (HGA), which uses a warm-up comparability test to choose between global and cost-stratified allocation. Across MBPP and MATH using Qwen3-8B, LLaMA3-8B, and GPT-4o-mini, global online adaptation yields inconsistent gains over static thresholding; CST improves hit rate by up to 17 percentage points in strongly heterogeneous settings, while HGA preserves most gains and avoids blind stratification when the partition is not useful. These findings suggest a resource-allocation principle for LLM systems: before optimizing harder over a shared proxy, test whether the proxy is decision-comparable across observable operating regimes, and gate structural specialization on that test.

AI.title_translation: 预算受限的大语言模型验证中的异方差信号：结构异质性限制了优化增益
AI.tldr: 本论文指出，LLM验证中的不确定性信号在不同成本层级间存在异质性（不可比性），导致全局在线优化效果不佳；为此提出异质性门控分配（HGA）方法，通过预测试自适应选择分配策略，显著提升了资源分配效率。
AI.motivation: 在预算受限的LLM验证中，探究当不确定性或奖励信号在不同输入之间不具备决策可比性时，为什么更强的全局在线优化反而会失效。具体而言，研究不确定性质量在不同成本层级间的异方差性如何扭曲全局资源分配。
AI.method:
1. 引入受控干预层级（包括Threshold、MP-Adapt、MP-Strat和成本分层阈值化CST），用以区分弱信号、优化器不稳定性和结构失配。
2. 提出“异质性门控分配”（Heterogeneity-Gated Allocation, HGA），该方法使用热身可比性测试，自适应地在全局分配和成本分层分配之间做出选择。
AI.result: 在MBPP和MATH数据集上（使用Qwen3-8B、LLaMA3-8B和GPT-4o-mini进行实验），全局在线自适应相比静态阈值化带来的收益并不稳定。相比之下，成本分层阈值化（CST）在强异质性设置下将命中率提高了多达17个百分点；而HGA能够保留大部分收益，并在分区无用时避免盲目的分层。
AI.conclusion: 在对共享代理指标进行更强力的在线优化之前，应该先测试该代理在可观测运行区间内是否具有决策可比性，并根据该测试结果来决定是否进行结构专门化（分层分配）。这一原则为LLM系统的资源分配提供了新的指导。
AI.translation: 选择性计算的大语言模型（LLM）系统在有限的预算下，需要决定哪些输出值得进行验证、额外推理、工具执行或人工审计。人们自然会期望，针对共享的不确定性或奖励信号进行更强的在线优化应该能够改善这些决策。我们对这一假设进行了审视，并提出疑问：当信号在不同输入之间不具备决策可比性时，更努力地优化在何时会失败？在有预算限制的LLM验证中，我们发现不确定性的质量在不同的成本层级之间是异方差的：某些区域表现出接近随机的区分度，同时集中了许多错误。在一个显式的局部模型下，我们刻画了由此导致的全局分配失真，并表明其上界随着跨层级信号质量的离散度而扩展。为了将弱信号与优化器不稳定性及结构失配分离开来，我们引入了一种受控干预层级：Threshold、MP-Adapt、MP-Strat 和 成本分层阈值化（CST）。然后，我们将这一诊断转化为异质性门控分配（HGA），它使用热身可比性测试在全局分配和成本分层分配之间进行选择。在基于 Qwen3-8B、LLaMA3-8B 和 GPT-4o-mini 的 MBPP 和 MATH 数据集上，全局在线自适应相比静态阈值化带来的收益并不稳定；而在强异质性设置下，CST 将命中率提高了多达 17 个百分点，同时 HGA 保留了大部分收益，并在分区无用时避免了盲目的分层。这些发现为 LLM 系统提出了一种资源分配原则：在对共享代理指标进行更强力优化之前，先测试该代理在可观测运行区间内是否具有决策可比性，并根据该测试来决定是否采用结构专门化。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了预算受限下LLM选择性计算系统的资源分配优化问题。作者指出，由于不确定性信号在不同成本层级间存在异方差性（即决策不可比），传统的全局在线优化往往无法带来稳定收益。为此，本文提出了一种受控干预层级和成本分层阈值化（CST）方法，并设计了异质性门控分配（HGA）机制，通过热身测试自适应选择最佳分配策略，从而在异质性场景下显著提升了系统性能。
AI.keywords: 预算受限LLM验证, 异方差信号, 资源分配, 异质性门控分配 (HGA), 选择性计算
AI.comments: 本文深入探讨了LLM选择性计算（Selective-Compute）中一个关键但常被忽视的痛点：用于决策的不确定性或奖励信号在不同成本层级间存在异方差性（即不可比性）。论文的创新之处在于，不仅从理论上刻画了这种结构异质性对全局资源分配的扭曲作用，还提出了一套实用的受控干预层级（如CST）和自适应的门控分配机制（HGA）。这为大模型在有限预算下的高效资源调度与验证提供了极具启发性的理论支撑与实用指导。

title: A Formal Resilience Framework for Cyber-Physical Embodied Systems under Device-Level Cyberattacks
summary: In cyber-physical systems (CPSs), fault tolerance is traditionally achieved by analysing sensor and actuator outputs, detecting progressive drift or sudden failures, and initiating suitable tolerance mechanisms. Reasonable under general failure models, this approach fails to capture nuanced disruptions caused by cyberattacks, which may employ subtle strategies. This is particularly critical in embodied CPSs, where computational and physical devices not only have an active role in task completion, but also in embodiment preservation (that is, maintaining the system's physical integrity). To prevent structural physical damage, embodied CPSs require a framework that enables proactive response to cyberattacks. This paper proposes a formal dependability framework that incorporates IDS information into resilience evaluation predicates, enabling assessment of tolerance to disruption and degradation. The framework supports structured reasoning about how cyberattacks affect task execution and embodiment preservation, and whether mitigation strategies must be deployed. Analytical examples demonstrate its analytical capability and soundness, establishing a theoretical foundation for dependable and secure embodied CPSs.

AI.title_translation: 设备级网络攻击下信息物理具身系统的形式化弹性框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对具身信息物理系统的形式化弹性框架，通过将IDS信息融入评估谓词，实现对网络攻击的主动防御并保护系统的物理完整性。
AI.motivation: 传统的CPS容错机制依赖于检测传感器和执行器的输出异常，难以应对网络攻击采用的隐蔽策略。这在具身CPS中尤为严重，因为设备不仅要执行任务，还必须保护自身的物理结构不受损坏（即具身保护）。因此，亟需一种能够主动应对网络攻击并防止物理结构受损的形式化框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种形式化的可靠性框架。该框架将入侵检测系统（IDS）的信息集成到弹性评估谓词中，用以评估系统对网络干扰和性能退化的容忍度，并支持对网络攻击如何影响任务执行与物理完整性（具身保护）进行结构化的推理，从而决定是否部署缓解策略。
AI.result: 通过分析性示例（analytical examples）展示了该框架的分析能力和理论正确性（soundness）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为设计和构建高可靠、高安全的具身信息物理系统（embodied CPSs）奠定了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 在信息物理系统（CPS）中，传统上是通过分析传感器和执行器的输出、检测渐进式漂移或突发故障并启动适当的容错机制来实现容错的。在一般的故障模型下，这种方法是合理的，但它无法捕捉由网络攻击引起的微妙干扰，因为网络攻击可能会采用精细的策略。这在具身CPS中尤为关键，因为其中的计算和物理设备不仅在任务完成中发挥积极作用，在具身保护（即维护系统的物理完整性）中也起着关键作用。为了防止结构性的物理损坏，具身CPS需要一个能够对网络攻击做出主动响应的框架。本文提出了一种形式化可靠性框架，该框架将入侵检测系统（IDS）的信息融入到弹性评估谓词中，从而能够评估对干扰和退化的容忍度。该框架支持关于网络攻击如何影响任务执行和具身保护，以及是否必须部署缓解策略的结构化推理。分析性示例展示了其分析能力和正确性，为构建可靠且安全的具身CPS奠定了理论基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对具身信息物理系统（embodied CPS）在网络攻击下易受物理结构损坏的问题，提出了一种新型的形式化可靠性框架。该框架通过将入侵检测系统（IDS）的信息引入弹性评估谓词，实现了对攻击干扰和系统退化容忍度的量化评估。它支持对任务执行和物理完整性保护进行结构化推理，为主动应对设备级网络攻击提供了理论安全保障。
AI.keywords: 具身信息物理系统, 形式化弹性框架, 网络攻击, 具身保护, 入侵检测系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将入侵检测系统（IDS）的动态信息直接融入到形式化的弹性评估谓词中，首次针对“具身CPS”的物理完整性（具身保护）提出了主动防御的形式化推理方法。这对于当前快速发展的具身智能和机器人安全领域具有重要的理论指导意义。然而，其局限性在于摘要中仅提到通过“分析性示例”进行了验证，缺乏在实际复杂具身设备（如双足机器人或自动驾驶车辆）上的大规模实证数据和计算开销评估。

title: Look Again Before You Abstain:Budgeted Conformal Evidence Acquisition for Reliable Vision-Language Model
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) hallucinate: they assert visual details that the image does not support. A principled remedy is selective prediction with a distribution-free guarantee-verify each claim and abstain when the claim is not grounded, so that the hallucination rate among asserted claims is provably bounded. We show, however, that this guarantee is bought at a brutal price: to keep the hallucination rate below $5\%$ on a balanced object-existence benchmark, a state-of-the-art conformal filter must abstain on more than $80\%$ of claims. We argue that abstention is wasteful when more visual evidence is cheaply available, and introduce Budgeted Conformal Evidence Acquisition (BCEA), which replaces the binary answer/abstain decision with a three-way choice: answer, abstain, or acquire additional visual evidence by re-examining the image (zooming, cropping, or applying a claim-specific intervention) under a bounded compute budget. We make two observations. First, acquisition that is plugged naively into a calibrated filter breaks the statistical guarantee -- realized risk overshoots the target by up to $17$ points -- because the acquisition step destroys the exchangeability that conformal calibration relies on. Second, folding the entire acquisition policy into the score function and re-calibrating on post-acquisition scores \emph{restores} the finite-sample guarantee while still recovering coverage. BCEA further uses structured, claim-type-specific interventions. Across the POPE benchmark and COCO-constructed existence and spatial-relation claims, on four open VLMs, BCEA controls the hallucination rate at the target level and consistently improves coverage over a guaranteed-abstention baseline.

AI.title_translation: 放弃前再看一眼：用于可靠视觉语言模型的预算受限符合性证据获取
AI.tldr: 本文提出了BCEA方法，通过在预算内主动获取额外视觉证据（如缩放、裁剪），在保证视觉语言模型超低幻觉率的同时，克服了传统方法拒绝率过高的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）容易产生幻觉。现有的符合性预测方法虽然能通过“拒绝回答”来提供无分布的低幻觉率保证，但代价是拒绝率极高（超过80%）。在可以廉价获取更多视觉证据的情况下，直接拒绝回答是极其浪费的。
AI.method: 提出“预算约束符合性证据获取（BCEA）”方法。该方法将传统的“回答/拒绝”二分类选择扩展为“回答、拒绝、或在受限计算预算下通过重新检查图像（如缩放、裁剪或应用特定干预）获取额外视觉证据”的三分类选择。为了解决引入获取步骤破坏符合性校准“交换性”的问题，BCEA将整个获取策略折叠进评分函数中，并在获取后的分数上进行重新校准，从而恢复了有限样本统计保证。
AI.result: 在POPE基准测试以及基于COCO构建的存在性和空间关系声明上，针对四种开源视觉语言模型，BCEA成功将幻觉率控制在目标水平，并且相比于保证拒绝的基线方法，一致且显著地提高了覆盖率（即减少了无谓的拒绝，提高了有效回答比例）。
AI.conclusion: BCEA通过将主动证据获取与符合性预测重新校准相结合，在数学上恢复了无分布可靠性保证，同时在有限计算预算内显著降低了视觉语言模型的拒绝率，提升了模型的实用性与可靠性。
AI.translation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）存在幻觉问题：它们会断言图像并不支持的视觉细节。一种原则性的补救方法是具有无分布保证的选择性预测——验证每个声明并在声明不成立时拒绝回答，从而使断言声明中的幻觉率在可证明的范围内。然而，我们表明，这种保证付出了极其惨痛的代价：为了在平衡的物体存在性基准上将幻觉率保持在5%以下，最先进的符合性滤波器必须拒绝超过80%的声明。我们认为，在能够廉价获得更多视觉证据时，拒绝回答是浪费的，因此引入了预算约束符合性证据获取（BCEA）。它将二元的回答/拒绝决策替换为三选一：回答、拒绝，或在受限的计算预算下通过重新检查图像（缩放、裁剪或应用特定于声明的干预）来获取额外的视觉证据。我们有两个发现。首先，将获取机制天真地插入到校准的滤波器中会破坏统计保证——实际风险超出目标多达17个百分点——因为获取步骤破坏了符合性校准所依赖的交换性。其次，将整个获取策略折叠进评分函数并在获取后的分数上重新校准，可以恢复有限样本保证，同时仍然收复覆盖率。BCEA进一步使用了结构化的、特定于声明类型的干预。在POPE基准以及COCO构建的存在性和空间关系声明上，针对四个开源视觉语言模型，BCEA将幻觉率控制在目标水平，并始终比有保证的拒绝基线提高了覆盖率。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉问题，提出了一种名为“预算约束符合性证据获取（BCEA）”的新框架。该框架改进了传统的符合性预测方法（该方法为了保证低幻觉率而具有极高的拒绝率），引入了主动获取视觉证据（如缩放、裁剪）的机制。通过将获取策略融入评分函数并进行重新校准，BCEA在维持严格的低幻觉率统计保证的同时，显著提高了模型的有效回答覆盖率。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 幻觉控制, 符合性预测, 证据获取, 选择性预测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于指出了传统符合性预测（Conformal Prediction）在解决视觉语言模型（VLM）幻觉时因高拒绝率（>80%）而实用性不足的问题，并创造性地引入了“主动获取证据”的三向决策机制。更重要的是，作者敏锐地发现了天真引入获取机制会破坏符合性预测的“交换性”（Exchangeability）假设，从而导致统计保证失效，并提出将获取策略融入评分函数进行重新校准的优雅解决方案。局限性在于该方法增加了额外的图像处理计算开销（如缩放、裁剪），且对于非局部性或更复杂的推理幻觉的有效性仍有待在更广泛的场景中验证。

title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
summary: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, harnesses, contexts, environments, and feedback signals, any one of which can move the benchmark score by margins comparable to those between adjacent model generations. We discuss three symptoms: (i) benchmark scores conflate the model with the rest of the harness; (ii) grading against a single reference solution penalises equally valid alternatives; and (iii) the absence of signal at the level of individual harness components makes the end-to-end system score difficult to iterate on.

AI.title_translation: 观点：代码基准测试与智能体软件工程不相匹配
AI.tldr: 当前的代码基准测试针对前智能体时代设计，将模型与环境混为一谈且缺乏组件级反馈，无法有效评估和迭代复杂的代码智能体系统。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体已成为软件工程的主要模式，但现有的代码基准测试仍停留在“前智能体时代”。这些基准测试将模型、测试框架和环境简化为单一的端到端分数，且缺乏组件级的反馈信号，无法满足实际应用中复杂智能体系统的评估与迭代需求。
AI.method: 作为一篇观点性论文，本文通过理论分析和论证，剖析了当前代码基准测试不适应智能体软件工程的三个主要症状：（1）基准分数混淆了模型与测试框架的其他部分；（2）单一参考答案评分惩罚了其他同样有效的方案；（3）缺乏组件级信号导致难以进行系统迭代。
AI.result: 指出并论证了当前代码基准测试与智能体软件工程不匹配的三个具体症状：一是分数混淆了模型与其余测试框架的影响；二是单一参考答案评分惩罚了其他有效替代方案；三是缺乏组件级信号导致端到端系统难以迭代。
AI.conclusion: 当前的代码基准测试与智能体软件工程存在严重错配。实际中的代码智能体是一个由模型、环境、反馈等构成的复杂系统，未来的基准测试需要改变单一端到端评分的现状，提供组件级的信号以支持系统的有效迭代。
AI.translation: 代码智能体已成为软件工程的一种主要模式，但我们用来比较它们的基准测试却是在前智能体时代设计的：它们将模型、测试框架和环境压缩为一个单一的端到端分数，通常仅针对一个参考解决方案进行计算，且没有用于迭代的组件级信号。我们认为，当前的代码基准测试与智能体软件工程是不匹配的。在实践中，代码智能体并不是一个模型：它是一个系统框架——由模型、测试框架、上下文、环境和反馈信号组成，其中任何一个要素对基准测试分数的影响，都可能与相邻两代模型之间的差距相媲美。我们讨论了三个症状：（i）基准测试分数将模型与测试框架的其他部分混为一谈；（ii）针对单一参考解决方案进行评分会惩罚同样有效的其他替代方案；（iii）在单个测试框架组件级别上缺乏信号，使得端到端系统分数难以进行迭代。
AI.summary: 本文指出当前的代码基准测试由于设计于前智能体时代，已无法适应现代智能体软件工程的需求。作者强调，实际中的代码智能体是一个包含模型、环境和反馈等多个组件的复杂系统，而现有的基准测试将其简化为单一的端到端得分，存在混淆模型与框架、惩罚有效替代方案以及缺乏组件级迭代信号等问题。
AI.keywords: 代码智能体, 基准测试, 软件工程, 系统框架, 评估错配
AI.comments: 本文敏锐地指出了当前代码大模型评估领域的关键痛点。随着AI Agent在软件工程中的广泛应用，传统的、基于单一输入输出比对的基准测试确实显得过时。文章提出“代码智能体是一个复杂的系统框架而非单一模型”的观点极具启发性，为未来构建更科学、多维度、支持组件化迭代的代码智能体评估基准指明了方向。

title: Overlapping Schwarz Attention: Hierarchical Attention via Domain Decomposition
summary:
We propose a hierarchical attention mechanism based on two-level overlapping Schwarz domain decomposition. The method is motivated by domain decomposition methods in partial differential equations which combine local subdomain corrections with a coarse level that communicates global, long-range information. We test its usefulness in the context of finite-dimensional operator learning using a simple, one-dimensional diffusion problem. Although elementary, this problem provides a controlled sequence-to-sequence setting in which the exact nonlocal solution operator is known. After discretization, learning the solution operator amounts to approximating the inverse of a symmetric positive definite matrix. As a baseline, we use a global softmax-free low-rank attention operator of the form \(QK^T\). The proposed construction replaces this global factorization by a two-level additive structure: local low-rank attention blocks on overlapping subdomains are combined with a coarse attention block. The resulting operator has the form $$
  M_θ^{-1}
  =
  ΦQ_0 K_0^T Φ^T
  +
  \sum_{i=1}^{N}
  R_i^T D_i^{1/2} Q_i K_i^T D_i^{1/2} R_i . $$ Here, $R_i$ restricts to an overlapping subdomain, $D_i$ is a partition-of-unity weight, and $Φ$ is a coarse interpolation %(or prolongation) matrix. Numerical experiments for synthetic Fourier right-hand sides indicate that the domain-decomposition attention operator can converge faster and can give more accurate approximations than a global low-rank attention baseline while using significantly fewer parameters.

title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code and models: https://github.com/harryhsing/omniagent
summary: Passive models for long video understanding typically rely on a "watch-it-all" paradigm, processing frames uniformly regardless of query difficulty, causing computational cost to grow with video duration. Although interactive frameworks have emerged, they often rely on global pre-scanning, and their context cost still scales with video length. We propose OmniAgent, the first native omni-modal agent that formulates video understanding as a POMDP-based iterative Observation-Thought-Action cycle. OmniAgent executes on-demand actions to selectively distill audio-visual cues into a persistent textual memory, effectively decoupling reasoning complexity from raw video duration. To operationalize this, we introduce (1) Agentic Supervised Fine-Tuning to bootstrap native active perception via best-of-N trajectory synthesis with dual-stage quality control, and (2) Agentic Reinforcement Learning with TAURA (Turn-aware Adaptive Uncertainty Rescaled Advantage), which leverages turn-level entropy to steer credit assignment toward pivotal discovery turns. Crucially, OmniAgent exhibits positive test-time scaling, where performance improves as the number of reasoning turns increases, validating the efficacy of active perception. Empirical results across ten benchmarks (e.g., VideoMME, LVBench) demonstrate that OmniAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models. Notably, on LVBench, our 7B agent outperforms the 10$\times$ larger Qwen2.5-VL-72B (50.5% vs. 47.3%).
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code and models: https://github.com/harryhsing/omniagent

AI.title_translation: 原生主动感知：作为全模态理解的推理机制
AI.tldr: OmniAgent通过像人类一样的主动感知和迭代推理，以更小的模型规模在长视频理解任务中超越了更大的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的长视频理解模型多采用“全量处理”范式，导致计算成本随视频时长线性增长；即便交互式框架也存在预扫描依赖和上下文成本随时长扩展的问题。
AI.method: 提出OmniAgent框架，将视频理解建模为基于POMDP的观察-思考-动作（OTA）循环。采用代理监督微调（Agentic SFT）进行引导，并引入基于TAURA（转向感知自适应不确定性重标定优势）的代理强化学习来优化决策过程。
AI.result: 在十个基准测试中达到开源模型SOTA水平。特别是在LVBench上，7B参数的OmniAgent表现优于72B参数的Qwen2.5-VL（50.5% vs 47.3%），并呈现出显著的测试时扩展性能提升。
AI.conclusion: OmniAgent通过主动感知和迭代推理，成功提升了长视频理解的效率与准确性，展示了主动推理范式在多模态领域超越单纯规模扩展的有效性。
AI.translation: 用于长视频理解的被动模型通常依赖于“全量观看”范式，无论查询难度如何都统一处理帧，导致计算成本随视频时长增长。尽管已经出现了交互式框架，但它们通常依赖于全局预扫描，且其上下文成本仍随视频长度扩展。我们提出了OmniAgent，这是第一个原生全模态智能体，它将视频理解构建为一个基于POMDP的迭代式观察-思考-动作（Observation-Thought-Action）循环。OmniAgent执行按需操作，有选择地将视听线索提取到持久的文本记忆中，有效地将推理复杂性与原始视频时长解耦。为了实现这一点，我们引入了（1）代理监督微调，通过具有双阶段质量控制的最佳N轨迹合成来引导原生主动感知；以及（2）采用TAURA（转向感知自适应不确定性重标定优势）的代理强化学习，利用转向级熵将信用分配引导至关键发现步骤。至关重要的是，OmniAgent表现出正向的测试时扩展性，即随着推理步数的增加，性能随之提升，验证了主动感知的有效性。在十个基准测试（如VideoMME、LVBench）上的实证结果表明，OmniAgent在开源模型中达到了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，在LVBench上，我们的7B智能体表现优于参数量大10倍的Qwen2.5-VL-72B（50.5% 对 47.3%）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OmniAgent，一种原生全模态智能体，通过将视频理解转化为基于POMDP的迭代式主动感知过程，实现了推理复杂度与视频时长的解耦。通过代理监督微调和TAURA强化学习，OmniAgent能够按需提取音频视觉线索，在保持高效的同时显著提升了长视频理解的性能。
AI.keywords: 长视频理解, 主动感知, 多模态智能体, POMDP, 测试时扩展
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将视频理解建模为POMDP过程，通过主动感知机制实现了推理复杂度与视频时长解耦。其在参数量远小于竞品的情况下取得SOTA结果，证明了主动推理范式在长视频理解任务中的巨大潜力。

title: GroundShot: Visually Consistent Multi-Shot Long Video Generation via Entity-Grounded Shot Scheduling
summary: Generating visually consistent multi-shot videos remains an open challenge. As videos span more shots, inconsistencies can accumulate across shots, causing entities that reappear across shots -- characters, objects, and locations -- to drift away from how they first appear. We observe that viewers judge consistency by comparing each later appearance of an entity with its first clear appearance; the visual quality of this initial appearance sets the consistency ceiling for all that follows. Motivated by this, we present \textbf{GroundShot}, a training-free, model-agnostic agentic framework for entity-grounded multi-shot generation. GroundShot builds an entity-level visual memory online from accepted generated shots: it schedules shots' generation order by their expected usefulness as entity references, grounds entities from generated videos, verifies their reliability before adding them to memory, and retrieves suitable entity references from memory before each shot is generated. To evaluate this entity-centered view of consistency, we further introduce \textbf{GroundBench}, a diagnostic benchmark that measures consistency at the entity level while isolating controlled challenge dimensions. Experiments show that GroundShot improves multi-shot consistency over existing methods while requiring no additional training or model modification.

title: WingSpan: Concurrency and Dependence for Sparse and Structured Tensor Compilers
summary: Sparse tensors represent data that is mostly zero or some other compressible fill pattern. Such datasets can be massive, so optimized tensor algebra libraries and compilers have been developed to exploit these patterns to improve performance. Existing systems, however, frequently lack support for parallelism, especially when outputs are sparse or multiple inputs are sparse. We propose WingSpan, a sparse tensor language enabling unrestricted parallel programming. WingSpan supports arbitrary composition of parallel loops and data structures, matching or exceeding the performance of hand-optimized parallel routines on critical kernels such as SpGEMM. We also introduce a dependence theory for the safety of parallel programs involving sparse tensors and structures beyond sparsity.

AI.title_translation: WingSpan：针对稀疏与结构化张量编译器的并发与依赖机制
AI.tldr: WingSpan 是一种新型稀疏张量语言，通过引入依赖理论实现了不受限制的高效并行编程，并在关键稀疏内核上实现了高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的稀疏张量编译器在处理稀疏输出或多个稀疏输入时，往往缺乏对并行化的有效支持，限制了大规模稀疏数据集的处理效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种支持任意并行循环和数据结构组合的稀疏张量语言，并引入了一套用于稀疏张量及其他结构并行程序安全性的依赖理论。
AI.result: WingSpan 在 SpGEMM 等关键内核上达到了与手工优化的并行例程相当甚至更高的性能，并为稀疏张量并行编程提供了安全性保障。
AI.conclusion: WingSpan 成功证明了在稀疏张量编译器中实现不受限制的并行编程是可行的，不仅提升了性能，还通过依赖理论保证了程序的安全性。
AI.translation: 稀疏张量代表了大部分为零或具有其他可压缩填充模式的数据。此类数据集可能非常庞大，因此开发了优化的张量代数库和编译器来利用这些模式以提高性能。然而，现有系统通常缺乏对并行性的支持，尤其是在输出稀疏或存在多个稀疏输入时。我们提出了 WingSpan，这是一种支持不受限制并行编程的稀疏张量语言。WingSpan 支持并行循环和数据结构的任意组合，在 SpGEMM 等关键内核上达到或超过了手工优化并行例程的性能。我们还引入了一种依赖理论，用于确保涉及稀疏张量及超越稀疏性的结构的并行程序的安全性。
AI.summary: WingSpan 是一种新型稀疏张量语言，旨在解决现有编译器在处理稀疏张量并行化方面的不足。它支持不受限制的并行编程，通过创新的依赖理论确保程序安全，在关键稀疏内核上表现出了优于或媲美手工优化代码的性能。
AI.keywords: 稀疏张量, 并行计算, 编译器, 依赖理论, 性能优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入依赖理论解决了稀疏张量编译器在并行化方面的核心痛点，为构建高性能、安全且通用的稀疏张量编译器提供了重要理论支撑和实践参考，具有很高的学术和工业价值。

title: Short-Term Electricity Demand Forecasting for New England: A Comprehensive Machine Learning Benchmark with Weather, Calendar, and COVID-19 Indicators
summary: Accurate short-term electricity demand forecasting is critical for reliable power system operation, energy market planning, and infrastructure optimization. This paper benchmarks ten machine learning models for daily electricity demand forecasting across the New England ISO (February 2020 - March 2023). The models span four families: tabular gradient-boosted trees (Random Forest, LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost), standalone neural architectures (LSTM, Transformer encoder), and hybrid Transformer+tree variants (Hybrid XGBoost, Hybrid LightGBM, Hybrid CatBoost, Hybrid RF). All models use meteorological data from six cities, calendar and holiday effects, autoregressive demand lags, and COVID-19 epidemiological variables. Hyperparameter optimization uses Optuna (300 trials, multivariate TPE, seed=42) under a leakage-free 70/15/15 chronological split. CatBoost achieves the best test performance: RMSE 8316 MWh, MAPE 1.87%, R-squared 0.917, followed by XGBoost (9066 MWh, R-squared 0.901), Hybrid CatBoost (9068 MWh, R-squared 0.901), and Hybrid XGBoost (9208 MWh, R-squared 0.898). Standalone neural architectures perform substantially worse (Transformer: 21294 MWh; LSTM: 22808 MWh), confirming the Transformer's role as a feature extractor rather than an end-to-end forecaster. An ablation on CatBoost shows that demand lags are the dominant predictor: removal degrades RMSE from 8316 to 11310 MWh (+36%), while weather and calendar features alone achieve an R-squared of 0.864. Removing COVID-19 features improves test RMSE by 1.7% while reducing training RMSE by 17.3%, a signature of temporal validity decay. SHAP analysis confirms this: 3 of 8 COVID features rank higher on the post-acute test set than during pandemic-active training, indicating the model over-applies stale pandemic patterns after behavioral adaptation was complete by August 2022.

title: Right Knowledge, Wrong Answer: Characterizing Parametric Temporal Conflict in Open-Weight Language Models
summary: Language models may encode both outdated facts and their newer replacements. We introduce Parametric Temporal Conflict (PTC), where the newer fact is present and recoverable, but the default forward pass prefers the outdated one. We release a deterministically verified benchmark of 8,746 Wikidata position-holder transitions and evaluate four open-weight language models across three families. A date-prefix prompt recovers the newer fact in 61-81% of PTC cases. Activation patching flips predictions in 72-85% of cases and localizes the preference to model-specific upper-layer regions. Residual-stream steering outperforms norm-matched random directions, indicating direction-specific representations. These results show that PTC reflects a localized representational preference rather than missing knowledge. Recovery is measured on oracle-identified conflicts because automatic detection remains unreliable. We release the benchmark, code, and statistics.

title: Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching: Autonomous Trajectory Optimization via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Consistency distillation has significantly accelerated diffusion-model inference, but its sampling dynamics remain underexplored. We reveal an asymmetry: although Logit-Normal sampling priors work well for standard iterative generation, consistency distillation exhibits a different difficulty profile (e.g., U-shaped), with optimization bottlenecks concentrated at the boundary stages rather than intermediate steps. To address the limitations of static sampling under evolving learning demands, we propose Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching (CACFM). By formulating distillation as a dynamic decision process, CACFM uses a lightweight reinforcement learning agent to probe Probability Flow ODE trajectories and construct an efficiency-oriented curriculum that prioritizes critical regions without manual scheduling. Combined with Flow-adapted DMD and adversarial consistency objectives, our RL-based scheduler achieves state-of-the-art results on large-scale models such as FLUX and SDXL, mitigating structural deformities and preserving high-frequency details in extreme few-step regimes.

AI.title_translation: 曲率自适应一致性流匹配：基于强化学习的自主轨迹优化
AI.tldr: 通过引入强化学习动态调整采样轨迹，CACFM 解决了扩散模型一致性蒸馏在极少步数下的优化难题，提升了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型一致性蒸馏方法在采样动力学上存在局限性，特别是在边界阶段存在优化瓶颈，且缺乏对动态学习需求的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出曲率自适应一致性流匹配 (CACFM)，将蒸馏过程建模为动态决策过程，利用轻量级强化学习代理探索概率流 ODE 轨迹，并结合流适应 DMD 和对抗性一致性目标进行训练。
AI.result: 在 FLUX 和 SDXL 等大规模模型上实现了最先进的性能，在极少步数推理下显著减少了结构畸变，并保留了高频细节。
AI.conclusion: CACFM 通过强化学习实现的自适应采样策略，在极少步数下显著提升了扩散模型的生成质量，并能有效保持图像细节与结构完整性。
AI.translation: 一致性蒸馏显著加速了扩散模型的推理，但其采样动力学仍未得到充分探索。我们揭示了一种不对称性：尽管 Logit-Normal 采样先验在标准迭代生成中表现良好，但一致性蒸馏表现出不同的难度分布（例如 U 型），其优化瓶颈集中在边界阶段而非中间步骤。为了解决静态采样在不断变化的学习需求下的局限性，我们提出了曲率自适应一致性流匹配 (CACFM)。通过将蒸馏建模为动态决策过程，CACFM 利用轻量级强化学习代理探索概率流 ODE 轨迹，并构建了一个以效率为导向的课程，无需人工调度即可优先处理关键区域。结合流适应 DMD 和对抗性一致性目标，我们基于强化学习的调度器在 FLUX 和 SDXL 等大规模模型上取得了最先进的结果，减轻了极端少步数下的结构畸变并保留了高频细节。
AI.summary: 本文针对一致性蒸馏中采样动力学研究不足的问题，提出了曲率自适应一致性流匹配 (CACFM)。通过引入强化学习代理动态优化采样轨迹，CACFM 无需人工调度即可自动构建高效的学习课程，克服了传统方法在边界阶段的优化瓶颈。
AI.keywords: 一致性蒸馏, 强化学习, 轨迹优化, 扩散模型, 流匹配
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入强化学习来动态调整一致性蒸馏中的采样轨迹，有效解决了传统静态采样在边界阶段的优化瓶颈，为加速扩散模型推理提供了一种自适应且高效的创新方案。

title: Identifying Quality Indicators in Student Self-Reflections in Software Engineering
summary: Context: Reflection is a fundamental skill in software engineering education, particularly in project-based courses where students learn through extended group work and need to develop their ability to reflect iteratively throughout their work. For students to benefit from reflection, their written reflections need to be assessed so that feedback can guide and improve their reflective practice. However, manually assessing written reflections to guide reflections is time-consuming, and often results in broad, non-specific feedback for a student to improve. Objective: This study builds on reflective writing frameworks to produce an eight-indicator scheme for assessing student reflections in software engineering. Furthermore, this study validates an automated classifier for assessing reflections against the framework, enabling scalable and structured feedback whilst reducing instructor workload. Method: We adapted existing reflection frameworks through iterative refinement to create our eight-indicator framework. Three annotators labelled student reflection texts, establishing moderate to reliable inter-rater agreement. We then trained and evaluated multiple encoder-only transformer models and compared them with decoder-only large language models using zero-shot prompting. Results: The fine-tuned RoBERTa model achieved the strongest performance, substantially outperforming decoder-only models in both accuracy and speed. The classifier demonstrated human-level agreement on most indicators whilst enabling near-instantaneous classification. We provide two model variants optimised for different assessment priorities. Conclusions: Our fine-tuned encoder-only models enable efficient automated assessment of reflective writing. The framework and automated classifier offer a means to provide timely, structured feedback on student reflections in software engineering.

AI.title_translation: 识别软件工程学生反思中的质量指标
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于八项指标的软件工程学生反思评估框架，并利用微调后的RoBERTa模型实现了高效、准确的自动化评估，为教师提供了及时反馈的新途径。
AI.motivation: 在软件工程项目课程中，学生反思对于学习至关重要。然而，手动评估学生反思文本既耗时又难以提供具体反馈。因此，研究旨在开发一套评估指标，并利用自动化技术实现高效、结构化的反馈，以减轻教师负担。
AI.method: 研究者通过迭代优化现有的反思框架，构建了一个包含八项指标的评估体系。利用人工标注的数据集，对多种编码器架构（如RoBERTa）进行了微调，并将其与基于零样本提示（Zero-shot）的解码器架构大型语言模型进行了性能对比。
AI.result: 微调后的RoBERTa模型表现最佳，在准确性和处理速度上均显著优于零样本解码器模型。该分类器在多数指标上达到了与人类评估相当的一致性，并实现了近乎即时的自动化评估。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的编码器模型（如RoBERTa）能够有效地对软件工程专业的学生反思进行自动化评估，为大规模、即时且结构化的反馈提供了可行方案。
AI.translation: 背景：反思是软件工程教育中的一项基本技能，特别是在基于项目的课程中，学生通过长期的团队合作学习，需要培养在整个工作中进行迭代反思的能力。为了让学生从反思中受益，他们的书面反思需要被评估，以便反馈能够指导和改进他们的反思实践。然而，手动评估书面反思非常耗时，且往往只能提供宽泛、非特定的反馈。目标：本研究基于反思写作框架，构建了一个包含八项指标的方案，用于评估软件工程专业的学生反思。此外，本研究验证了一个针对该框架的反思评估自动化分类器，在减少教师工作量的同时，实现了可扩展且结构化的反馈。方法：我们通过迭代优化现有的反思框架，创建了八项指标框架。三名标注员对学生反思文本进行了标注，建立了中度到可靠的评分者间一致性。随后，我们训练并评估了多个仅编码器Transformer模型，并将其与使用零样本提示的仅解码器大型语言模型进行了比较。结果：微调后的RoBERTa模型表现最强，在准确性和速度上均大幅优于仅解码器模型。该分类器在大多数指标上表现出与人类一致的水平，同时实现了近乎即时的分类。我们提供了两种针对不同评估优先级优化的模型变体。结论：我们微调的仅编码器模型实现了反思写作的高效自动化评估。该框架和自动化分类器为提供及时、结构化的软件工程学生反思反馈提供了手段。
AI.summary: 本文针对软件工程教育中的反思评估难题，提出了一套包含八项指标的评估框架，并开发了相应的自动化分类器。通过微调RoBERTa模型，该系统能够高效地对学生反思文本进行评估，提供结构化反馈，从而减轻教师工作量并提升教学反馈质量。
AI.keywords: 软件工程教育, 学生反思, 自动化评估, Transformer模型, 质量指标
AI.comments: 该研究通过将教育学中的反思框架应用于软件工程领域，并结合Transformer模型实现了反思质量的自动化评估，具有较高的实用价值。其创新点在于将复杂的反思评估转化为可计算的指标，并对比了多种预训练模型。局限性在于该指标体系主要针对软件工程项目课程，其跨学科的普适性尚待验证。

title: A Vendor-Agnostic LiDAR Data Conversion System with Multi-Signal Detection and Multi-Format Output
comments: Manuscript submitted at Software: Practice and Experience
summary: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) sensors capture the surrounding environment as dense 3D point clouds by measuring the time-of-flight of emitted laser pulses, making them foundational across autonomous vehicles, robotics, and large-scale mapping. PCAP (Packet Capture) files from these sensors are the starting point of most 3D perception pipelines, yet internal packet structures, UDP (User Datagram Protocol) port conventions and encoding schemes differ enough across manufacturers that no single tool reads them all. Ouster, Velodyne, Hesai, and Livox each require their own SDK (Software Development Kit), their own environment setup, and their own conversion workflow. Supporting all four means maintaining four disconnected pipelines with no shared infrastructure. The pipeline described here takes a raw PCAP as input and handles vendor identification automatically, scoring six independent file characteristics through a weighted multi-signal approach to determine the source sensor. C++ SDKs handle Ouster and Velodyne, while Hesai and Livox rely on Python-based dpkt parsing where no open source SDK exists. From there, a single command writes output to any of five industry-standard formats. We tested on real outdoor captures. Ouster peaks at 2.08M points per second, Velodyne at 1.47M, both running through native C++ packet decoding. Hesai and Livox land at 110K and 150K respectively, where Python-layer parsing introduces overhead that compounds under sustained load. The 8-10x gap held consistently across runs. Tested on a consumer-grade i3 with 8GB RAM, no vendor configuration required
comment: Manuscript submitted at Software: Practice and Experience

AI.title_translation: 一种具有多信号检测和多格式输出的厂商无关LiDAR数据转换系统
AI.tldr: 该系统自动识别不同品牌的LiDAR传感器，并将原始数据统一转换为标准格式，极大简化了多厂商设备混合使用的开发工作流。
AI.motivation: 不同厂商的LiDAR传感器在PCAP文件结构、UDP协议和编码方案上存在显著差异，导致开发人员需要维护多个不兼容的SDK和工作流，缺乏通用的数据处理工具。
AI.method: 开发了一个自动化流水线，通过加权多信号检测方法自动识别传感器厂商，利用C++ SDK处理Ouster和Velodyne数据，并利用Python的dpkt解析器处理Hesai和Livox数据，最终统一输出为五种行业标准格式。
AI.result: 系统成功支持四种主流LiDAR厂商，在消费级硬件上无需额外配置即可运行。性能测试显示，C++解析的传感器（Ouster/Velodyne）处理速度远高于Python解析的传感器（Hesai/Livox），表现出8-10倍的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功实现了一个统一的LiDAR数据转换框架，能够自动识别传感器厂商并将原始PCAP数据转化为标准格式，在不增加用户配置负担的情况下显著简化了多源数据处理流程。
AI.translation: LiDAR（激光雷达）传感器通过测量发射激光脉冲的飞行时间，将周围环境捕捉为密集的3D点云，这使其成为自动驾驶、机器人技术和大规模测绘的基础。来自这些传感器的PCAP（数据包捕获）文件是大多数3D感知流水线的起点，然而不同制造商之间的内部数据包结构、UDP（用户数据报协议）端口约定和编码方案差异巨大，以至于没有单一工具可以读取所有格式。Ouster、Velodyne、Hesai和Livox各自需要自己的SDK、环境设置和转换工作流。支持这四种格式意味着需要维护四个断开连接的流水线，且没有共享基础设施。本文所述的流水线以原始PCAP作为输入，通过加权多信号方法对六个独立的特征进行评分，自动处理厂商识别以确定源传感器。C++ SDK用于处理Ouster和Velodyne，而Hesai和Livox则依赖于基于Python的dpkt解析（因为缺乏开源SDK）。在此基础上，系统通过单条命令将输出写入五种行业标准格式中的任意一种。我们在真实的户外采集数据上进行了测试。Ouster每秒处理点数峰值为208万，Velodyne为147万，两者均通过原生C++数据包解码运行。Hesai和Livox分别为11万和15万，Python层解析引入的开销在持续负载下会叠加。这种8-10倍的差距在多次运行中保持一致。系统在配备8GB内存的消费级i3电脑上进行了测试，无需任何厂商配置。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种与厂商无关的LiDAR数据转换系统，通过自动识别传感器厂商并统一处理流程，将多厂商的原始PCAP数据转换为标准化格式，从而消除了维护多个独立SDK的需求。
AI.keywords: LiDAR, 点云处理, 多厂商兼容, 自动识别, 数据转换
AI.comments: 该论文通过统一多厂商LiDAR数据处理流程，解决了机器人和自动驾驶领域中不同硬件SDK不兼容的痛点。其创新的多信号检测方法实现了自动化厂商识别，具有很高的工程实用价值。局限性在于Python实现的解析器在性能上显著低于C++实现，在大规模点云处理中可能存在瓶颈。

title: On the Intractability of the Minimum Distance Problem for Regular LDPC Codes
summary: The minimum distance problem (MDP) for low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes is a central problem in coding theory and is closely related to the analysis of low-weight codewords and error-floor behavior. Although the unrestricted MDP is computationally intractable, its complexity under degree constraints that commonly occur in LDPC code design has remained less clear. In this paper, we study the MDP for left regular and biregular Tanner graphs. For every fixed $J\geq3$, we prove that the standard at-most-weight problem is $\mathrm{NP}$-complete for $J$-left regular Tanner graphs and that its exact-weight variant is $\mathrm{W}[1]$-complete when parameterized by the prescribed weight. For biregular Tanner graphs, we prove $\mathrm{NP}$-completeness for $(3,K)$-regular instances for every fixed $K\geq 3$ by replacing degree-two auxiliary completion blocks with a single-port high-girth gadget. A nonzero relative support inside this gadget induces an essentially cubic graph, so the Moore bound gives an exponential lower bound in the girth and allows a polynomial-size Karp reduction. Combining this right-degree amplification with a replica-and-global-check left-degree amplification yields $\mathrm{NP}$-completeness for $(J,K)$-regular Tanner graphs for every fixed $J,K\geq 3$. The reductions are based on a degree-preserving transformation framework consisting of hyperedge decomposition, check node splitting, and controlled variable replication. These transformations relate different degree distributions while preserving explicit maps among nonzero codewords, even covers, and nonempty $(a,0)$-trapping sets. The results delineate the computational limits of computing minimum distance exactly under natural regularity constraints.

title: Omni-Perception Policy Optimization for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning
comments: Accepted at ICML 2026. Project page: https://zjycutieee.github.io/OPPO-page/ Code: https://github.com/ZhiyuanHan-Aaron/OPPO
summary: We find that current emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs still lack reliable omni-modal perception: they (i) underutilize multimodal cues in their reasoning trajectories and (ii) exhibit unfaithful behavior, often hallucinating modality-specific statements from other modalities. Building on these insights, we propose OPPO (Omni-Perception Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception. First, an Omni-Perception Reward decomposes ground-truth reasoning into fine-grained visual, acoustic, and emotion cues and rewards trajectories that semantically recover these cues. Second, an Omni-Perception Loss compares the policy under full and unimodally masked inputs, applying a KL penalty only to modality-specific evidence tokens to suppress cross-modal hallucination. We further introduce MEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that quantifies utilization and faithfulness. Experiments show that OPPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion, while substantially improving utilization and faithfulness scores on MEP-Bench, highlighting the importance of sufficient and faithful omni perception for multimodal emotion reasoning.
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Project page: https://zjycutieee.github.io/OPPO-page/ Code: https://github.com/ZhiyuanHan-Aaron/OPPO

AI.title_translation: 面向多模态情感推理的全感知策略优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为OPPO的强化学习框架，通过细粒度奖励和模态掩码机制，有效提升了多模态情感推理模型的感知可靠性并减少了跨模态幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有面向情感的多模态大模型（Omni-MLLMs）存在多模态线索利用不足以及跨模态幻觉（即基于一种模态虚构另一种模态的信息）的问题。
AI.method: 提出OPPO框架，包含两个核心部分：1. 全感知奖励机制，通过将推理过程分解为细粒度多模态线索进行奖励；2. 全感知损失函数，通过对比全模态与单模态掩码输入，利用KL散度惩罚抑制跨模态幻觉。此外，构建了MEP-Bench评估基准。
AI.result: OPPO在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上达到了最先进的性能，并在MEP-Bench上显著提高了模态利用率和忠实度评分。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明OPPO框架显著提升了多模态情感推理的性能，并有效改善了模型的模态利用率和忠实度，验证了增强全感知能力对多模态情感推理的重要性。
AI.translation: 我们发现当前面向情感的全模态大模型（Omni-MLLMs）仍缺乏可靠的全模态感知能力：它们（i）在推理轨迹中未能充分利用多模态线索，以及（ii）表现出不忠实的行为，经常从其他模态中幻觉出特定模态的陈述。基于这些见解，我们提出了OPPO（全感知策略优化），这是一个明确优化多模态感知的强化学习框架。首先，全感知奖励将地面真值推理分解为细粒度的视觉、听觉和情感线索，并奖励能够语义恢复这些线索的推理轨迹。其次，全感知损失比较了在全模态和单模态掩码输入下的策略，仅对特定模态的证据标记应用KL惩罚，以抑制跨模态幻觉。我们还引入了MEP-Bench，这是一个量化利用率和忠实度的诊断基准。实验表明，OPPO在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上达到了最先进的性能，同时在MEP-Bench上的利用率和忠实度得分显著提高，突显了充分且忠实的全感知对于多模态情感推理的重要性。
AI.summary: 针对多模态情感推理中模型感知不可靠的问题，本文提出了OPPO框架。该框架通过细粒度的多模态奖励和基于模态掩码的损失函数，强化了模型对多模态线索的利用并抑制了跨模态幻觉，同时引入了MEP-Bench基准以量化评估模型的感知能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态情感推理, 全感知优化, 强化学习, 模态忠实度, 幻觉抑制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出通过强化学习框架（OPPO）来解决多模态大模型在情感推理中存在的感知不足和幻觉问题。其核心贡献在于将多模态感知能力量化，并结合细粒度奖励机制和模态遮蔽损失来优化推理过程，这为提升多模态模型的忠实度和推理可靠性提供了重要参考。

title: Reclaim Evaluation: A Lossy Memory Is Worse Than an Empty One
comments: v4: adds τ-bench replication (wall + source-first fix, scale-invariant, judge-free) and the mandatory-tool-interface result (harm-vs-escalation is a modelxinterface property); matched-decoding control; tightened framing and definitions
summary: A language model's memory can be worse than no memory at all when the model or its interface is disposed to act on it: a memory that keeps a wrong conclusion but drops the work behind it leads a model to re-emit the stale value as a confident answer, where an empty memory leads it to abstain. We call this brittle memory. The information loss is definitional; the finding is behavioral, and it turns on one thing, whether the memory kept a re-derivation basis (the source) rather than the answer. We measure it with reclaim evaluation: induce a known drift, compress at a fixed budget, deliver a correction that names the error, and score exact recovery, judge-free. Holding the budget fixed and varying only what the compression keeps isolates correctability from capability and from size; an 8B model and a frontier one wall in the same place. A one-line source-first policy, keep the recomputable source, drop the re-derivable conclusion, restores correctability at equal budget where the source is compact and identifiable, with a length-matched control ruling out "more text." We map where the fix fails, show the failure compounds through memory loops, and replicate across three deployed memory systems, real dialogue (MultiWOZ), and tau-bench, a deployed-agent benchmark where whether a lossy memory becomes a harmful action is a joint model-and-interface property. We release the harness, the paired memory conditions, and validators built to come out false.
